title: Never Look Back: Understanding Persistence in 3D Object Memory from Egocentric Videos
title_zh: Ledger: 一种持久的3D对象记忆

paragraphs.en: As we move through the world and carry out everyday tasks, we encounter objects that may become relevant only later. We are capable of recalling where we left something or what was inside a container, even without knowing we would need it later. Here, we study how an embodied assistant can build a similar memory from egocentric videos, by observing a person’s day-to-day activities. We present Ledger , a persistent 3D object memory that combines object locations, their histories, and contextual descriptions. It associates observations across the recording and retains objects after they leave the view, including those the person never touches. It clusters each object’s observations by resting locations and records a move only after repeated evidence, reducing the effect of localization noise. Short descriptions preserve details such as an object’s contents or supporting surface. It saves these records to later answer spatial questions without having to access the original images or video. Our memory raises HD-EPIC accuracy from 29.7% to 42.6%, UCS-Bench accuracy from 33.8% to 38.5% and localizes Ego4D objects with a 0.99 m median error on returned predictions. Our analyses identify complementary roles for temporal persistence, contextual descriptions, and retrieval. Our study on 100 stitched streams of multiple scenes each further exposes failures in both retrieval and construction. Per-scene construction partially recovers the performance lost across scene changes compared to that of single scene streams.
paragraphs.zh: 当我们在世界中活动并执行日常任务时，会遇到一些可能直到后来才变得重要的物体。 即使不知道以后会用得上，我们也能回忆起自己把某样东西放在哪里，或者容器里装有什么。 在这里，我们研究一个具身助手如何通过观察一个人的日常活动，从以自我为中心的视频中构建类似的记忆。 我们提出了 Ledger——一种持久的三维物体记忆系统，它结合了物体的位置、历史以及上下文描述。 它能在整个记录过程中关联不同观察结果，并在物体离开视野后仍保留其信息，包括那些当事人从未接触过的物体。 它将每个物体的观察结果按静止位置进行聚类，并仅在出现重复证据后才记录移动，从而减少定位噪声的影响。 简短的描述保留了诸如物体内容或支撑表面等细节。 它将这些记录保存下来，以便日后回答空间性问题，而无需访问原始图像或视频。 我们的记忆系统将 HD-EPIC 的准确率从 29.7% 提升至 42.6%，UCS-Bench 的准确率从 33.8% 提升至 38.5%，并在返回的预测中将以 0.99 米的中间误差定位 Ego4D 物体。 我们的分析揭示了时间持久性、上下文描述和检索功能之间互补的作用。 我们对包含多个场景的 100 条拼接流的研究，进一步揭示了检索和构建过程中的失败情况。 与单场景流相比，按场景进行的构建在一定程度上恢复了跨场景切换时丢失的性能。

paragraphs.en: Humans typically perform several tasks during the day like cooking, clearing out the garage, playing football, or other diverse activities. We are reliably good at tracking our environments and our positions relative to the objects of the scene we are in [ 48 , 3 ] . Even after exiting the scene, we can still answer certain questions about it like where we left the wrench, which shelf had the spare batteries, or where the serving bowl was last placed [ 37 , 21 ] . Fundamentally, we keep a running memory of where potentially important objects are [ 26 , 19 ] , freeing us from having to exactly retrace our steps in either our memories or the scene itself [ 46 , 13 ] . Similarly, in long horizon explorations spanning multiple scenes, we are capable of both tracking objects across scenes [ 51 ] and revising our memory for familiar objects displaced when we were absent from a scene [ 20 , 24 ] . Our goal is to develop embodied spatial memory that supports recall of previously visited scenes and incorporates new observations of objects and changes in familiar environments. A natural setting to study these capabilities is long egocentric videos about everyday human activity (Figure 1 ). Such videos capture people moving through diverse scenes, interacting with objects, and revisiting places over time. This enables us to study what an embodied agent can retain from a person’s visual experience without controlling where that person looks or what they do.
paragraphs.zh: 人类通常在一天中完成多项任务，例如烹饪、清理车库、踢足球或从事其他多样化的活动。 我们能够可靠地追踪周围环境以及我们在所处场景中物体相对位置 [ 48 , 3 ] 。 即使离开场景后，我们仍然能够回答关于该场景的某些问题，例如我们把扳手放在哪里、哪个架子上有备用电池，或者盛菜碗最后被放在哪里 [ 37 , 21 ] 。 从根本上说，我们会持续记忆可能重要的物体所处的位置 [ 26 , 19 ] ，从而无需在记忆中或场景中精确地重走我们的足迹 [ 46 , 13 ] 。 同样，在跨越多个场景的长期探索中，我们既能追踪跨场景的物体 [ 51 ] ，也能修正因自己不在某个场景时而被移动的熟悉物体的记忆 [ 20 , 24 ] 。 我们的目标是开发一种具身空间记忆能力，以支持对先前访问过的场景进行回忆，并整合对物体的新观察以及对熟悉环境变化的记录。 研究这些能力的自然场景是记录日常人类活动的长视角视频（图 1）。 这类视频捕捉了人们穿越多样化场景、与物体互动以及随时间推移再次访问某些地点的过程。 这使得我们能够在不控制人物视线方向或行为的前提下，研究具身智能体能够从一个人的视觉经验中保留哪些信息。

paragraphs.en: Building such a memory from these recordings is challenging. Objects can be occluded, briefly visible or captured from an alternate viewpoint [ 17 , 12 , 43 ] . They may also move between observations, and errors in 3D localization can make an agent mistake a stationary object for a moving one. Moreover, the agent does not know during exploration which objects or events will be relevant to a question asked later. It should decide what information to retain from these incomplete observations. This includes information about objects that are only seen in passing. In this work, we study four aspects of this problem: which objects are recorded in the memory, how to record changes in their locations, what information is retained beyond their 3D positions, and how earlier observations can be retrieved as more scenes are added. Our goal here is to understand how these design choices impact the spatial questions an agent can answer after exploration, without revisiting the scene or replaying the video.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些记录构建这样的记忆具有挑战性。 物体可能被遮挡、短暂可见，或从其他视角捕捉到 [ 17 , 12 , 43 ] 。 它们也可能在不同观察之间移动，而三维定位中的错误可能导致智能体将静止物体误认为运动物体。 此外，在探索过程中，智能体并不知道哪些物体或事件会对之后提出的问题具有相关性。 它应当决定从这些不完整的观察中保留哪些信息。 这包括仅短暂经过时看到的物体的相关信息。 在这项工作中，我们研究了该问题的四个方面：哪些物体会被记录到记忆中、如何记录其位置的变化、除了三维位置之外还保留哪些信息，以及随着更多场景的加入，如何检索早期的观察结果。 我们的目标是理解这些设计选择如何影响智能体在探索结束后无需重返场景或重播视频就能回答的空间问题。

paragraphs.en: a R4DSG’s objects enter through a per-segment controlled vocabulary and its places through location segments, both taken from released segment records whose source the paper does not state; anchors are found per location window, and the authors report limited cross-day persistence.
paragraphs.zh: R4DSG 的实体通过按分段控制的词汇表进入，其位置则通过位置分段进入；这两者均取自已发布但论文未注明来源的分段记录；锚点按每个位置窗口进行查找，作者报告称跨日持久性有限。

paragraphs.en: Recent works have developed object memories that retain identities and locations after objects leave the view [ 36 , 6 , 16 , 33 ] . Object-centric maps and scene graphs organize observations through the spatial relationships between objects [ 18 , 40 ] . Language-model agents, in contrast, write their observations into a structured record of objects, places, and their states, which the model later reads to answer questions [ 2 , 15 , 58 , 49 ] . Another line of work simply uses video-language models to answer from frames sampled from the recording at question time without explicitly maintaining a record of the scene [ 11 , 60 , 61 , 44 ] , including models trained particularly for spatial reasoning [ 52 , 55 ] . Streaming models compress past frames in a memory of visual tokens [ 59 , 38 , 23 ] . Visual query localization methods search the recording again for every query [ 17 , 30 ] . Table 1 compares what these memories keep and what they need at query time. To guide memory design, we need to decide which retained evidence supports later questions and to distinguish failures of representation from retrieval and reasoning failures.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究已经开发出能够保留物体身份和位置的物体记忆，即使这些物体离开了视野 [ 36 , 6 , 16 , 33 ] 。 以物体为中心的地图和场景图通过物体之间的空间关系来组织观察结果 [ 18 , 40 ] 。 相比之下，语言模型智能体则将其观察内容写入一个包含物体、位置及其状态的结构化记录中，模型随后会读取该记录来回答问题 [ 2 , 15 , 58 , 49 ] 。 另一条研究路线则直接使用视频-语言模型，在问题出现时从记录中采样的帧中直接回答问题，而无需显式维护场景记录 [ 11 , 60 , 61 , 44 ] ，其中包括专门针对空间推理进行训练的模型 [ 52 , 55 ] 。 流式模型将过去的帧压缩为视觉标记的记忆 [ 59 , 38 , 23 ] 。 视觉查询定位方法则对每次查询都重新搜索整个记录 [ 17 , 30 ] 。 表 1 比较了这些记忆所保留的内容以及它们在查询时所需的信息。 为了指导记忆的设计，我们需要决定哪些保留的证据能够支持后续的问题，并区分表示失败与检索和推理失败。

sents.zh: 表 1 比较了这些记忆所保留的内容以及它们在查询时所需的信息。

sents.en: To guide memory design, we need to decide which retained evidence supports later questions and to distinguish failures of representation from retrieval and reasoning failures.
sents.zh: 为了指导记忆的设计，我们需要决定哪些保留的证据能够支持后续的问题，并区分表示失败与检索和推理失败。

paragraphs.en: For example, restricting memory to objects involved in hand interactions [ 16 , 36 ] can exclude visible objects that still affect the agent or are relevant later on. Although retaining an object’s position may support a location question, it does not preserve its contents or its movement history. Even a sequence of positions can mislead when localization noise is recorded as movement. Further failures can arise across scenes when storing observations into memory or while retrieving relevant records. These examples motivate us to address our core question: what must an agent preserve from past observations to answer spatial questions it could not anticipate?
paragraphs.zh: 例如，将记忆限制在与手部互动相关的物体上 [ 16 , 36 ]，可能会排除那些仍然影响智能体或之后仍会相关的可见物体。 虽然保留物体的位置可能有助于回答位置相关的问题，但这并不能保存其内部内容或移动历史。 即使是一系列位置信息，如果定位噪声被记录为移动，也可能产生误导。 在将观察结果存储到记忆中，或在检索相关记录时，不同场景之间还可能出现更多问题。 这些例子促使我们去探讨核心问题：为了回答那些无法预见的空间性问题，智能体必须从过去的观察中保留哪些信息？

paragraphs.en: To this end, we present Ledger (Long-horizon Egocentric Descriptions, Geometry, and Event Records), a persistent 3D object memory that combines geometric observations with contextual descriptions. We construct the memory offline from sampled egocentric recordings, using supplied or estimated camera poses. We detect objects with an open-vocabulary detector, associate their observations over time, store them whether or not the wearer interacts with them, and keep their records after they leave view. We group each object’s timestamped 3D observations into rest segments . Each rest segment for an object represents its observations close to the same resting location. A new segment indicates that the object has moved, which is only recorded when multiple subsequent observations support it. We use a persistence rule to reduce false motion detections caused by localization noise. We add a short contextual description to each segment to capture details such as what a container held or which surface it rested on. We first identify the objects referred to in the question and retrieve their records. A language model then answers using these records as text, without seeing images or the original video. This tests whether the stored locations, histories, and descriptions provide enough information to answer questions about objects no longer in view.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出了 Ledger（长期自中心描述、几何与事件记录），一种持久的三维对象记忆系统，它将几何观察与上下文描述相结合。 我们利用提供的或估计的相机姿态，从采样得到的自中心记录中离线构建该记忆系统。 我们通过开放词汇量检测器识别物体，关联其随时间的观察数据，无论佩戴者是否与物体互动都将其存储下来，并在物体离开视野后保留其记录。 我们将每个物体的带时间戳的三维观察数据分组为静止段。 每个物体的每个静止段代表其在相近静止位置附近的观察数据。 新的静止段表示该物体发生了移动，但只有当后续多个观察结果支持这一判断时才会被记录。 我们采用一种持久性规则，以减少由定位噪声引起的虚假运动检测。 我们为每个静止段添加简短的上下文描述，以捕捉诸如容器内装有什么或物体置于哪个表面等细节。 我们首先识别问题中提及的物体，并检索它们的记录。 随后，语言模型利用这些记录作为文本进行回答，而无需查看图像或原始视频。 这检验了存储的位置、历史记录和描述是否足以回答关于已不在视野中的物体的问题。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Ledger on all 2,400 questions in HD-EPIC’s 3D Perception and Object Motion categories [ 35 ] , named-object localization on Ego4D VQ3D [ 17 ] , and 2,771 timestamped questions on UCS-Bench [ 49 ] . On UCS-Bench, the answerer sees 48 frames. Adding Ledger yields 46.3 % 46.3\% accuracy, compared with 42.9 % 42.9\% when adding DirectMe’s graph. On VQ3D, our memory returns object locations with a median error of 0.99 m among the queries for which it returns a prediction.

paragraphs.en: A reusable 3D memory of past observations. We introduce Ledger , a persistent object memory built offline from egocentric videos with supplied or estimated poses, retaining locations, movement histories, and contextual descriptions, even for untouched objects.
paragraphs.zh: 一种可重复使用的、记录过往观察结果的三维记忆。 我们提出了 Ledger，这是一种持久化的对象记忆系统，它通过离线处理第一人称视角视频，并结合提供的或估算出的姿态信息构建而成，能够保留物体的位置、移动历史以及上下文描述，即使这些物体从未被互动过。

sents.en: A reusable 3D memory of past observations.
sents.zh: 一种可重复使用的、记录过往观察结果的三维记忆。

sents.en: We introduce Ledger , a persistent object memory built offline from egocentric videos with supplied or estimated poses, retaining locations, movement histories, and contextual descriptions, even for untouched objects.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 Ledger，这是一种持久化的对象记忆系统，它通过离线处理第一人称视角视频，并结合提供的或估算出的姿态信息构建而成，能够保留物体的位置、移动历史以及上下文描述，即使这些物体从未被互动过。

paragraphs.en: Spatial answering and localization across benchmarks. We demonstrate improved text-only question answering on HD-EPIC, named-object localization on Ego4D VQ3D, and gains over frame-only answering on UCS-Bench, and compare against rebuilt object, caption, and graph memories to show where our representation helps and what it misses.
paragraphs.zh: 跨基准测试的空间回答与定位。 我们在 HD-EPIC 上展示了纯文本问答能力的提升，在 Ego4D VQ3D 上实现了命名对象定位的改进，并在 UCS-Bench 上超越了仅基于帧的回答方法；同时，我们将结果与重建的对象、描述和图记忆进行了对比，以展示我们的表示方法在哪些方面具有优势，以及存在哪些不足。

sents.en: Spatial answering and localization across benchmarks.
sents.zh: 跨基准测试的空间回答与定位。

sents.en: We demonstrate improved text-only question answering on HD-EPIC, named-object localization on Ego4D VQ3D, and gains over frame-only answering on UCS-Bench, and compare against rebuilt object, caption, and graph memories to show where our representation helps and what it misses.
sents.zh: 我们在 HD-EPIC 上展示了纯文本问答能力的提升，在 Ego4D VQ3D 上实现了命名对象定位的改进，并在 UCS-Bench 上超越了仅基于帧的回答方法；同时，我们将结果与重建的对象、描述和图记忆进行了对比，以展示我们的表示方法在哪些方面具有优势，以及存在哪些不足。

paragraphs.en: Evidence for how to build and read memory. Ablations isolate temporal persistence, contextual descriptions, and geometry, and shared readers reveal how retrieval shapes a representation’s apparent advantage; costlier iterative search does not improve every task.
paragraphs.zh: 构建和读取记忆的证据。 消融实验将时间持续性、上下文描述和几何结构分离出来，而共享读取器则揭示了检索如何塑造表征的表面优势；成本更高的迭代搜索并不会提升所有任务的表现。

sents.en: Evidence for how to build and read memory.
sents.zh: 构建和读取记忆的证据。

sents.en: Ablations isolate temporal persistence, contextual descriptions, and geometry, and shared readers reveal how retrieval shapes a representation’s apparent advantage; costlier iterative search does not improve every task.

paragraphs.en: An analysis of accumulating experience. Across recording lengths and 100 paired stitched streams, memory retains its gains up to 75 minutes, while scene changes expose failures in construction and retrieval that building memory per scene partially repairs.
paragraphs.zh: 对累积经验的分析。 在不同长度的记录以及 100 对拼接流中，记忆在长达 75 分钟的时间内都能保持其增益，而场景变化则暴露了构建和检索中的缺陷，按场景构建记忆可以部分修复这些问题。

sents.en: An analysis of accumulating experience.
sents.zh: 对累积经验的分析。

sents.en: Across recording lengths and 100 paired stitched streams, memory retains its gains up to 75 minutes, while scene changes expose failures in construction and retrieval that building memory per scene partially repairs.
sents.zh: 在不同长度的记录以及 100 对拼接流中，记忆在长达 75 分钟的时间内都能保持其增益，而场景变化则暴露了构建和检索中的缺陷，按场景构建记忆可以部分修复这些问题。

paragraphs.en: OSNOM tracks the 3D locations of active objects through absence with appearance and spatial association [ 36 ] . Whareformer learns association with an updatable track memory and an explicit new-track decision and is trained on active objects. However, its architecture does not require contact [ 6 ] . AMEGO builds location memories and interaction tracklets for querying on long videos [ 16 ] , and ESOM couples discovery, tracking, and retrieval in an online visual-query memory [ 33 ] . These systems determine which objects enter memory and how to recognize them when they reappear. Scene representations also differ in the information they store. ConceptGraphs builds open-vocabulary scene graphs of objects from posed RGB-D observations [ 18 ] . Snapshot and scene-based memories support spatial reasoning and exploration [ 57 , 28 , 62 ] . Khronos records short-term motion and long-term scene changes [ 40 ] . DirectMe tracks objects, places, and the wearer, and uses geometry to derive spatial relations for timestamped questions [ 49 ] .
paragraphs.zh: OSNOM 通过“消失与出现”以及空间关联来追踪活跃物体的三维位置 [ 36 ] 。 Whareformer 借助一个可更新的轨迹记忆模块和一个明确的新轨迹决策机制来学习关联，并在活跃物体上进行训练。 然而，其架构并不要求接触 [ 6 ] 。 AMEGO 构建位置记忆和交互轨迹片段，以便在长视频中查询 [ 16 ] ，而 ESOM 则将发现、追踪和检索耦合到一个在线视觉查询记忆中 [ 33 ] 。 这些系统会决定哪些物体进入记忆，并在它们再次出现时如何识别它们。 场景表示在存储的信息方面也存在差异。 ConceptGraphs 从带有姿态的 RGB-D 观测数据中构建包含开放词汇的场景图 [ 18 ] 。 快照和基于场景的记忆支持空间推理和探索 [ 57 , 28 , 62 ] 。 Khronos 记录短期运动和长期场景变化 [ 40 ] 。 DirectMe 能够追踪物体、地点以及佩戴者，并利用几何学推导出带时间戳问题的空间关系 [ 49 ] 。

sents.zh: 这些系统会决定哪些物体进入记忆，并在它们再次出现时如何识别它们。

sents.en: Scene representations also differ in the information they store.
sents.zh: 场景表示在存储的信息方面也存在差异。

sents.en: ConceptGraphs builds open-vocabulary scene graphs of objects from posed RGB-D observations [ 18 ] .
sents.zh: ConceptGraphs 从带有姿态的 RGB-D 观测数据中构建包含开放词汇的场景图 [ 18 ] 。

sents.zh: 快照和基于场景的记忆支持空间推理和探索 [ 57 , 28 , 62 ] 。

sents.en: Khronos records short-term motion and long-term scene changes [ 40 ] .
sents.zh: Khronos 记录短期运动和长期场景变化 [ 40 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We study how the objects retained, their estimated positions, movement histories, and contextual descriptions help answer different spatial questions. Errors in geometry can misplace an object or make it appear to have moved. We therefore evaluate how these errors affect answers, alongside their effect on localization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了保留下来的物体、其估计位置、移动历史以及上下文描述如何帮助回答不同的空间问题。 几何错误可能导致物体位置错误，或使其看起来像是发生了移动。 因此，我们评估了这些错误对答案的影响，以及它们对定位的影响。

sents.en: We study how the objects retained, their estimated positions, movement histories, and contextual descriptions help answer different spatial questions.
sents.zh: 我们研究了保留下来的物体、其估计位置、移动历史以及上下文描述如何帮助回答不同的空间问题。

sents.en: We therefore evaluate how these errors affect answers, alongside their effect on localization.
sents.zh: 因此，我们评估了这些错误对答案的影响，以及它们对定位的影响。

paragraphs.en: Memory-based systems differ in what they store, how they find relevant information, and whether they show images to the answerer. ReMEmbR stores captions with timestamps and positions, then searches this memory over multiple rounds to answer a question [ 2 ] . VideoAgent and Embodied VideoAgent combine stored information about entities with retrieved frames [ 14 , 15 ] . MEMORA maintains entity state for later reasoning [ 58 ] , while DirectMe gives the answerer its graph and retrieved frames [ 49 ] . Video-language and streaming models use sampled frames or compressed visual tokens without explicit object records [ 11 , 60 , 61 , 44 , 59 , 38 , 23 ] . We test what stored records can support when the answerer receives only text. We also compare our object records with event descriptions against a caption memory using the same retrieval procedures. This helps distinguish the value of the stored information from the reader’s ability to find and use it.
paragraphs.zh: 基于记忆的系统在存储内容、查找相关信息的方式以及是否向回答者展示图像方面存在差异。 ReMEmbR 会存储带有时间戳和位置的描述文本，然后在多个回合中搜索这些记忆以回答问题 [ 2 ] 。 VideoAgent 和 Embodied VideoAgent 将存储的实体信息与检索到的帧相结合 [ 14 , 15 ] 。 MEMORA 会保留实体的状态以便后续推理 [ 58 ] ，而 DirectMe 则向回答者提供其图结构和检索到的帧 [ 49 ] 。 视频语言模型和流式模型使用采样帧或压缩视觉标记，但没有显式的对象记录 [ 11 , 60 , 61 , 44 , 59 , 38 , 23 ] 。 我们测试了当回答者仅接收文本时，存储的记录能够提供哪些支持。 我们还使用相同的检索流程，将我们的对象记录与事件描述一同与描述文本记忆进行比较。 这有助于区分存储信息的价值与读取者查找并使用这些信息的能力。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks test different demands on memory. Ego4D VQ3D queries an object’s location using an image crop [ 17 ] ; EgoLoc, ReLoCATE, and EAGLE address this task through pose recovery, training-free retrieval, and appearance and geometric memory [ 30 , 25 , 4 ] . We evaluate localization using object names instead. HD-EPIC tests object and fixture positions and motion on calibrated recordings [ 35 ] , while UCS-Bench tests timestamped spatial reasoning relative to the moving wearer [ 49 ] . EASG-Bench tests questions grounded in scene graphs [ 39 ] , while OpenEQA tests questions about previously observed environments [ 32 ] . HourVideo evaluates reasoning over long egocentric videos [ 7 ] . EgoMemReason extends this to evidence spanning days, including changes in object states [ 50 ] . We complement these benchmarks by asking the same questions on individual recordings and on streams formed by joining recordings. We then modify memory construction and retrieval to identify why performance changes.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基准测试评估了内存的不同需求。 Ego4D VQ3D 通过图像裁剪查询物体的位置 [ 17 ]；EgoLoc、ReLoCATE 和 EAGLE 则通过姿态恢复、免训练检索以及外观和几何记忆来解决这一任务 [ 30 , 25 , 4 ]。 我们改用物体名称来评估定位能力。 HD-EPIC 在已校准的录像中测试物体和固定装置的位置与运动 [ 35 ]，而 UCS-Bench 则测试相对于移动佩戴者的时间戳空间推理能力 [ 49 ]。 EASG-Bench 测试基于场景图的问题 [ 39 ]，而 OpenEQA 则测试关于先前观察过环境的问题 [ 32 ]。 HourVideo 评估对长时间第一人称视角视频的推理能力 [ 7 ]。 EgoMemReason 将这一能力扩展到跨越数天的证据，包括物体状态的变化 [ 50 ]。 我们通过在单个录像以及由多个录像拼接而成的流中提出相同问题，来补充这些基准测试。 接着，我们修改内存的构建与检索方式，以明确性能变化的原因。

sents.en: Existing benchmarks test different demands on memory.
sents.zh: 现有的基准测试评估了内存的不同需求。

sents.en: Ego4D VQ3D queries an object’s location using an image crop [ 17 ] ; EgoLoc, ReLoCATE, and EAGLE address this task through pose recovery, training-free retrieval, and appearance and geometric memory [ 30 , 25 , 4 ] .
sents.zh: Ego4D VQ3D 通过图像裁剪查询物体的位置 [ 17 ]；EgoLoc、ReLoCATE 和 EAGLE 则通过姿态恢复、免训练检索以及外观和几何记忆来解决这一任务 [ 30 , 25 , 4 ]。

sents.en: We evaluate localization using object names instead.
sents.zh: 我们改用物体名称来评估定位能力。

sents.en: HD-EPIC tests object and fixture positions and motion on calibrated recordings [ 35 ] , while UCS-Bench tests timestamped spatial reasoning relative to the moving wearer [ 49 ] .
sents.zh: HD-EPIC 在已校准的录像中测试物体和固定装置的位置与运动 [ 35 ]，而 UCS-Bench 则测试相对于移动佩戴者的时间戳空间推理能力 [ 49 ]。

sents.en: EASG-Bench tests questions grounded in scene graphs [ 39 ] , while OpenEQA tests questions about previously observed environments [ 32 ] .
sents.zh: EASG-Bench 测试基于场景图的问题 [ 39 ]，而 OpenEQA 则测试关于先前观察过环境的问题 [ 32 ]。

sents.en: HourVideo evaluates reasoning over long egocentric videos [ 7 ] .
sents.zh: HourVideo 评估对长时间第一人称视角视频的推理能力 [ 7 ]。

sents.en: EgoMemReason extends this to evidence spanning days, including changes in object states [ 50 ] .
sents.zh: EgoMemReason 将这一能力扩展到跨越数天的证据，包括物体状态的变化 [ 50 ]。

sents.en: We complement these benchmarks by asking the same questions on individual recordings and on streams formed by joining recordings.
sents.zh: 我们通过在单个录像以及由多个录像拼接而成的流中提出相同问题，来补充这些基准测试。

sents.en: We then modify memory construction and retrieval to identify why performance changes.
sents.zh: 接着，我们修改内存的构建与检索方式，以明确性能变化的原因。

paragraphs.en: Ledger (Long-horizon Egocentric Descriptions, Geometry, and Event Records) constructs a persistent object memory offline from an egocentric recording and supplied or estimated camera poses (Figure 2 ), once per recording and independently of any question. It is then reused for spatial question answering and named-object localization; on UCS-Bench, reading it costs about 2.0k input tokens per question, against 9.6k for 48 sampled frames (Appendix H ).
paragraphs.zh: Ledger（长期自中心描述、几何与事件记录）通过一次自中心记录以及提供的或估计的相机姿态（图 2），在离线状态下构建一个持久的对象记忆，该过程每段记录仅执行一次，且独立于任何具体问题。 随后，该记忆会被重新用于空间问答和命名对象定位；在 UCS-Bench 上，读取它每个问题大约需要 2.0k 输入词元，而读取 48 个采样帧则需要 9.6k（附录 H）。

sents.en: Ledger (Long-horizon Egocentric Descriptions, Geometry, and Event Records) constructs a persistent object memory offline from an egocentric recording and supplied or estimated camera poses (Figure 2 ), once per recording and independently of any question.
sents.zh: Ledger（长期自中心描述、几何与事件记录）通过一次自中心记录以及提供的或估计的相机姿态（图 2），在离线状态下构建一个持久的对象记忆，该过程每段记录仅执行一次，且独立于任何具体问题。

paragraphs.en: For each instance j j , we store its label c j c_{j} and timestamped observations 𝒪 j = { ( t i , b i , 𝐱 i ) } \mathcal{O}_{j}=\{(t_{i},b_{i},\mathbf{x}_{i})\} , where b i b_{i} is the image box and 𝐱 i \mathbf{x}_{i} is the estimated 3D position in scene coordinates. We summarize the object’s observed location history as rest segments , 𝒮 j = { ( t s start , t s end , 𝝁 s , d s ) } \mathcal{S}_{j}=\{(t_{s}^{\rm start},t_{s}^{\rm end},\bm{\mu}_{s},d_{s})\} . Each segment groups observations associated with one resting location: t s start t_{s}^{\rm start} and t s end t_{s}^{\rm end} delimit the segment’s span in the sampled observation sequence, 𝝁 s \bm{\mu}_{s} represents its estimated 3D location, and d s d_{s} describes the object and its surrounding context. A new segment is confirmed only after repeated observations support a displacement from the current location. Rest segments thus summarize where the object was observed; its position during gaps between observations is unknown. Camera poses also retain the wearer’s trajectory and heading for egocentric queries. Unrelated scenes are not registered into a shared frame; coordinates are metric where pose scale is available.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个实例 j，我们存储其标签 c_j 和带有时间戳的观察数据 𝒪_j = { (t_i, b_i, 𝐱_i) }，其中 b_i 是图像框，𝐱_i 是在场景坐标系中估计的三维位置。 我们将物体被观察到的位置历史总结为静止段，即 𝒮_j = { (t_s^{\rm start}, t_s^{\rm end}, 𝝁_s, d_s) }。 每个静止段将关联于一个静止位置的观察数据分组：t_s^{\rm start} 和 t_s^{\rm end} 界定了该静止段在采样观察序列中的时间跨度，𝝁_s 表示其估计的三维位置，而 d_s 描述了物体及其周围环境。 只有当重复的观察结果支持物体从当前位置发生位移时，才会确认一个新的静止段。 因此，静止段总结了物体被观察到的位置；而在观察之间的间隙中，其位置是未知的。 相机姿态还保留了佩戴者的轨迹和方向，用于以自我为中心视角的查询。 无关的场景不会被注册到共享坐标系中；当姿态尺度可用时，坐标是度量坐标。

paragraphs.en: Discovery and geometry. Qwen3.5-9B names objects in sampled frames; synonym merging produces a vocabulary for YOLO-World [ 9 ] , so objects enter memory whether or not the wearer touches them, within the detection and 3D-lifting budgets. From the image, detection box, and label, WildDet3D [ 22 ] predicts a 3D box in camera coordinates, and the camera pose places its centre in scene coordinates (Appendix A ).
paragraphs.zh: 发现与几何。 Qwen3.5-9B 为采样帧中的物体命名；同义词合并为 YOLO-World [ 9 ] 生成一个词汇表，因此无论佩戴者是否接触这些物体，它们都会进入记忆，且受检测与 3D 提升预算限制。 WildDet3D [ 22 ] 根据图像、检测框和标签预测相机坐标系下的 3D 框，而相机的姿态则将其中心定位到场景坐标系中（附录 A）。

sents.en: Discovery and geometry.
sents.zh: 发现与几何。

sents.en: From the image, detection box, and label, WildDet3D [ 22 ] predicts a 3D box in camera coordinates, and the camera pose places its centre in scene coordinates (Appendix A ).
sents.zh: WildDet3D [ 22 ] 根据图像、检测框和标签预测相机坐标系下的 3D 框，而相机的姿态则将其中心定位到场景坐标系中（附录 A）。

paragraphs.en: Association and persistence. We match observations in time order to existing instances by label and distance from the instance’s latest position; same-frame detections stay separate unless they are overlapping duplicates. A second pass re-identifies objects that 3D association split into several tracks: the SAM 3 video tracker [ 5 ] propagates each fragment’s masks and merges fragments whose masks agree, subject to co-occurrence and 3D-distance checks (Appendix A.3 ). Records persist after objects leave view, although a large move may create a new identity. A new rest segment starts only after k k successive observations lie more than τ \tau from the current resting position; observations that return within this radius stay in the current segment. This suppresses false moves from localization noise but may miss brief ones.
paragraphs.zh: 关联性与持久性。 我们按时间顺序将观测结果与现有实例通过标签和与实例最新位置的距离进行匹配；同一帧内的检测结果保持独立，除非它们是重叠的重复项。 第二轮处理会重新识别那些因三维关联而被拆分为多个轨迹的对象：SAM 3 视频追踪器 [5] 会传播每个片段的面具，并在满足共现和三维距离检查（附录 A.3）的前提下合并面具一致的面具片段。 即使对象离开视野后，记录也会保留，但大幅移动可能会生成一个新的身份标识。 只有当连续 k 次观测到的位置与当前静止位置的距离均超过 τ 时，才会开始一个新的静止阶段；在此半径范围内返回的观测结果仍属于当前阶段。 这种方法可以抑制由定位噪声引起的虚假移动，但可能会遗漏短暂的移动。

paragraphs.en: Context and refinement. Qwen3.5-9B describes selected segments from frames with the object outlined, recording contents, supporting surfaces, and interactions (on HD-EPIC, transferred from distance-threshold segments; Appendix A.4 ). Multi-view triangulation refines a resting object’s position when the viewpoints are well separated and the estimate is stable and close to the original (Appendix A.5 ). Two extensions add activity descriptions for sampled frames and build a separate memory for each detected scene (Appendices E.5 and E.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 上下文与优化。 Qwen3.5-9B 会描述选定帧中已勾勒出对象的片段，记录其内容、支撑面及相互作用（在 HD-EPIC 上，数据来自距离阈值片段；附录 A.4）。 当视角充分分离且估计结果稳定并接近原始值时，多视角三角测量可优化静止物体的位置（附录 A.5）。 两项扩展功能分别为采样帧添加活动描述，并为每个检测到的场景构建独立的记忆（附录 E.5 和 E.4）。

paragraphs.en: Grounding and retrieval. HD-EPIC box queries are lifted to a 3D point on the sampled frame nearest their timestamp, and the four nearest instances observed within ± 6 \pm 6 s are retrieved; named fixtures are matched through fixed synonym groups, taking the most-observed matches, with clock directions computed from stored positions and the camera heading at query time. VQ3D supplies an object name, and we return the selected instance’s stored position; UCS-Bench targets are inferred from the question, and entries are ranked by word overlap and temporal proximity (Appendices B.2 , C , and D ).
paragraphs.zh: 基础定位与检索。 HD-EPIC 框查询被提升至采样帧中与其时间戳最近的三维点，并检索在 ±6 \pm 6 秒内观测到的四个最近实例；命名固定物通过固定的同义词组进行匹配，选取观测次数最多的匹配结果，其时钟方向则根据存储的位置和查询时刻的相机朝向计算得出。 VQ3D 提供一个物体名称，我们则返回所选实例的存储位置；UCS-Bench 的目标从问题中推断得出，条目则按词语重叠度和时间邻近性进行排序（附录 B.2、C 和 D）。

paragraphs.en: Answering. Retrieved labels, ranking signals, and segment histories (times, positions, and descriptions) are rendered as text, and a single call to Qwen3.5-9B [ 45 ] or GPT-5.4 [ 34 ] answers from this evidence, the question, and its options. HD-EPIC queries use the completed memory; for timestamped UCS-Bench queries, snapshots remove later observations and descriptions, truncate histories and the wearer path, and recompute positions. This filters what the answerer sees without making construction causal (Appendix D.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 回答。 检索到的标签、排名信号和片段历史（时间、位置和描述）以文本形式呈现，然后单次调用 Qwen3.5-9B [ 45 ] 或 GPT-5.4 [ 34 ]，基于这些证据、问题和选项给出答案。 HD-EPIC 查询使用已完成的记忆；对于带有时间戳的 UCS-Bench 查询，快照会移除后续的观察和描述，截断历史信息和佩戴者路径，并重新计算位置。 这过滤了回答者所见的内容，但并未使构建过程具有因果性（附录 D.3）。

paragraphs.en: We first show three memories answering on one stream; five research questions then connect benchmark results to interventions on the memory, and Appendix G.1 analyses failures by stage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先展示三个记忆在单一流程中的回答；随后，五个研究问题将基准测试结果与对记忆的干预措施联系起来，附录 G.1 则按阶段分析了失败情况。

paragraphs.en: We use all 2,400 3D Perception and Object Motion questions of HD-EPIC [ 35 ] with prototype-averaged accuracy (Appendix B.1 ); all 164 Ego4D VQ3D validation queries [ 17 ] , localized from the object’s name and scored over returned predictions alongside coverage; and 2,771 UCS-Bench questions [ 49 ] from 211 EgoLife and TeleEgo recordings, with estimated poses and memories filtered to the question time (Appendix D.1 ). Evidence conditions are a blind control (question and options only), memory alone, 48 frames sampled up to the question time, and frames plus memory on spatial questions. DirectMe, ReMEmbR, OSNOM, and AMEGO are rebuilt from released code with dataset adaptations and read by GPT-5.4 unless stated; RQ4 examines their retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了 HD-EPIC [ 35 ] 中全部 2,400 个 3D 感知与物体运动问题，采用原型平均准确率（附录 B.1）；全部 164 个 Ego4D VQ3D 验证查询 [ 17 ]，这些查询根据物体名称进行定位，并在返回的预测结果上结合覆盖度进行评分；以及来自 211 条 EgoLife 和 TeleEgo 记录的 2,771 个 UCS-Bench 问题 [ 49 ]，其估计姿态和记忆已过滤至问题发生的时间点（附录 D.1）。 证据条件包括：仅显示问题和选项的盲测控制组、仅使用记忆、截至问题时间点采样得到的 48 帧画面，以及在空间相关问题中同时使用画面和记忆。 除非另有说明，DirectMe、ReMEmbR、OSNOM 和 AMEGO 均基于已发布的代码重新构建，并进行了数据集适配，然后由 GPT-5.4 读取；RQ4 将检验它们的检索能力。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 follows DirectMe, ReMEmbR, and Ledger through one stream. Ledger is correct on all five questions, DirectMe’s graph on one, and ReMEmbR on none, and the difference follows from what each memory keeps. For Q2, the detector’s label is wrong, but the description stored with the object’s rest segment names what the wearer was holding, which the answerer follows; neither baseline stored the object. For Q5, Ledger returns the chair’s position, 0.73 m from the annotation, whereas ReMEmbR returns only where the wearer stood.

paragraphs.en: Object records help every answering model we tested, most on objects the wearer never touched and least on interactions and counts. On HD-EPIC, the memory lifts Qwen3.5-9B, GPT-5.4, and GPT-5.6 by 11 to 18 points over their blind controls and, read by GPT-5.4, outscores every rebuilt memory (Table 2 ; Figure 4 b); on UCS-Bench, it also improves the 48-frame reader it is added to (Table 3 ). The clearest benefit is fixture location, because admitting untouched objects supplies evidence that contact-gated memories exclude. The weakest cases need events and identities rather than more objects: AMEGO’s hand–object tracklets remain better on interaction counting and the onset of rest (Appendix B.4 ), and UCS-Bench object counts do not improve because association both splits single objects into several tracks and misses others (Appendix D.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 物体记录对我们测试的每个回答模型都有帮助，其中对佩戴者从未接触过的物体的帮助最大，而对互动和计数的帮助最小。 在 HD-EPIC 上，记忆机制使 Qwen3.5-9B、GPT-5.4 和 GPT-5.6 的性能相比其无记忆控制版本提升了 11 到 18 分；根据 GPT-5.4 的评估结果，它还优于所有重建的记忆模型（表 2；图 4b）；在 UCS-Bench 上，它同样提升了所添加的 48 帧读取器的性能（表 3）。 最明显的优势在于固定装置的位置，因为承认存在未接触过的物体，为那些以接触为条件的记忆模型提供了排除依据。 表现最弱的情况需要事件和身份识别，而非更多物体：AMEGO 的手–物体轨迹在互动计数和静止状态开始时的表现仍然更优（附录 B.4），而 UCS-Bench 的物体计数并未提升，因为关联机制既将单个物体拆分为多个轨迹，又遗漏了其他物体（附录 D.2）。

paragraphs.en: Requiring repeated evidence of a move, rather than raising the distance threshold, keeps localization noise from being counted as movement. A threshold alone cannot separate the two, because they overlap in size: half of the annotated moves are shorter than 0.8 m, and the 95th percentile of localization error is 0.84 m. A 0.3 m threshold therefore roughly doubles the counted moves, and 0.8 m gets only 57.3% of counts within ± 1 \pm 1 of the truth. Keeping 0.3 m but requiring three consecutive displaced observations raises this to 67.4% (Appendix B.8 ), and removing persistence costs movement counting 15.5 points, which survives correction for multiple tests (Figure 4 a). The price is that brief moves go unrecorded.
paragraphs.zh: 要求重复的证据来确认移动，而不是提高距离阈值，可以防止将定位噪声计为移动。 仅凭一个阈值无法区分两者，因为它们在尺寸上存在重叠：一半的标注移动长度小于 0.8 米，而定位误差的 95 百分位数为 0.84 米。 因此，0.3 米的阈值会使计数的移动数量大致翻倍，而 0.8 米的阈值则只有 57.3% 的计数落在真实值的 ±1 \pm 1 范围内。 保持 0.3 米的阈值，但要求连续三次观察到位置变化，可将这一比例提高到 67.4%（附录 B.8），而移除持续性要求会使移动计数减少 15.5 个点数，这一结果在考虑多次测试的校正后依然成立（图 4a）。 代价是短暂的移动将无法被记录。

paragraphs.en: Errors in the camera reference frame matter more for answering than errors in object coordinates. Direction answers depend on the camera’s heading, so estimated poses cost fixture-location questions 11 points, or 29 without gravity levelling (Appendix B.6 ). Refining object coordinates by triangulation, by contrast, adds only 2.2 points overall, less than persistence (5.5) or descriptions (4.9; Figure 4 a and Table 11 ). Coordinates are still what make metric localization possible: on VQ3D, our memory has the lowest error of the rebuilt memories on its returned predictions (Table 4 ). Even there, pose quality bounds the refinement: triangulation improves eligible predictions by about 0.1 m with scan-registered poses but only 0.03 m with feed-forward poses (Appendix C.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 相机参考系中的误差对回答问题的影响，比物体坐标中的误差更大。 方向答案取决于相机的朝向，因此估计的位姿在固定位置问题中会损失 11 分，若没有重力水平调整则会损失 29 分（附录 B.6）。 相比之下，通过三角测量优化物体坐标总共仅增加 2.2 分，低于持续性（5.5 分）或描述（4.9 分；图 4a 和表 11）。 坐标仍然是实现度量定位的关键：在 VQ3D 上，我们的记忆在其返回的预测结果中，重建后的记忆误差最低（表 4）。 即便如此，位姿的质量也限制了优化效果：使用扫描配准的位姿时，三角测量能将符合条件的预测结果提升约 0.1 米，而使用前馈位姿时仅能提升 0.03 米（附录 C.4）。

paragraphs.en: Which memory looks better depends on the reader, so comparisons must hold the reader fixed. We read our record with two readers: our single-shot reader (one call, about 2k input tokens) and ReMEmbR’s querying agent ( Ledger agent {}_{\text{agent}} ; three to four calls of 16–23k tokens; Appendix E.7 ). When the same agent reads both memories, our record beats ReMEmbR’s captions by 5.0 points on HD-EPIC ( p < 10 − 8 p<10^{-8} ) and by 26 points in VQ3D queries within 1 m, and is level on UCS-Bench (Tables 2 , 4 , and 32 ). ReMEmbR leads natively only on UCS-Bench (41.4 against 39.0), and the lead disappears in two steps: event lines on what the wearer did, the weakness found in RQ1, bring our record to 41.0 with our reader (Table 27 ), and the shared agent brings it to 42.1 (Appendix E.7 ), as on stitched streams (Figure 7 b). The agent is not the better reader everywhere: on HD-EPIC, where our reader grounds box-marked questions in 3D, it beats the agent on the same record by 7.8 points over all 2,400 questions (Table 2 ) at a thirteenth of the tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 哪种记忆看起来更好取决于读者，因此比较时必须保持读者不变。 我们用两种读者来读取我们的记录：我们的单次读取器（一次调用，约 2k 输入词元）和 ReMEmbR 的查询智能体（Ledger 智能体 {}_{\text{agent}}；三次到四次调用，每次 16–23k 词元；附录 E.7）。 当同一智能体读取两种记忆时，我们的记录在 HD-EPIC 上比 ReMEmbR 的说明高出 5.0 分（p < 10^{-8}），在 1 米范围内的 VQ3D 查询中高出 26 分，并且在 UCS-Bench 上表现相当（表 2、4 和 32）。 ReMEmbR 仅在 UCS-Bench 上具有原生优势（41.4 对比 39.0），但这种优势在两个步骤中消失：穿戴者行为的事件行——这是 RQ1 中发现的弱点——使我们的记录在使用我们的读取器时达到 41.0（表 27），而共享智能体则使其达到 42.1（附录 E.7），正如在拼接流中的表现一样（图 7b）。 该智能体并非在所有情况下都是更好的读取器：在 HD-EPIC 上，我们的读取器能将带有方框标记的问题定位到三维空间中，它在同一记录上比该智能体高出 7.8 分（涵盖全部 2,400 个问题）（表 2），且使用的词元仅为后者的十三分之一。

paragraphs.en: Longer recordings do not erode the memory’s advantage, but changes of scene do. Over length, the memory stays 10 to 18 points above the blind control in every HD-EPIC bin up to 75 minutes, while no rebuilt memory gains more than 5; on UCS-Bench, the 48-frame reader loses accuracy as recordings grow and the memory does not (Figure 5 ; Appendix F ). Across scenes, 100 paired stitched streams show that returning to the same scene costs the memory little, whereas a change of scene brings it to the blind level (Table 27 ). The loss arises in both stages, because each assumes one scene: retrieval shows records and histories from other scenes, and construction drops labels that cannot belong to one place while its pose gate rejects the whole stream at the seam. Fixing either stage recovers part of the loss. Limiting retrieved records and histories to the current scene recovers 3.0 points with true boundaries, and building the memory per detected scene recovers about half in emulation (Appendices E.3 and E.4 ). The fixes are not additive, and these streams also change the camera, wearer, and clip length.
paragraphs.zh: 更长的记录并不会削弱记忆的优势，但场景的变化却会。 在较长的时间跨度内，在所有 HD-EPIC 分箱中，直到 75 分钟为止，记忆的表现始终比盲控高出 10 到 18 分，而任何重建的记忆得分都不会超过 5；在 UCS-Bench 上，随着记录时间的增长，48 帧读取器的准确性会下降，而记忆则不会（图 5；附录 F）。 跨不同场景来看，100 对拼接流表明，回到同一场景对记忆几乎没有影响，而场景的变化则会使其表现降至盲控水平（表 27）。 这种损失发生在两个阶段，因为每个阶段都假设只有一个场景：检索阶段会显示来自其他场景的记录和历史，而构建阶段则会丢失那些不可能属于单一位置的标签，同时其姿态门会在接缝处拒绝整个流。 修复任一阶段都能恢复部分损失。 将检索到的记录和历史限制在当前场景内，使用真实边界时能恢复 3.0 分，而在模拟环境中，按每个检测到的场景构建记忆则能恢复约一半（附录 E.3 和 E.4）。 这些修复措施并非可叠加的，并且这些流还会改变摄像头、佩戴者以及片段长度。

sents.en: Longer recordings do not erode the memory’s advantage, but changes of scene do.
sents.zh: 更长的记录并不会削弱记忆的优势，但场景的变化却会。

sents.en: Over length, the memory stays 10 to 18 points above the blind control in every HD-EPIC bin up to 75 minutes, while no rebuilt memory gains more than 5; on UCS-Bench, the 48-frame reader loses accuracy as recordings grow and the memory does not (Figure 5 ; Appendix F ).
sents.zh: 在较长的时间跨度内，在所有 HD-EPIC 分箱中，直到 75 分钟为止，记忆的表现始终比盲控高出 10 到 18 分，而任何重建的记忆得分都不会超过 5；在 UCS-Bench 上，随着记录时间的增长，48 帧读取器的准确性会下降，而记忆则不会（图 5；附录 F）。

sents.en: Across scenes, 100 paired stitched streams show that returning to the same scene costs the memory little, whereas a change of scene brings it to the blind level (Table 27 ).
sents.zh: 跨不同场景来看，100 对拼接流表明，回到同一场景对记忆几乎没有影响，而场景的变化则会使其表现降至盲控水平（表 27）。

sents.en: The loss arises in both stages, because each assumes one scene: retrieval shows records and histories from other scenes, and construction drops labels that cannot belong to one place while its pose gate rejects the whole stream at the seam.
sents.zh: 这种损失发生在两个阶段，因为每个阶段都假设只有一个场景：检索阶段会显示来自其他场景的记录和历史，而构建阶段则会丢失那些不可能属于单一位置的标签，同时其姿态门会在接缝处拒绝整个流。

sents.en: Fixing either stage recovers part of the loss.
sents.zh: 修复任一阶段都能恢复部分损失。

sents.en: Limiting retrieved records and histories to the current scene recovers 3.0 points with true boundaries, and building the memory per detected scene recovers about half in emulation (Appendices E.3 and E.4 ).
sents.zh: 将检索到的记录和历史限制在当前场景内，使用真实边界时能恢复 3.0 分，而在模拟环境中，按每个检测到的场景构建记忆则能恢复约一半（附录 E.3 和 E.4）。

sents.en: The fixes are not additive, and these streams also change the camera, wearer, and clip length.
sents.zh: 这些修复措施并非可叠加的，并且这些流还会改变摄像头、佩戴者以及片段长度。

paragraphs.en: Ledger makes past object observations reusable for spatial answering and localization. Admitting untouched objects answers fixture questions, and persistence and contextual descriptions contribute more than coordinate refinement; missing event evidence and fragmented identities limit interaction and counting. Comparisons between memories depend on the reader, and scene changes break both retrieval and construction, which per-scene construction partly repairs. Evaluations should measure answerable evidence alongside localization, and should state retrieval budgets and scene boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: Ledger 使过去的对象观察结果能够被重新利用，以支持空间回答和定位。 承认未受干扰的对象可以回答固定问题，而持久性和上下文描述所贡献的价值超过了坐标精度的提升；缺失的事件证据和碎片化的身份会限制交互与计数。 记忆之间的比较取决于阅读者，场景变化会破坏信息的检索与构建，而按场景进行的构建能在一定程度上修复这一问题。 评估应同时衡量可回答的证据与定位能力，并明确说明检索预算和场景边界。

sents.en: Ledger makes past object observations reusable for spatial answering and localization.
sents.zh: Ledger 使过去的对象观察结果能够被重新利用，以支持空间回答和定位。

sents.en: Admitting untouched objects answers fixture questions, and persistence and contextual descriptions contribute more than coordinate refinement; missing event evidence and fragmented identities limit interaction and counting.
sents.zh: 承认未受干扰的对象可以回答固定问题，而持久性和上下文描述所贡献的价值超过了坐标精度的提升；缺失的事件证据和碎片化的身份会限制交互与计数。

sents.zh: 记忆之间的比较取决于阅读者，场景变化会破坏信息的检索与构建，而按场景进行的构建能在一定程度上修复这一问题。

sents.en: Evaluations should measure answerable evidence alongside localization, and should state retrieval budgets and scene boundaries.
sents.zh: 评估应同时衡量可回答的证据与定位能力，并明确说明检索预算和场景边界。

paragraphs.en: The scope remains limited. Recent frame readers outperform memory-only answering on HD-EPIC, and frames alone outperform memory alone on UCS-Bench, although adding the memory to the frames improves them. Counting and continuous rest intervals remain unresolved, and construction does not yet scale to the most object-dense hour-long recordings (Appendix D ). HD-EPIC uses calibrated poses; VQ3D is queried by name rather than crop, and most UCS-Bench memories lack metric scale. On HD-EPIC, the segmentation and retrieval rules, triangulation thresholds, and fixture synonym groups were developed on calibration videos kept separate from evaluation (Appendix B.9 ). Construction is offline, so filtering records by question time does not establish causal online memory.
paragraphs.zh: 范围仍然有限。 近期的帧读取器在 HD-EPIC 上的表现优于仅依赖记忆的回答方式，而单独的帧在 UCS-Bench 上的表现也优于单独的记忆，尽管将记忆与帧结合使用能进一步提升性能。 计数和连续休息间隔的问题仍未解决，且构建方法尚无法扩展到物体密度最高的持续一小时的视频记录（附录 D）。 HD-EPIC 使用了经过校准的姿态；VQ3D 是通过名称而非裁剪区域进行查询的，而大多数 UCS-Bench 的记忆数据缺乏度量尺度。 在 HD-EPIC 上，分割与检索规则、三角测量阈值以及配件同义词组均基于与评估过程分离的校准视频开发而成（附录 B.9）。 构建过程是离线的，因此通过问题时间筛选记录并不能建立因果关联的在线记忆。

sents.zh: 范围仍然有限。

paragraphs.en: We sample one frame every four seconds, up to 1,200 frames per recording. Qwen3.5-9B names the visible objects. We merge synonymous names into a vocabulary of at most 80 labels per recording. On UCS-Bench, this step uses at most 80 frames (Appendix D ). YOLO-World [ 9 ] then detects objects matching these labels. We also evaluate SAM 3 [ 5 ] as an alternative detector on VQ3D. Which objects enter memory depends on the vocabulary, the detector’s confidence threshold, and the number of detections we can lift into 3D. Dataset-specific resolutions, thresholds, and budgets are listed in Appendices B.2 , C , and D .
paragraphs.zh: 我们每四秒采样一帧，每次录制最多可采集 1,200 帧。 Qwen3.5-9B 会命名可见的物体。 我们将同义名称合并，使每次录制的标签总数最多不超过 80 个。 在 UCS-Bench 上，此步骤最多使用 80 帧（附录 D）。 随后，YOLO-World [9] 会检测与这些标签匹配的物体。 我们还在 VQ3D 上评估了 SAM 3 [5]，作为另一种替代检测器。 哪些物体会被存入记忆取决于词汇表、检测器的置信度阈值，以及我们能够提升至三维的检测数量。 数据集特定的分辨率、阈值和预算列于附录 B.2、C 和 D 中。

sents.en: We sample one frame every four seconds, up to 1,200 frames per recording.
sents.zh: 我们每四秒采样一帧，每次录制最多可采集 1,200 帧。

sents.en: Qwen3.5-9B names the visible objects.
sents.zh: Qwen3.5-9B 会命名可见的物体。

sents.en: We merge synonymous names into a vocabulary of at most 80 labels per recording.
sents.zh: 我们将同义名称合并，使每次录制的标签总数最多不超过 80 个。

sents.en: On UCS-Bench, this step uses at most 80 frames (Appendix D ).
sents.zh: 在 UCS-Bench 上，此步骤最多使用 80 帧（附录 D）。

sents.en: YOLO-World [ 9 ] then detects objects matching these labels.
sents.zh: 随后，YOLO-World [9] 会检测与这些标签匹配的物体。

sents.en: We also evaluate SAM 3 [ 5 ] as an alternative detector on VQ3D.
sents.zh: 我们还在 VQ3D 上评估了 SAM 3 [5]，作为另一种替代检测器。

sents.en: Which objects enter memory depends on the vocabulary, the detector’s confidence threshold, and the number of detections we can lift into 3D.
sents.zh: 哪些物体会被存入记忆取决于词汇表、检测器的置信度阈值，以及我们能够提升至三维的检测数量。

sents.en: Dataset-specific resolutions, thresholds, and budgets are listed in Appendices B.2 , C , and D .
sents.zh: 数据集特定的分辨率、阈值和预算列于附录 B.2、C 和 D 中。

paragraphs.en: We use calibrated device trajectories on HD-EPIC and registered EgoLoc poses on VQ3D. To estimate poses, we use FastVGGT [ 41 ] , a training-free acceleration of VGGT [ 47 ] . It processes 96-frame chunks with 16 overlapping frames. We align adjacent chunks using a Sim(3) transformation estimated from their shared frames.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 HD-EPIC 上使用经过校准的设备轨迹，并在 VQ3D 上使用已配准的 EgoLoc 姿态。 为了估计姿态，我们使用 FastVGGT [ 41 ]，这是 VGGT [ 47 ] 的一种无需训练的加速版本。 它以包含 16 个重叠帧的 96 帧片段为单位进行处理。 我们通过利用其共享帧估计出的 Sim(3) 变换来对齐相邻的片段。

sents.en: We use calibrated device trajectories on HD-EPIC and registered EgoLoc poses on VQ3D.
sents.zh: 我们在 HD-EPIC 上使用经过校准的设备轨迹，并在 VQ3D 上使用已配准的 EgoLoc 姿态。

sents.en: To estimate poses, we use FastVGGT [ 41 ] , a training-free acceleration of VGGT [ 47 ] .
sents.zh: 为了估计姿态，我们使用 FastVGGT [ 41 ]，这是 VGGT [ 47 ] 的一种无需训练的加速版本。

sents.en: It processes 96-frame chunks with 16 overlapping frames.
sents.zh: 它以包含 16 个重叠帧的 96 帧片段为单位进行处理。

sents.en: We align adjacent chunks using a Sim(3) transformation estimated from their shared frames.
sents.zh: 我们通过利用其共享帧估计出的 Sim(3) 变换来对齐相邻的片段。

paragraphs.en: These estimated poses have arbitrary scale. To recover metric scale, the pipeline compares pairs of observations of the same static object with their predicted metric positions in camera coordinates. This step fails for most UCS-Bench recordings and all TeleEgo recordings. Distances in those memories are therefore expressed in scene units (Appendix D.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这些估计出的位姿具有任意的尺度。 为了恢复度量尺度，该流程会将同一静态物体的观测对与其在相机坐标系中预测的度量位置进行比较。 对于大多数 UCS-Bench 录像和所有 TeleEgo 录像，此步骤都会失败。 因此，这些记忆中的距离以场景单位表示（附录 D.1）。

sents.en: These estimated poses have arbitrary scale.
sents.zh: 这些估计出的位姿具有任意的尺度。

sents.en: To recover metric scale, the pipeline compares pairs of observations of the same static object with their predicted metric positions in camera coordinates.
sents.zh: 为了恢复度量尺度，该流程会将同一静态物体的观测对与其在相机坐标系中预测的度量位置进行比较。

sents.en: This step fails for most UCS-Bench recordings and all TeleEgo recordings.
sents.zh: 对于大多数 UCS-Bench 录像和所有 TeleEgo 录像，此步骤都会失败。

sents.en: Distances in those memories are therefore expressed in scene units (Appendix D.1 ).
sents.zh: 因此，这些记忆中的距离以场景单位表示（附录 D.1）。

paragraphs.en: On UCS-Bench, we first try Depth Anything 3 [ 27 ] , except for circular-fisheye recordings. It processes 48-frame chunks with 12 overlapping frames. We keep its poses only if they pass three consistency checks: the chunk-alignment residual is at most 0.5 m, chunk scales lie within [ 0.8 , 1.25 ] [0.8,1.25] , and the camera moves no more than 6 m between sampled frames. Otherwise, we fall back to FastVGGT. If FastVGGT cannot align a chunk with the preceding one, it starts from a new anchor (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 UCS-Bench 上，我们首先尝试使用 Depth Anything 3 [ 27 ]，但圆形鱼眼录制除外。 它以包含 12 个重叠帧的 48 帧片段为单位进行处理。 只有当其姿态通过三项一致性检查时，我们才会保留这些姿态：片段对齐残差最多为 0.5 米，片段缩放系数位于 [ 0.8 , 1.25 ] [0.8,1.25] 范围内，且采样帧之间的相机移动距离不超过 6 米。 否则，我们将转而使用 FastVGGT。 如果 FastVGGT 无法将某个片段与前一个片段对齐，它则会从一个新的锚点开始（附录 D）。

sents.en: On UCS-Bench, we first try Depth Anything 3 [ 27 ] , except for circular-fisheye recordings.
sents.zh: 在 UCS-Bench 上，我们首先尝试使用 Depth Anything 3 [ 27 ]，但圆形鱼眼录制除外。

sents.en: It processes 48-frame chunks with 12 overlapping frames.
sents.zh: 它以包含 12 个重叠帧的 48 帧片段为单位进行处理。

sents.en: We keep its poses only if they pass three consistency checks: the chunk-alignment residual is at most 0.5 m, chunk scales lie within [ 0.8 , 1.25 ] [0.8,1.25] , and the camera moves no more than 6 m between sampled frames.
sents.zh: 只有当其姿态通过三项一致性检查时，我们才会保留这些姿态：片段对齐残差最多为 0.5 米，片段缩放系数位于 [ 0.8 , 1.25 ] [0.8,1.25] 范围内，且采样帧之间的相机移动距离不超过 6 米。

sents.en: Otherwise, we fall back to FastVGGT.
sents.zh: 否则，我们将转而使用 FastVGGT。

sents.en: If FastVGGT cannot align a chunk with the preceding one, it starts from a new anchor (Appendix D ).
sents.zh: 如果 FastVGGT 无法将某个片段与前一个片段对齐，它则会从一个新的锚点开始（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: Given an image, a 2D box, and an object label, WildDet3D [ 22 ] predicts a metric 3D box in camera coordinates. We use its centre as the object’s position. This avoids selecting pixels from a dense depth map, where object and background surfaces can be mixed. Although the predicted box is metric, its position in scene coordinates is only metric if the camera poses also have a known scale.
paragraphs.zh: 给定一张图像、一个二维框和一个物体标签，WildDet3D [ 22 ] 会预测一个以相机坐标为基准的度量三维框。 我们将其中心点作为物体的位置。 这样可以避免从密集的深度图中选择像素，因为其中物体和背景的表面可能会相互混合。 尽管预测的框是度量的，但它在场景坐标中的位置只有在相机姿态也具有已知尺度时才是度量的。

sents.en: Given an image, a 2D box, and an object label, WildDet3D [ 22 ] predicts a metric 3D box in camera coordinates.
sents.zh: 给定一张图像、一个二维框和一个物体标签，WildDet3D [ 22 ] 会预测一个以相机坐标为基准的度量三维框。

sents.en: We use its centre as the object’s position.
sents.zh: 我们将其中心点作为物体的位置。

sents.en: This avoids selecting pixels from a dense depth map, where object and background surfaces can be mixed.
sents.zh: 这样可以避免从密集的深度图中选择像素，因为其中物体和背景的表面可能会相互混合。

sents.en: Although the predicted box is metric, its position in scene coordinates is only metric if the camera poses also have a known scale.
sents.zh: 尽管预测的框是度量的，但它在场景坐标中的位置只有在相机姿态也具有已知尺度时才是度量的。

paragraphs.en: In the earlier HD-EPIC analysis, the median localization error was 0.39 m, with a median along-ray component of 0.37 m (Appendix B.7 ). This motivates using multiple views with known camera poses to refine object positions.
paragraphs.zh: 在早期的 HD-EPIC 分析中，定位误差的中位数为 0.39 米，沿射线方向分量的中位数为 0.37 米（附录 B.7）。 这促使我们使用具有已知相机姿态的多视角图像来优化物体位置。

sents.en: In the earlier HD-EPIC analysis, the median localization error was 0.39 m, with a median along-ray component of 0.37 m (Appendix B.7 ).
sents.zh: 在早期的 HD-EPIC 分析中，定位误差的中位数为 0.39 米，沿射线方向分量的中位数为 0.37 米（附录 B.7）。

sents.en: This motivates using multiple views with known camera poses to refine object positions.
sents.zh: 这促使我们使用具有已知相机姿态的多视角图像来优化物体位置。

paragraphs.en: On the UCS-Bench pilot, two Depth Anything 3 reconstructions were rejected. Their chunk scale ratios were 1.16 and 1.58, and their alignment residuals at chunk boundaries were 0.67 and 7.10 m, respectively. We fall back to FastVGGT, which also handles fisheye recordings but does not provide metric scale on its own.
paragraphs.zh: 在 UCS-Bench 试点测试中，有两个 Depth Anything 3 的重建结果被拒绝。 它们的块尺度比分别为 1.16 和 1.58，块边界处的对齐残差也分别为 0.67 米和 7.10 米。 我们转而使用 FastVGGT，它也能处理鱼眼图像记录，但本身不提供度量尺度信息。

sents.en: On the UCS-Bench pilot, two Depth Anything 3 reconstructions were rejected.
sents.zh: 在 UCS-Bench 试点测试中，有两个 Depth Anything 3 的重建结果被拒绝。

sents.en: Their chunk scale ratios were 1.16 and 1.58, and their alignment residuals at chunk boundaries were 0.67 and 7.10 m, respectively.
sents.zh: 它们的块尺度比分别为 1.16 和 1.58，块边界处的对齐残差也分别为 0.67 米和 7.10 米。

sents.en: We fall back to FastVGGT, which also handles fisheye recordings but does not provide metric scale on its own.
sents.zh: 我们转而使用 FastVGGT，它也能处理鱼眼图像记录，但本身不提供度量尺度信息。

paragraphs.en: We compare both pose estimators on the same frames from all 44 VQ3D clips (Appendix C ). After aligning each trajectory to EgoLoc camera centres with one Sim(3) transformation per clip, their median position errors are similar: 9.1 cm for Depth Anything 3 and 9.2 cm for FastVGGT. Median orientation errors are 5.5 ∘ and 5.9 ∘ , respectively. However, Depth Anything 3 fails to join its chunks into a single trajectory on 11 clips. Object localization also shows no clear difference: median paired differences range from − 0.03 -0.03 to + 0.02 +0.02 m across detectors and memory variants, with every interval including zero. These results support using FastVGGT as the fallback when poses are unavailable, although both estimators still require metric scale recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在全部 44 个 VQ3D 剪辑（附录 C）的相同帧上对两种姿态估计器进行了比较。 将每条轨迹通过每个剪辑一次 Sim(3) 变换与 EgoLoc 相机中心对齐后，它们的中位数位置误差相近：Depth Anything 3 为 9.1 厘米，FastVGGT 为 9.2 厘米。 中位数方向误差分别为 5.5° 和 5.9°。 然而，在 11 个剪辑中，Depth Anything 3 未能将其片段合并为单条轨迹。 物体定位也未表现出明显差异：在不同检测器和内存变体之间，成对差异的中位数范围从 −0.03 至 −0.03 米到 +0.02 至 +0.02 米，且每个区间都包含零。 这些结果支持在姿态不可用时使用 FastVGGT 作为备用方案，尽管两种估计器仍然需要恢复度量尺度。

sents.en: We compare both pose estimators on the same frames from all 44 VQ3D clips (Appendix C ).
sents.zh: 我们在全部 44 个 VQ3D 剪辑（附录 C）的相同帧上对两种姿态估计器进行了比较。

sents.en: After aligning each trajectory to EgoLoc camera centres with one Sim(3) transformation per clip, their median position errors are similar: 9.1 cm for Depth Anything 3 and 9.2 cm for FastVGGT.
sents.zh: 将每条轨迹通过每个剪辑一次 Sim(3) 变换与 EgoLoc 相机中心对齐后，它们的中位数位置误差相近：Depth Anything 3 为 9.1 厘米，FastVGGT 为 9.2 厘米。

sents.en: Median orientation errors are 5.5 ∘ and 5.9 ∘ , respectively.
sents.zh: 中位数方向误差分别为 5.5° 和 5.9°。

sents.en: However, Depth Anything 3 fails to join its chunks into a single trajectory on 11 clips.
sents.zh: 然而，在 11 个剪辑中，Depth Anything 3 未能将其片段合并为单条轨迹。

sents.en: Object localization also shows no clear difference: median paired differences range from − 0.03 -0.03 to + 0.02 +0.02 m across detectors and memory variants, with every interval including zero.
sents.zh: 物体定位也未表现出明显差异：在不同检测器和内存变体之间，成对差异的中位数范围从 −0.03 至 −0.03 米到 +0.02 至 +0.02 米，且每个区间都包含零。

sents.en: These results support using FastVGGT as the fallback when poses are unavailable, although both estimators still require metric scale recovery.
sents.zh: 这些结果支持在姿态不可用时使用 FastVGGT 作为备用方案，尽管两种估计器仍然需要恢复度量尺度。

paragraphs.en: Trajectory memory clusters observations in 3D, associating them chronologically by label and proximity to an instance’s most recent position. Detections in the same frame remain separate unless they are overlapping duplicates. A second pass, called consolidation, reconnects tracks that may belong to the same object. It groups tracks with synonymous labels, uses the SAM 3 video tracker [ 5 ] to propagate their masks across frames, and merges tracks whose propagated masks agree. Co-occurrence and 3D-distance checks block incompatible merges.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹记忆将观测数据以三维形式聚类，通过标签和实例最近位置的距离按时间顺序将其关联起来。 同一帧中的检测结果保持独立，除非它们是重叠的重复项。 第二个步骤称为整合，它会重新连接可能属于同一物体的轨迹。 该步骤会将具有同义标签的轨迹分组，使用 SAM 3 视频追踪器 [5] 在其各帧间传播掩码，并合并那些传播后的掩码一致的轨迹。 共现性和三维距离检查会阻止不兼容的合并操作。

sents.en: Trajectory memory clusters observations in 3D, associating them chronologically by label and proximity to an instance’s most recent position.
sents.zh: 轨迹记忆将观测数据以三维形式聚类，通过标签和实例最近位置的距离按时间顺序将其关联起来。

sents.en: Detections in the same frame remain separate unless they are overlapping duplicates.
sents.zh: 同一帧中的检测结果保持独立，除非它们是重叠的重复项。

sents.en: A second pass, called consolidation, reconnects tracks that may belong to the same object.
sents.zh: 第二个步骤称为整合，它会重新连接可能属于同一物体的轨迹。

sents.en: It groups tracks with synonymous labels, uses the SAM 3 video tracker [ 5 ] to propagate their masks across frames, and merges tracks whose propagated masks agree.
sents.zh: 该步骤会将具有同义标签的轨迹分组，使用 SAM 3 视频追踪器 [5] 在其各帧间传播掩码，并合并那些传播后的掩码一致的轨迹。

sents.en: Co-occurrence and 3D-distance checks block incompatible merges.
sents.zh: 共现性和三维距离检查会阻止不兼容的合并操作。

paragraphs.en: We use consolidation on HD-EPIC and UCS-Bench. On VQ3D, we compare raw, trajectory, and consolidated memories, using a trajectory association radius of 1.0 m and a consolidation mask-IoU threshold of 0.3. On UCS-Bench, merges are blocked beyond a 3D distance of 1.0, measured in scene units when metric scale is unavailable (Appendix D.2 ). Even with consolidation, an object may receive a new identity after a long absence or a large move.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 HD-EPIC 和 UCS-Bench 上使用了巩固机制。 在 VQ3D 上，我们比较了原始记忆、轨迹记忆和巩固后的记忆，其中轨迹关联半径为 1.0 米，巩固掩码 IoU 阈值为 0.3。 在 UCS-Bench 上，当场景单位不可用时（见附录 D.2），合并操作会在超过 1.0 的三维距离后被阻止。 即使使用了巩固机制，一个物体在长时间消失或发生大幅移动后，仍可能获得一个新的身份标识。

sents.en: We use consolidation on HD-EPIC and UCS-Bench.
sents.zh: 我们在 HD-EPIC 和 UCS-Bench 上使用了巩固机制。

sents.en: On VQ3D, we compare raw, trajectory, and consolidated memories, using a trajectory association radius of 1.0 m and a consolidation mask-IoU threshold of 0.3.
sents.zh: 在 VQ3D 上，我们比较了原始记忆、轨迹记忆和巩固后的记忆，其中轨迹关联半径为 1.0 米，巩固掩码 IoU 阈值为 0.3。

sents.en: On UCS-Bench, merges are blocked beyond a 3D distance of 1.0, measured in scene units when metric scale is unavailable (Appendix D.2 ).
sents.zh: 在 UCS-Bench 上，当场景单位不可用时（见附录 D.2），合并操作会在超过 1.0 的三维距离后被阻止。

sents.en: Even with consolidation, an object may receive a new identity after a long absence or a large move.
sents.zh: 即使使用了巩固机制，一个物体在长时间消失或发生大幅移动后，仍可能获得一个新的身份标识。

paragraphs.en: Distance-threshold segmentation starts a new segment as soon as an observation lies more than τ \tau from the current resting position. Our persistence rule waits until k k successive observations of the object lie outside this radius before confirming a new segment. If observations return within the radius before confirmation, they remain in the current segment.
paragraphs.zh: 距离阈值分割法一旦观察到观测点与当前静止位置的距离超过 τ，就会开始一个新的分段。 我们的持续规则会等待连续 k 次对物体的观测都位于该半径之外，才会确认一个新的分段。 如果在确认之前，观测点重新回到该半径范围内，它们仍属于当前的分段。

sents.en: Distance-threshold segmentation starts a new segment as soon as an observation lies more than τ \tau from the current resting position.
sents.zh: 距离阈值分割法一旦观察到观测点与当前静止位置的距离超过 τ，就会开始一个新的分段。

sents.en: Our persistence rule waits until k k successive observations of the object lie outside this radius before confirming a new segment.
sents.zh: 我们的持续规则会等待连续 k 次对物体的观测都位于该半径之外，才会确认一个新的分段。

sents.en: If observations return within the radius before confirmation, they remain in the current segment.
sents.zh: 如果在确认之前，观测点重新回到该半径范围内，它们仍属于当前的分段。

paragraphs.en: On HD-EPIC, we use τ = 0.3 \tau=0.3 m and k = 3 k=3 . We use the same values on UCS-Bench, but measure the radius in scene units when metric scale is unavailable. Appendix B.8 compares the two rules.
paragraphs.zh: 在 HD-EPIC 中，我们使用 τ = 0.3 \tau=0.3 m 和 k = 3 k=3 。 我们在 UCS-Bench 中使用相同的数值，但在无法获取度量比例时，以场景单位为半径进行测量。 附录 B.8 对这两种规则进行了比较。

sents.en: On HD-EPIC, we use τ = 0.3 \tau=0.3 m and k = 3 k=3 .
sents.zh: 在 HD-EPIC 中，我们使用 τ = 0.3 \tau=0.3 m 和 k = 3 k=3 。

sents.en: We use the same values on UCS-Bench, but measure the radius in scene units when metric scale is unavailable.
sents.zh: 我们在 UCS-Bench 中使用相同的数值，但在无法获取度量比例时，以场景单位为半径进行测量。

sents.en: Appendix B.8 compares the two rules.
sents.zh: 附录 B.8 对这两种规则进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: For up to six segments per object, Qwen3.5-9B describes a representative frame with the object outlined. These descriptions record details such as the object’s contents, its supporting surface, and interactions that positions alone do not capture.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个对象最多六个片段，Qwen3.5-9B 会用轮廓勾勒出该对象的代表性帧。 这些描述记录了诸如对象内容、其支撑表面以及仅凭位置无法捕捉到的交互等细节。

sents.en: For up to six segments per object, Qwen3.5-9B describes a representative frame with the object outlined.
sents.zh: 对于每个对象最多六个片段，Qwen3.5-9B 会用轮廓勾勒出该对象的代表性帧。

sents.en: These descriptions record details such as the object’s contents, its supporting surface, and interactions that positions alone do not capture.
sents.zh: 这些描述记录了诸如对象内容、其支撑表面以及仅凭位置无法捕捉到的交互等细节。

paragraphs.en: In the reported HD-EPIC runs, we first generated descriptions for distance-threshold segments. Each persistence segment then inherited the description of the segment with the greatest temporal overlap. The persistence ablation therefore also changes which descriptions appear in the records; it does not keep all textual evidence fixed (Appendix B.2 ). The additional activity descriptions for sampled frames in the UCS-Bench extensions are detailed in Appendix E.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 在报告的 HD-EPIC 运行中，我们首先为距离阈值段生成了描述。 随后，每个持续性段继承了具有最大时间重叠度的段的描述。 因此，持续性消融也会改变记录中出现的描述；它并不会保持所有文本证据不变（附录 B.2）。 UCS-Bench 扩展中采样帧的额外活动描述详见附录 E.5。

sents.en: In the reported HD-EPIC runs, we first generated descriptions for distance-threshold segments.
sents.zh: 在报告的 HD-EPIC 运行中，我们首先为距离阈值段生成了描述。

sents.en: Each persistence segment then inherited the description of the segment with the greatest temporal overlap.
sents.zh: 随后，每个持续性段继承了具有最大时间重叠度的段的描述。

sents.en: The persistence ablation therefore also changes which descriptions appear in the records; it does not keep all textual evidence fixed (Appendix B.2 ).
sents.zh: 因此，持续性消融也会改变记录中出现的描述；它并不会保持所有文本证据不变（附录 B.2）。

sents.en: The additional activity descriptions for sampled frames in the UCS-Bench extensions are detailed in Appendix E.5 .
sents.zh: UCS-Bench 扩展中采样帧的额外活动描述详见附录 E.5。

paragraphs.en: Observing a resting object from several viewpoints helps constrain its 3D position. Each detected box centre defines a viewing ray from the camera. Given camera centres 𝐜 i \mathbf{c}_{i} and unit ray directions 𝐝 i \mathbf{d}_{i} , we estimate the point that minimizes the sum of squared distances to these rays:
paragraphs.zh: 从多个视角观察静止物体有助于约束其三维位置。 每个检测到的框中心都定义了一条从摄像头发出的视线射线。 给定摄像头中心 𝐜 i \mathbf{c}_{i} 和单位射线方向 𝐝 i \mathbf{d}_{i}，我们估计使到这些射线的距离平方和最小的点：

sents.en: Observing a resting object from several viewpoints helps constrain its 3D position.
sents.zh: 从多个视角观察静止物体有助于约束其三维位置。

sents.en: Each detected box centre defines a viewing ray from the camera.
sents.zh: 每个检测到的框中心都定义了一条从摄像头发出的视线射线。

sents.en: Given camera centres 𝐜 i \mathbf{c}_{i} and unit ray directions 𝐝 i \mathbf{d}_{i} , we estimate the point that minimizes the sum of squared distances to these rays:
sents.zh: 给定摄像头中心 𝐜 i \mathbf{c}_{i} 和单位射线方向 𝐝 i \mathbf{d}_{i}，我们估计使到这些射线的距离平方和最小的点：

paragraphs.en: We accept this estimate only when the camera positions are sufficiently separated, the ray geometry supports a stable solution, and the estimate stays close to the monocular prediction. On HD-EPIC, we require at least three rays, a camera baseline of at least 0.10 m, a minimum eigenvalue of 0.25 for ∑ i 𝐏 i \sum_{i}\mathbf{P}_{i} , and a shift of no more than 2.0 m from the monocular prediction (Table 7 ). The localization analysis and question-answering ablation are reported in Appendices B.7 and B.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 只有当相机位置充分分离、射线几何结构支持稳定的解，且该估计值与单目预测保持接近时，我们才会接受这一估计。 在 HD-EPIC 上，我们要求至少有三条射线、至少 0.10 米的相机基线、∑ i 𝐏 i \sum_{i}\mathbf{P}_{i} 的最小特征值为 0.25，以及与单目预测的偏移不超过 2.0 米（表 7）。 定位分析和问答消融研究分别报告在附录 B.7 和 B.5 中。

sents.en: We accept this estimate only when the camera positions are sufficiently separated, the ray geometry supports a stable solution, and the estimate stays close to the monocular prediction.
sents.zh: 只有当相机位置充分分离、射线几何结构支持稳定的解，且该估计值与单目预测保持接近时，我们才会接受这一估计。

sents.en: On HD-EPIC, we require at least three rays, a camera baseline of at least 0.10 m, a minimum eigenvalue of 0.25 for ∑ i 𝐏 i \sum_{i}\mathbf{P}_{i} , and a shift of no more than 2.0 m from the monocular prediction (Table 7 ).
sents.zh: 在 HD-EPIC 上，我们要求至少有三条射线、至少 0.10 米的相机基线、∑ i 𝐏 i \sum_{i}\mathbf{P}_{i} 的最小特征值为 0.25，以及与单目预测的偏移不超过 2.0 米（表 7）。

sents.en: The localization analysis and question-answering ablation are reported in Appendices B.7 and B.5 .
sents.zh: 定位分析和问答消融研究分别报告在附录 B.7 和 B.5 中。

paragraphs.en: HD-EPIC contains 26,550 five-way multiple-choice questions across 30 prototypes and seven categories. We evaluate all questions in 3D Perception and Object Motion, covering 150 videos (Table 5 ; Figure 6 ). These questions have no official training, validation, or test split.
paragraphs.zh: HD-EPIC 包含 26,550 道五选一的选择题，涵盖 30 个原型和七个类别。 我们在三维感知与物体运动方面对所有问题进行了评估，涉及 150 段视频（表 5；图 6）。 这些问题没有官方的训练、验证或测试划分。

sents.en: HD-EPIC contains 26,550 five-way multiple-choice questions across 30 prototypes and seven categories.
sents.zh: HD-EPIC 包含 26,550 道五选一的选择题，涵盖 30 个原型和七个类别。

sents.en: We evaluate all questions in 3D Perception and Object Motion, covering 150 videos (Table 5 ; Figure 6 ).
sents.zh: 我们在三维感知与物体运动方面对所有问题进行了评估，涉及 150 段视频（表 5；图 6）。

sents.en: These questions have no official training, validation, or test split.
sents.zh: 这些问题没有官方的训练、验证或测试划分。

paragraphs.en: We build memories using the released camera poses and reserve ground-truth geometry for analysis. Across the 150 videos (40.7 hours), 36,633 sampled frames produce 52,001 object instances, 504,981 observations, and 82,445 rest segments. Answering from the same memory in a separate session yields 41.9% accuracy, compared with 42.6% originally, illustrating a 0.7-point variation between these two runs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用已释放的相机姿态构建记忆，并将真实几何信息保留下来用于分析。 在 150 个视频（共 40.7 小时）中，36,633 个采样帧生成了 52,001 个物体实例、504,981 个观察结果和 82,445 个静止片段。 在另一个会话中从同一记忆库获取答案的准确率为 41.9%，而原始准确率为 42.6%，这表明这两次运行之间存在 0.7 个百分点的差异。

sents.en: We build memories using the released camera poses and reserve ground-truth geometry for analysis.
sents.zh: 我们利用已释放的相机姿态构建记忆，并将真实几何信息保留下来用于分析。

sents.en: Across the 150 videos (40.7 hours), 36,633 sampled frames produce 52,001 object instances, 504,981 observations, and 82,445 rest segments.
sents.zh: 在 150 个视频（共 40.7 小时）中，36,633 个采样帧生成了 52,001 个物体实例、504,981 个观察结果和 82,445 个静止片段。

sents.en: Answering from the same memory in a separate session yields 41.9% accuracy, compared with 42.6% originally, illustrating a 0.7-point variation between these two runs.
sents.zh: 在另一个会话中从同一记忆库获取答案的准确率为 41.9%，而原始准确率为 42.6%，这表明这两次运行之间存在 0.7 个百分点的差异。

paragraphs.en: Component ablations use 2,317 questions from the 133 videos processed in the initial pass, with the same prototype-averaged metric. The earlier ten-video analyses reported below are development studies based on different run snapshots.
paragraphs.zh: 组件消融分析使用了初始处理阶段中处理的 133 个视频中的 2,317 个问题，并采用了相同的原型平均指标。 下文提到的早期十个视频的分析是基于不同运行快照的开发研究。

sents.en: Component ablations use 2,317 questions from the 133 videos processed in the initial pass, with the same prototype-averaged metric.
sents.zh: 组件消融分析使用了初始处理阶段中处理的 133 个视频中的 2,317 个问题，并采用了相同的原型平均指标。

sents.en: The earlier ten-video analyses reported below are development studies based on different run snapshots.
sents.zh: 下文提到的早期十个视频的分析是基于不同运行快照的开发研究。

paragraphs.en: We report 95% bootstrap intervals using 2,000 resamples stratified by prototype (seed 0). Comparisons use the same questions in both conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用按原型分层抽样的 2,000 次重采样，报告了 95% 的自助置信区间（种子为 0）。 比较时，两种条件下均使用相同的提问。

sents.en: We report 95% bootstrap intervals using 2,000 resamples stratified by prototype (seed 0).
sents.zh: 我们使用按原型分层抽样的 2,000 次重采样，报告了 95% 的自助置信区间（种子为 0）。

sents.en: Comparisons use the same questions in both conditions.
sents.zh: 比较时，两种条件下均使用相同的提问。

paragraphs.en: We also report pooled accuracy, which gives each question equal weight, so larger prototypes contribute more. For Qwen, memory raises pooled 3D Perception accuracy from 23.2% to 44.6% and Object Motion accuracy from 18.7% to 25.7%. For GPT, the corresponding improvements are from 27.7% to 47.4% and from 33.0% to 39.9%.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还报告了合并准确率，该指标为每个问题赋予相等的权重，因此较大的原型会贡献更多。 对于 Qwen，记忆机制将合并的 3D 感知准确率从 23.2% 提升至 44.6%，并将物体运动准确率从 18.7% 提升至 25.7%。 对于 GPT，相应的提升幅度分别为从 27.7% 到 47.4%，以及从 33.0% 到 39.9%。

sents.en: We also report pooled accuracy, which gives each question equal weight, so larger prototypes contribute more.
sents.zh: 我们还报告了合并准确率，该指标为每个问题赋予相等的权重，因此较大的原型会贡献更多。

sents.en: For Qwen, memory raises pooled 3D Perception accuracy from 23.2% to 44.6% and Object Motion accuracy from 18.7% to 25.7%.
sents.zh: 对于 Qwen，记忆机制将合并的 3D 感知准确率从 23.2% 提升至 44.6%，并将物体运动准确率从 18.7% 提升至 25.7%。

sents.en: For GPT, the corresponding improvements are from 27.7% to 47.4% and from 33.0% to 39.9%.
sents.zh: 对于 GPT，相应的提升幅度分别为从 27.7% 到 47.4%，以及从 33.0% 到 39.9%。

paragraphs.en: Across all 2,400 questions, pooled accuracy rises from 21.5% to 37.5% for Qwen and from 29.7% to 44.6% for GPT. The paired gains are 16.0 points [ 13.6 , 18.3 ] [13.6,18.3] and 14.9 points [ 12.7 , 17.3 ] [12.7,17.3] , respectively. These pooled scores should not be compared directly with the HD-EPIC paper, which averages prototype scores.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有 2400 个问题中，Qwen 的合并准确率从 21.5% 提升至 37.5%，GPT 的合并准确率则从 29.7% 提升至 44.6%。 对应的提升幅度分别为 16.0 分 [ 13.6 , 18.3 ] [13.6,18.3] 和 14.9 分 [ 12.7 , 17.3 ] [12.7,17.3]。 这些合并得分不应与 HD-EPIC 论文中的结果直接比较，因为该论文计算的是原型得分的平均值。

paragraphs.en: For questions that specify an object with a box, we use the sampled frame nearest the query time to estimate the box’s 3D position. We rank object instances observed near that time by their minimum distance to this position and retrieve the closest four. We then replace the box reference in the question with the estimated coordinate. The answerer receives object labels, ranking signals, and segment histories as text. It sees no images, although grounding the query box still uses a frame.
paragraphs.zh: 对于指定了带框物体的问题，我们使用与查询时间最接近的采样帧来估计该框的三维位置。 我们会根据这些物体实例与该位置的最小距离对在该时间附近观察到的物体实例进行排序，并获取最近的四个。 然后，我们将问题中的框引用替换为估计出的坐标。 回答者以文本形式接收物体标签、排序信号和分段历史。 它看不到任何图像，尽管对查询框进行定位时仍然会用到一个帧。

paragraphs.en: For fixture-location questions, we match names using predefined synonym groups, such as hob/stove/cooktop and fridge/refrigerator/freezer. We retrieve the four matching instances with the most observations. To compute their clock directions, we project the camera’s forward axis and the direction to each object onto the horizontal plane: 12 is ahead, 3 is right, 6 is behind, and 9 is left.
paragraphs.zh: 对于设备位置问题，我们使用预定义的同义词组来匹配名称，例如 hob/stove/cooktop 和 fridge/refrigerator/freezer。 我们检索出观察次数最多的四个匹配实例。 为了计算它们的时钟方向，我们将摄像头的向前轴以及指向每个物体的方向投影到水平面上：12 代表前方，3 代表右侧，6 代表后方，9 代表左侧。

paragraphs.en: Using ground-truth fixture positions, this calculation selects the correct direction option on 97.8% of 365 validation questions. With the constructed memory, retrieval finds a name-matched fixture for 83% of the 500 fixture-location questions. Choosing the option closest to the first candidate’s clock direction scores 59.2% across all 500 questions, compared with 56.0% for GPT reading the candidate histories. This geometric rule applies specifically to fixture-direction questions.
paragraphs.zh: 利用真实基准的设施位置，该计算在 365 道验证问题中 97.8% 的情况下选对了方向选项。 借助构建的记忆，检索系统在 500 道设施位置问题中找到了 83% 的名称匹配设施。 在所有 500 道问题中，选择与第一个候选人的时钟方向最接近的选项的得分为 59.2%，而 GPT 阅读候选人历史后的得分为 56.0%。 这条几何规则专门适用于设施方向问题。

paragraphs.en: We run Qwen with greedy decoding and thinking disabled. paragraphs.en: Using GPT, the memory exceeds the video baselines of the HD-EPIC paper and both 2025 challenge entries under this averaging convention, and it remains below the two 2026 challenge reports, which read the video with newer models. EgoAdapt uses category-specific video sampling and option-order voting. Neither comparison isolates the benefit of memory; our matched blind runs provide that control. We also tested a newer model on ten development videos covering 418 questions, using the same answering protocol with three evidence conditions: 50 frames, memory, or no evidence. Prototype-averaged 3D Perception and Object Motion scores were 57.9% and 45.8% with frames, 40.1% and 33.4% with memory, and 23.6% and 32.4% for the blind control. Frames outperform memory in this test, consistent with the published 2026 results.

paragraphs.en: Four memory-based methods are rebuilt on the same 150 videos and 2,400 questions. Each method uses its released code to build memory from the same rectified frames, sampled every 4 s. GPT-5.4 answers from each memory without seeing the video, and all scores use the same prototype averaging. For questions that identify an object with a box, we match the query box to each memory’s own observations at the query time. We select up to three matches with the highest 2D overlap, requiring IoU ≥ 0.1 \geq 0.1 . Method-specific adaptations:
paragraphs.zh: 四种基于记忆的方法在相同的 150 个视频和 2400 个问题上重新构建。 每种方法都使用其已发布的代码，从每 4 秒采样一次的相同校正帧中构建记忆。 GPT-5.4 在不观看视频的情况下根据每种记忆进行回答，且所有分数均使用相同的原型平均法。 对于通过方框识别物体的问题，我们将查询方框与每个记忆在查询时刻自身的观察结果进行匹配。 我们选择最多三个具有最高 2D 重叠度的匹配项，要求 IoU ≥ 0.1 \geq 0.1 。 各方法特定的调整：
