paragraphs.en: DirectMe [ 49 ] : released graph builder (Objects365 vocabulary, YOLO-World, SAM 2, Depth Anything 3 depth and poses) and its text-only graph prompt without keyframes, evaluated over the whole video, with the pose for egocentric relations taken at the question’s time. Its object-count shortcut is disabled because HD-EPIC counting questions count events, not instances.
paragraphs.zh: DirectMe [ 49 ]：发布了图构建器（Objects365 词汇表、YOLO-World、SAM 2、Depth Anything 3 深度和姿态）及其仅包含文本的图提示（不含关键帧），并在整个视频上进行评估，其中自我中心关系的姿态取自问题对应的时间点。 其对象计数快捷方式已被禁用，因为 HD-EPIC 的计数问题统计的是事件，而非实例。

sents.en: DirectMe [ 49 ] : released graph builder (Objects365 vocabulary, YOLO-World, SAM 2, Depth Anything 3 depth and poses) and its text-only graph prompt without keyframes, evaluated over the whole video, with the pose for egocentric relations taken at the question’s time.
sents.zh: DirectMe [ 49 ]：发布了图构建器（Objects365 词汇表、YOLO-World、SAM 2、Depth Anything 3 深度和姿态）及其仅包含文本的图提示（不含关键帧），并在整个视频上进行评估，其中自我中心关系的姿态取自问题对应的时间点。

sents.en: Its object-count shortcut is disabled because HD-EPIC counting questions count events, not instances.
sents.zh: 其对象计数快捷方式已被禁用，因为 HD-EPIC 的计数问题统计的是事件，而非实例。

paragraphs.en: ReMEmbR [ 2 ] : released VILA captioner (one caption per sampled frame), camera positions from the released device trajectories, and its retrieval agent with the options appended; memory times are video times.
paragraphs.zh: ReMEmbR [ 2 ]：发布了 VILA 图像描述生成器（每个采样帧对应一个图像描述）、来自已发布设备轨迹的摄像头位置，以及附加了选项的检索智能体；记忆时间即为视频时间。

paragraphs.en: OSNOM [ 36 ] : released tracker with its published configuration, given the detections our memory lifts (as box masks), the released device trajectories, and FastVGGT depth scaled to metres per 120-frame chunk in place of its mesh-rendered depth. It has no question-answering stage; a common harness serializes the matched track’s position history, nearby tracks, and, for fixture questions, name-matched tracks with clock directions computed as in our agent.
paragraphs.zh: OSNOM [ 36 ]：发布了带有其已发布配置的路径追踪器，其中包含了我们的记忆提取结果（以框掩码形式）、已发布的设备轨迹，以及将 FastVGGT 深度按每 120 帧片段缩放为米，以替代其网格渲染的深度。 它没有问答阶段；一个通用的框架会将匹配轨迹的位置历史、附近轨迹，以及在固定对象问题中通过名称匹配的轨迹（其时钟方向按照我们智能体的方法计算）进行序列化。

sents.en: OSNOM [ 36 ] : released tracker with its published configuration, given the detections our memory lifts (as box masks), the released device trajectories, and FastVGGT depth scaled to metres per 120-frame chunk in place of its mesh-rendered depth.
sents.zh: OSNOM [ 36 ]：发布了带有其已发布配置的路径追踪器，其中包含了我们的记忆提取结果（以框掩码形式）、已发布的设备轨迹，以及将 FastVGGT 深度按每 120 帧片段缩放为米，以替代其网格渲染的深度。

sents.en: It has no question-answering stage; a common harness serializes the matched track’s position history, nearby tracks, and, for fixture questions, name-matched tracks with clock directions computed as in our agent.
sents.zh: 它没有问答阶段；一个通用的框架会将匹配轨迹的位置历史、附近轨迹，以及在固定对象问题中通过名称匹配的轨迹（其时钟方向按照我们智能体的方法计算）进行序列化。

paragraphs.en: AMEGO [ 16 ] : its hand–object detector weights are no longer available, so the Hands23 detector [ 10 ] from the same group replaces it. Its frame-count thresholds, set for 50–60 fps, give an empty memory at 0.25 fps and are reduced to one frame; flow filtering and the object tracker are disabled. AMEGO stores no object names and no 3D positions.
paragraphs.zh: AMEGO [ 16 ]：其手部-物体检测器的权重已不可用，因此由同一团队开发的 Hands23 检测器 [ 10 ] 取而代之。 其帧数阈值设定为 50–60 fps，在 0.25 fps 时内存为空，并减少至一帧；光流过滤和物体跟踪器均被禁用。 AMEGO 不存储任何物体名称或 3D 位置信息。

sents.en: AMEGO [ 16 ] : its hand–object detector weights are no longer available, so the Hands23 detector [ 10 ] from the same group replaces it.
sents.zh: AMEGO [ 16 ]：其手部-物体检测器的权重已不可用，因此由同一团队开发的 Hands23 检测器 [ 10 ] 取而代之。

sents.en: Its frame-count thresholds, set for 50–60 fps, give an empty memory at 0.25 fps and are reduced to one frame; flow filtering and the object tracker are disabled.
sents.zh: 其帧数阈值设定为 50–60 fps，在 0.25 fps 时内存为空，并减少至一帧；光流过滤和物体跟踪器均被禁用。

sents.en: AMEGO stores no object names and no 3D positions.
sents.zh: AMEGO 不存储任何物体名称或 3D 位置信息。

paragraphs.en: The 95% bootstrap intervals on the mean are [ 28.8 , 32.8 ] [28.8,32.8] for DirectMe, [ 27.8 , 31.8 ] [27.8,31.8] for ReMEmbR, [ 28.2 , 32.2 ] [28.2,32.2] for OSNOM, and [ 32.6 , 36.7 ] [32.6,36.7] for AMEGO, against [ 40.5 , 44.8 ] [40.5,44.8] for our memory.
paragraphs.zh: DirectMe 的均值 95% 自助区间为 [28.8, 32.8]，ReMEmbR 的均值 95% 自助区间为 [27.8, 31.8]，OSNOM 的均值 95% 自助区间为 [28.2, 32.2]，AMEGO 的均值 95% 自助区间为 [32.6, 36.7]，而我们的记忆模块的均值 95% 自助区间为 [40.5, 44.8]。

paragraphs.en: “Segment descriptions” removes all descriptions and summaries from the final memory; “persistence segmentation” uses the distance-threshold rule ( τ = 0.3 \tau=0.3 m, no persistence); “multi-view triangulation” uses monocular depth with the same persistence segmentation. Table 12 reports category-level effects and their intervals. Per-prototype comparisons use the same questions in both conditions (Table 11 ). We use exact McNemar tests, with Holm correction across the 21 prototype–component comparisons, and bootstrap intervals from 4,000 resamples of videos.
paragraphs.zh: “片段描述”会从最终记忆中移除所有描述和摘要；“持续性分割”采用距离阈值规则（τ = 0.3 \tau=0.3 m，无持续性）；“多视角三角测量”则使用单目深度并结合相同的持续性分割方法。 表 12 报告了类别层面的效应及其置信区间。 每个原型的比较在两种条件下均使用相同的问题（表 11）。 我们采用精确的麦克尼马尔检验，并对 21 组原型与组件的比较应用霍尔姆校正，同时通过从视频中重采样 4,000 次生成自助法置信区间。

sents.en: “Segment descriptions” removes all descriptions and summaries from the final memory; “persistence segmentation” uses the distance-threshold rule ( τ = 0.3 \tau=0.3 m, no persistence); “multi-view triangulation” uses monocular depth with the same persistence segmentation.
sents.zh: “片段描述”会从最终记忆中移除所有描述和摘要；“持续性分割”采用距离阈值规则（τ = 0.3 \tau=0.3 m，无持续性）；“多视角三角测量”则使用单目深度并结合相同的持续性分割方法。

sents.en: Table 12 reports category-level effects and their intervals.
sents.zh: 表 12 报告了类别层面的效应及其置信区间。

sents.en: Per-prototype comparisons use the same questions in both conditions (Table 11 ).
sents.zh: 每个原型的比较在两种条件下均使用相同的问题（表 11）。

sents.en: We use exact McNemar tests, with Holm correction across the 21 prototype–component comparisons, and bootstrap intervals from 4,000 resamples of videos.
sents.zh: 我们采用精确的麦克尼马尔检验，并对 21 组原型与组件的比较应用霍尔姆校正，同时通过从视频中重采样 4,000 次生成自助法置信区间。

paragraphs.en: Three effects remain significant after correction: descriptions improve object location by 8.4 points [ 3.0 , 13.4 ] [3.0,13.4] and fixture-interaction counting by 7.8 points [ 3.8 , 12.0 ] [3.8,12.0] ; persistence improves movement counting by 15.5 points [ 8.1 , 23.2 ] [8.1,23.2] .
paragraphs.zh: 校正后，仍有三种效应具有显著性：描述使物体定位提升了 8.4 分 [ 3.0 , 13.4 ] [3.0,13.4]，并使固定装置交互计数提升了 7.8 分 [ 3.8 , 12.0 ] [3.8,12.0]；持续性则使移动计数提升了 15.5 分 [ 8.1 , 23.2 ] [8.1,23.2]。

paragraphs.en: Each condition uses a single GPT-5.4 run. Repeating identical prompts changes whether 15–20% of answers are correct, and individual per-prototype scores vary by about ± 7 \pm 7 –10 points.
paragraphs.zh: 每个条件都使用一次 GPT-5.4 运行。 重复相同的提示词会改变答案中正确率是否达到 15–20%，而每个原型个体的得分则相差约 ±7 \pm 7 –10 分。

sents.en: Each condition uses a single GPT-5.4 run.
sents.zh: 每个条件都使用一次 GPT-5.4 运行。

sents.en: Repeating identical prompts changes whether 15–20% of answers are correct, and individual per-prototype scores vary by about ± 7 \pm 7 –10 points.
sents.zh: 重复相同的提示词会改变答案中正确率是否达到 15–20%，而每个原型个体的得分则相差约 ±7 \pm 7 –10 分。

paragraphs.en: Each row of Table 13 changes one part of the final HD-EPIC system and re-answers all 2,400 questions with the same prompts. We test differences in mean accuracy using paired sign-flip permutation tests with 20,000 draws and Holm correction across the twelve design comparisons. For individual prototypes, we use exact McNemar tests with Holm correction across 84 cells. Only the estimated poses without gravity levelling significantly change the mean after correction. The GPT-5.6, text-retrieval, and 2D-area-retrieval differences are significant only before correction.
paragraphs.zh: 表13中的每一行都会改变最终HD-EPIC系统的一个部分，并使用相同的提示词重新回答全部2400个问题。 我们使用配对符号翻转置换检验（含20000次抽样）和霍尔姆校正，对十二种设计比较中的平均准确率差异进行了测试。 对于单个原型，我们对84个单元格使用了精确的麦克尼马尔检验和霍尔姆校正。 仅未经重力调平的估计姿态在校正后显著改变了平均值。 GPT-5.6、文本检索和2D区域检索之间的差异仅在校正前具有显著性。

sents.en: Each row of Table 13 changes one part of the final HD-EPIC system and re-answers all 2,400 questions with the same prompts.
sents.zh: 表13中的每一行都会改变最终HD-EPIC系统的一个部分，并使用相同的提示词重新回答全部2400个问题。

sents.en: We test differences in mean accuracy using paired sign-flip permutation tests with 20,000 draws and Holm correction across the twelve design comparisons.
sents.zh: 我们使用配对符号翻转置换检验（含20000次抽样）和霍尔姆校正，对十二种设计比较中的平均准确率差异进行了测试。

sents.en: For individual prototypes, we use exact McNemar tests with Holm correction across 84 cells.
sents.zh: 对于单个原型，我们对84个单元格使用了精确的麦克尼马尔检验和霍尔姆校正。

sents.en: Only the estimated poses without gravity levelling significantly change the mean after correction.
sents.zh: 仅未经重力调平的估计姿态在校正后显著改变了平均值。

sents.en: The GPT-5.6, text-retrieval, and 2D-area-retrieval differences are significant only before correction.
sents.zh: GPT-5.6、文本检索和2D区域检索之间的差异仅在校正前具有显著性。

paragraphs.en: The pose-free variants use FastVGGT poses. We rescale their camera centres by 1 / 1.70 1/1.70 , a factor measured against ground-truth depth on HD-EPIC. These variants therefore avoid the released camera poses but still use ground-truth information for scale. Gravity levelling estimates the up direction as the direction most nearly perpendicular to all camera x x -axes, with a median error of 6.0 ∘ .
paragraphs.zh: 无需姿态的变体使用 FastVGGT 姿态。 我们将它们的相机中心按 1 / 1.70 的比例重新缩放，该比例因子是根据 HD-EPIC 上的真实深度数据测量得出的。 因此，这些变体避免了已发布的相机姿态，但仍使用真实信息来确定尺度。 重力水平化将向上方向估计为最接近垂直于所有相机 x 轴的方向，其中位误差为 6.0°。

sents.en: The pose-free variants use FastVGGT poses.
sents.zh: 无需姿态的变体使用 FastVGGT 姿态。

sents.en: We rescale their camera centres by 1 / 1.70 1/1.70 , a factor measured against ground-truth depth on HD-EPIC.
sents.zh: 我们将它们的相机中心按 1 / 1.70 的比例重新缩放，该比例因子是根据 HD-EPIC 上的真实深度数据测量得出的。

sents.en: These variants therefore avoid the released camera poses but still use ground-truth information for scale.
sents.zh: 因此，这些变体避免了已发布的相机姿态，但仍使用真实信息来确定尺度。

sents.en: Gravity levelling estimates the up direction as the direction most nearly perpendicular to all camera x x -axes, with a median error of 6.0 ∘ .
sents.zh: 重力水平化将向上方向估计为最接近垂直于所有相机 x 轴的方向，其中位误差为 6.0°。

paragraphs.en: The GPT-5.6 blind control includes six API errors and seven unparsed answers, all scored as incorrect. These affect its score by at most 0.3 points. GPT-5.6 uses reasoning on 98.9% of questions, with a median of 366 reasoning tokens. In contrast, GPT-5.4 uses no reasoning tokens. The 2.4-point gain therefore combines a change of model with the addition of reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-5.6 的盲测结果包含六个 API 错误和七个未解析的答案，所有结果均被判定为错误。 这些因素最多只会影响其 0.3 分的得分。 GPT-5.6 在 98.9% 的问题中使用了推理过程，其中推理标记数的中位数为 366。 相比之下，GPT-5.4 完全没有使用任何推理标记。 因此，这 2.4 分的提升既源于模型的变化，也得益于推理功能的加入。

sents.en: The GPT-5.6 blind control includes six API errors and seven unparsed answers, all scored as incorrect.
sents.zh: GPT-5.6 的盲测结果包含六个 API 错误和七个未解析的答案，所有结果均被判定为错误。

sents.en: These affect its score by at most 0.3 points.
sents.zh: 这些因素最多只会影响其 0.3 分的得分。

sents.en: GPT-5.6 uses reasoning on 98.9% of questions, with a median of 366 reasoning tokens.
sents.zh: GPT-5.6 在 98.9% 的问题中使用了推理过程，其中推理标记数的中位数为 366。

sents.en: In contrast, GPT-5.4 uses no reasoning tokens.
sents.zh: 相比之下，GPT-5.4 完全没有使用任何推理标记。

sents.en: The 2.4-point gain therefore combines a change of model with the addition of reasoning.
sents.zh: 因此，这 2.4 分的提升既源于模型的变化，也得益于推理功能的加入。

paragraphs.en: The bottom block reports full memory rebuilds on a ten-video pilot covering 418 questions. Each is compared with the final memory re-answered in the same session. Intervals are approximately ± 5 \pm 5 points, and no difference is significant. Sampling every two seconds mainly lowers movement-counting accuracy, but this needs further checking before drawing a conclusion. Across the 981 annotated object names in these videos, semantic recall is 61% for Qwen3.5-9B, 60% for GPT-5.4 with vision, and 54% for Gemma-3-4B.
paragraphs.zh: 底部模块报告了在一个包含 418 个问题的十视频试点中进行了完整的记忆重建。 每个结果都与同一会话中最终通过记忆重新回答的结果进行比较。 间隔约为 ±5 \pm 5 分，且没有差异具有显著性。 每两秒采样一次主要会降低动作计数的准确性，但在得出结论之前需要进一步验证这一点。 在这些视频中 981 个已标注的物体名称中，Qwen3.5-9B 的语义召回率为 61%，GPT-5.4（带视觉功能）为 60%，Gemma-3-4B 为 54%。

sents.en: The bottom block reports full memory rebuilds on a ten-video pilot covering 418 questions.
sents.zh: 底部模块报告了在一个包含 418 个问题的十视频试点中进行了完整的记忆重建。

sents.en: Each is compared with the final memory re-answered in the same session.
sents.zh: 每个结果都与同一会话中最终通过记忆重新回答的结果进行比较。

sents.en: Intervals are approximately ± 5 \pm 5 points, and no difference is significant.
sents.zh: 间隔约为 ±5 \pm 5 分，且没有差异具有显著性。

sents.en: Sampling every two seconds mainly lowers movement-counting accuracy, but this needs further checking before drawing a conclusion.
sents.zh: 每两秒采样一次主要会降低动作计数的准确性，但在得出结论之前需要进一步验证这一点。

sents.en: Across the 981 annotated object names in these videos, semantic recall is 61% for Qwen3.5-9B, 60% for GPT-5.4 with vision, and 54% for Gemma-3-4B.
sents.zh: 在这些视频中 981 个已标注的物体名称中，Qwen3.5-9B 的语义召回率为 61%，GPT-5.4（带视觉功能）为 60%，Gemma-3-4B 为 54%。

paragraphs.en: The component removals in Table 11 come from a separate experiment on 2,317 questions with its own full-memory baseline. They are not repeated here.
paragraphs.zh: 表 11 中的组件移除来自一项独立的实验，该实验涉及 2,317 个问题，并配有其专属的全记忆基线模型。 此处未重复列出这些内容。

sents.en: The component removals in Table 11 come from a separate experiment on 2,317 questions with its own full-memory baseline.
sents.zh: 表 11 中的组件移除来自一项独立的实验，该实验涉及 2,317 个问题，并配有其专属的全记忆基线模型。

sents.en: They are not repeated here.
sents.zh: 此处未重复列出这些内容。

paragraphs.en: The following analyses use an earlier 10-video development snapshot with 339 object-level questions. These results come from separate runs, rather than the current 2,400-question evaluation or the 2,317-question component ablations. Unless stated otherwise, the configurations in Table 14 use distance-threshold segmentation and monocular positions. With GPT, retrieval criteria differ by at most 0.3 accuracy points. Switching the answerer changes accuracy by 7.4 points when using the same 3D-centre retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 以下分析使用了一个早期的包含 10 个视频的发育快照，其中含有 339 个物体级问题。 这些结果来自独立的运行，而非当前的 2,400 个问题评估或 2,317 个问题的组件消融分析。 除非另有说明，表 14 中的配置均使用距离阈值分割和单目位置。 在使用 GPT 时，检索标准最多相差 0.3 个准确率点。 当使用相同的 3D 中心检索时，更换回答者会使准确率变化 7.4 个点。

sents.en: The following analyses use an earlier 10-video development snapshot with 339 object-level questions.
sents.zh: 以下分析使用了一个早期的包含 10 个视频的发育快照，其中含有 339 个物体级问题。

sents.en: These results come from separate runs, rather than the current 2,400-question evaluation or the 2,317-question component ablations.
sents.zh: 这些结果来自独立的运行，而非当前的 2,400 个问题评估或 2,317 个问题的组件消融分析。

sents.en: Unless stated otherwise, the configurations in Table 14 use distance-threshold segmentation and monocular positions.
sents.zh: 除非另有说明，表 14 中的配置均使用距离阈值分割和单目位置。

sents.en: With GPT, retrieval criteria differ by at most 0.3 accuracy points.
sents.zh: 在使用 GPT 时，检索标准最多相差 0.3 个准确率点。

sents.en: Switching the answerer changes accuracy by 7.4 points when using the same 3D-centre retrieval.
sents.zh: 当使用相同的 3D 中心检索时，更换回答者会使准确率变化 7.4 个点。

paragraphs.en: The trajectory oracle (Table 15 ) corrects target selection and history as well as localization. It does not separately identify each failure source. The near-identical retrieved and non-retrieved “any of four” scores also show why best-of-several answering success cannot be interpreted as retrieved evidence coverage: multiple guesses can produce a high score without selecting relevant objects.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹预言机（表 15）会修正目标选择、历史记录以及定位。 它不会单独识别每个故障来源。 检索到的和未检索到的“四选一”得分几乎完全相同，这也说明了为何“最佳多轮回答”的成功不能被解释为检索证据的覆盖：多次猜测可能在没有选中相关对象的情况下产生高分。

sents.en: The trajectory oracle (Table 15 ) corrects target selection and history as well as localization.
sents.zh: 轨迹预言机（表 15）会修正目标选择、历史记录以及定位。

sents.en: It does not separately identify each failure source.
sents.zh: 它不会单独识别每个故障来源。

sents.en: The near-identical retrieved and non-retrieved “any of four” scores also show why best-of-several answering success cannot be interpreted as retrieved evidence coverage: multiple guesses can produce a high score without selecting relevant objects.
sents.zh: 检索到的和未检索到的“四选一”得分几乎完全相同，这也说明了为何“最佳多轮回答”的成功不能被解释为检索证据的覆盖：多次猜测可能在没有选中相关对象的情况下产生高分。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate triangulation on 389 detections matched to ground-truth boxes with IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 . It reduces median 3D error from 0.39 to 0.35 m and increases the share within 0.25 m of the true position from 13.6% to 37.3% (Equation 1 ). Before refinement, most error lies along the viewing ray: the median along-ray component is 0.37 m, compared with 0.03 m perpendicular to it.

paragraphs.en: For 377 detections observed from at least two known camera poses, we group results into quartiles by camera baseline. The share within 0.25 m improves in every group: from 10.5% to 27.4%, 12.8% to 46.8%, 12.7% to 39.2%, and 19.1% to 38.3%. This analysis measures localization of matched detections, not how many objects the system discovers.
paragraphs.zh: 对于从至少两个已知相机姿态中观测到的 377 个检测结果，我们根据相机基线将结果分为四分位数。 0.25 米以内的比例在每一组中都有所提升：从 10.5% 到 27.4%，从 12.8% 到 46.8%，从 12.7% 到 39.2%，以及从 19.1% 到 38.3%。 这项分析衡量的是匹配检测结果的定位精度，而非系统发现了多少物体。

paragraphs.en: The threshold rule over-counts movement in 64% of these questions at 0.3 m (Table 16 ). A larger distance threshold suppresses localization noise but can miss small movements. In the annotations, 19% of moves are shorter than 0.3 m and 50% are shorter than 0.8 m. Meanwhile, the 95th percentile of localization error is 0.84 m. Persistence improves movement counts on questions whose target is already in memory, separating segmentation errors from failures to retain the target. Bias and mean counts are rounded separately.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些问题的 64% 中，当阈值为 0.3 m 时，阈值规则会高估移动次数（表 16）。 较大的距离阈值可以抑制定位噪声，但可能会遗漏微小的移动。 在标注数据中，19% 的移动距离小于 0.3 m，50% 的移动距离小于 0.8 m。 同时，定位误差的 95th 百分位数为 0.84 m。 对于目标已在记忆中的问题，持续性会提高移动计数，从而将分割错误与未能保留目标的情况区分开来。 偏差和平均计数分别进行四舍五入。

paragraphs.en: Stationary-localization questions ask when an object stopped moving and remained still. In the earlier analysis, choosing the answer timestamp closest to a rest-segment start is correct for only 22% of questions, compared with 20% chance. This suggests that sampled observation times do not reliably identify when continuous rest began. Memory does not always hurt this question type, however: the current Qwen and GPT runs show opposite effects (Table 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 静态定位问题询问的是物体何时停止移动并保持静止。 在之前的分析中，选择最接近静止阶段开始时间戳的答案仅对 22% 的问题正确，而这一概率仅为 20%。 这表明，采样观察时间无法可靠地确定连续静止状态开始的时刻。 然而，记忆并不总是会对这类问题产生负面影响：当前的 Qwen 和 GPT 运行结果显示出相反的效果（表 5）。

paragraphs.en: We developed the segmentation and retrieval rules, triangulation thresholds, and fixture synonym groups on 5–10 pilot videos from a calibration dataset kept separate from evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个与评估数据分开保存的校准数据集中，基于 5–10 段试点视频制定了分割和检索规则、三角测量阈值以及夹具同义词组。

paragraphs.en: In an earlier measurement on a 24 GB GPU, WildDet3D took 0.85, 0.99, and 0.94 seconds per detection at input resolutions of 1802, 960, and 480 pixels, respectively. Each box is processed at a fixed internal resolution, so reducing the input resolution does not consistently reduce processing time. Generating descriptions can dominate total runtime in videos with many objects. These component timings do not measure end-to-end throughput or memory compression.
paragraphs.zh: 在先前对一块 24 GB GPU 的测试中，WildDet3D 在输入分辨率为 1802、960 和 480 像素时，每次检测分别耗时 0.85、0.99 和 0.94 秒。 每个框都以固定的内部分辨率进行处理，因此降低输入分辨率并不会始终缩短处理时间。 在包含大量物体的视频中，生成描述可能会占据总运行时间的绝大部分。 这些组件的计时并未衡量端到端的吞吐量或内存压缩效果。

paragraphs.en: This threshold is permissive. Combined with excluding unanswered queries, it produces near-ceiling conditional success even when localization errors are several metres. Before making a leaderboard comparison, we still need to compute success over all queries and the official L 2 L_{2} aggregation using the benchmark’s evaluation code. Appendix C.5 lists published results and the remaining protocol differences.

paragraphs.en: We score a query only when retrieval returns a candidate. Raw SAM 3 memory returns candidates for 143 of 164 queries, and trajectory memory for 153. Each variant is therefore scored on its own returned queries, rather than a shared set. A 99% conditional success rate or a median error below one metre does not imply successful localization on 99% of all queries. These results do not establish full-query success or an end-to-end improvement on the official VQ3D task.
paragraphs.zh: 只有在检索返回候选项时，我们才会对查询进行评分。 原始 SAM 3 记忆为 164 个查询中的 143 个返回了候选项，而轨迹记忆则为 153 个返回了候选项。 因此，每个变体都基于其自身返回的查询进行评分，而不是基于共享的查询集。 99% 的条件成功率或低于一米的误差中位数，并不意味着在所有查询中有 99% 的成功定位。 这些结果并未证明所有查询都能成功，也未证明在官方 VQ3D 任务上实现了端到端的改进。

paragraphs.en: We sample every twentieth frame from a 5 fps grid, giving one frame every four seconds. YOLO-World uses v8x-worldv2 at 640 pixels, with a confidence threshold of 0.25 and at most 12 detections per frame. We lift at most 25 detections per tag and 400 per scene into 3D. Trajectory association uses a 1.0 m radius, and consolidation uses a mask-IoU threshold of 0.3.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 5 fps 的网格中每隔二十帧抽取一帧，即每四秒得到一帧。 YOLO-World 使用分辨率为 640 像素的 v8x-worldv2，置信度阈值为 0.25，每帧最多检测 12 个目标。 我们将每个标签下最多 25 个检测和每场景最多 400 个检测提升至三维空间。 轨迹关联使用 1.0 米的半径，而合并过程则使用 mask-IoU 阈值 0.3。

sents.en: We sample every twentieth frame from a 5 fps grid, giving one frame every four seconds.
sents.zh: 我们从 5 fps 的网格中每隔二十帧抽取一帧，即每四秒得到一帧。

sents.en: We lift at most 25 detections per tag and 400 per scene into 3D.
sents.zh: 我们将每个标签下最多 25 个检测和每场景最多 400 个检测提升至三维空间。

paragraphs.en: The localization tables use GPT-5.4 to select from at most four candidates. We evaluate Qwen only for tagging and judging coverage, so these results do not demonstrate a localization pipeline built entirely from open models. We also evaluate FastVGGT [ 41 ] as an alternative source of camera poses.
paragraphs.zh: 本地化表使用 GPT-5.4 从最多四个候选项中进行选择。 我们仅对 Qwen 的标签添加和覆盖判断能力进行评估，因此这些结果并未展示一个完全由开放模型构建的本地化流程。 我们还评估了 FastVGGT [ 41 ]，将其作为相机姿态的替代来源。

sents.en: The localization tables use GPT-5.4 to select from at most four candidates.
sents.zh: 本地化表使用 GPT-5.4 从最多四个候选项中进行选择。

sents.en: We evaluate Qwen only for tagging and judging coverage, so these results do not demonstrate a localization pipeline built entirely from open models.
sents.zh: 我们仅对 Qwen 的标签添加和覆盖判断能力进行评估，因此这些结果并未展示一个完全由开放模型构建的本地化流程。

sents.en: We also evaluate FastVGGT [ 41 ] as an alternative source of camera poses.
sents.zh: 我们还评估了 FastVGGT [ 41 ]，将其作为相机姿态的替代来源。

paragraphs.en: Raw memory groups observations by tag and returns the densest 3D cluster for the selected tag. Trajectory memory associates observations in time order using each instance’s latest position, rather than a global centroid. This allows it to retain multiple instances with the same tag. Consolidation additionally groups synonymous tags and propagates SAM 3 masks to reconnect tracks, using a co-occurrence check to block incompatible merges. In this analysis, EgoLoc provides poses for approximately 98% of sampled frames, compared with approximately 100% for FastVGGT.
paragraphs.zh: 原始记忆按标签对观察结果进行分组，并返回所选标签最密集的三维聚类。 轨迹记忆利用每个实例的最新位置而非全局质心，将观察结果按时间顺序关联起来。 这使得它能够保留具有相同标签的多个实例。 整合过程还会将同义标签进行分组，并将 SAM 3 掩码传播出去以重新连接轨迹，同时通过共现检查阻止不兼容的合并。 在此分析中，EgoLoc 为约 98% 的采样帧提供了姿态信息，而 FastVGGT 的这一比例约为 100%。

sents.en: Raw memory groups observations by tag and returns the densest 3D cluster for the selected tag.
sents.zh: 原始记忆按标签对观察结果进行分组，并返回所选标签最密集的三维聚类。

sents.en: Trajectory memory associates observations in time order using each instance’s latest position, rather than a global centroid.
sents.zh: 轨迹记忆利用每个实例的最新位置而非全局质心，将观察结果按时间顺序关联起来。

sents.en: Consolidation additionally groups synonymous tags and propagates SAM 3 masks to reconnect tracks, using a co-occurrence check to block incompatible merges.
sents.zh: 整合过程还会将同义标签进行分组，并将 SAM 3 掩码传播出去以重新连接轨迹，同时通过共现检查阻止不兼容的合并。

sents.zh: 在此分析中，EgoLoc 为约 98% 的采样帧提供了姿态信息，而 FastVGGT 的这一比例约为 100%。

paragraphs.en: With EgoLoc poses, consolidation reduces the median by 0.029 m for SAM 3 and 0.026 m for YOLO-World. This task predicts a single position and does not score identity continuity, movement histories, or later scene-specific question answering. A small localization difference cannot establish that tracking is unnecessary for those tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 EgoLoc 姿态后，整合使中位数分别降低了 SAM 3 的 0.029 米和 YOLO-World 的 0.026 米。 该任务仅预测单个位置，并未对身份连续性、移动历史或后续场景特定的问答进行评分。 微小的定位差异无法证明这些任务无需跟踪。

sents.en: With EgoLoc poses, consolidation reduces the median by 0.029 m for SAM 3 and 0.026 m for YOLO-World.
sents.zh: 使用 EgoLoc 姿态后，整合使中位数分别降低了 SAM 3 的 0.029 米和 YOLO-World 的 0.026 米。

sents.en: This task predicts a single position and does not score identity continuity, movement histories, or later scene-specific question answering.
sents.zh: 该任务仅预测单个位置，并未对身份连续性、移动历史或后续场景特定的问答进行评分。

sents.en: A small localization difference cannot establish that tracking is unnecessary for those tasks.
sents.zh: 微小的定位差异无法证明这些任务无需跟踪。

paragraphs.en: The triangulated variant intersects the viewing rays of an object’s observations (Equation 1 ) with the HD-EPIC guards: at least three rays, a camera spread of 0.10 m, conditioning of 0.25, the point in front of every camera, and at most 2 m from the monocular estimate; otherwise the monocular position is kept. We compute viewing rays using the dataset’s fisheye camera model. For each query, GPT-5.4 selects one candidate, which we score using both its original and refined positions. This holds object selection fixed and avoids variation from repeated answering. The two ground-truth annotations differ by a median of 4.8 cm.
paragraphs.zh: 三角化变体将物体观测的视线射线（方程 1）与 HD-EPIC 守卫射线进行相交：至少三条射线、0.10 米的相机间距、0.25 的条件约束、每架相机前方的点，以及距离单目估计最多 2 米；否则保留单目位置。 我们使用数据集的鱼眼相机模型计算视线射线。 对于每个查询，GPT-5.4 会选择一个候选项，我们使用其原始位置和精修位置对其进行评分。 这样可保持物体选择不变，并避免重复回答带来的差异。 两个真实标注之间的中位数差异为 4.8 厘米。

sents.en: The triangulated variant intersects the viewing rays of an object’s observations (Equation 1 ) with the HD-EPIC guards: at least three rays, a camera spread of 0.10 m, conditioning of 0.25, the point in front of every camera, and at most 2 m from the monocular estimate; otherwise the monocular position is kept.
sents.zh: 三角化变体将物体观测的视线射线（方程 1）与 HD-EPIC 守卫射线进行相交：至少三条射线、0.10 米的相机间距、0.25 的条件约束、每架相机前方的点，以及距离单目估计最多 2 米；否则保留单目位置。

sents.en: We compute viewing rays using the dataset’s fisheye camera model.
sents.zh: 我们使用数据集的鱼眼相机模型计算视线射线。

sents.en: For each query, GPT-5.4 selects one candidate, which we score using both its original and refined positions.
sents.zh: 对于每个查询，GPT-5.4 会选择一个候选项，我们使用其原始位置和精修位置对其进行评分。

sents.en: This holds object selection fixed and avoids variation from repeated answering.
sents.zh: 这样可保持物体选择不变，并避免重复回答带来的差异。

sents.en: The two ground-truth annotations differ by a median of 4.8 cm.
sents.zh: 两个真实标注之间的中位数差异为 4.8 厘米。

paragraphs.en: Table 18 reports results for queries that pass the refinement checks: about half with SAM 3 and a quarter with YOLO-World. Most remaining queries have fewer than three observations at this sampling rate. With EgoLoc poses, triangulation reduces error on eligible queries by a median of 0.09–0.12 m. All three SAM 3 results remain significant after Holm correction across twelve tests. With FastVGGT poses, the gain falls to about 0.03 m, showing that refinement depends on pose accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 表 18 报告了通过细化检查的查询结果：其中约一半使用了 SAM 3，四分之一使用了 YOLO-World。 在当前的采样率下，大多数剩余查询的观察次数少于三次。 使用 EgoLoc 位姿时，三角测量可将符合条件的查询误差中位数减少 0.09–0.12 米。 在所有十二次测试中，三个 SAM 3 的结果在 Holm 校正后仍然具有显著性。 使用 FastVGGT 位姿时，增益降至约 0.03 米，这表明细化效果依赖于位姿的准确性。

sents.en: Table 18 reports results for queries that pass the refinement checks: about half with SAM 3 and a quarter with YOLO-World.
sents.zh: 表 18 报告了通过细化检查的查询结果：其中约一半使用了 SAM 3，四分之一使用了 YOLO-World。

sents.en: Most remaining queries have fewer than three observations at this sampling rate.
sents.zh: 在当前的采样率下，大多数剩余查询的观察次数少于三次。

sents.en: With EgoLoc poses, triangulation reduces error on eligible queries by a median of 0.09–0.12 m.
sents.zh: 使用 EgoLoc 位姿时，三角测量可将符合条件的查询误差中位数减少 0.09–0.12 米。

sents.en: All three SAM 3 results remain significant after Holm correction across twelve tests.
sents.zh: 在所有十二次测试中，三个 SAM 3 的结果在 Holm 校正后仍然具有显著性。

sents.en: With FastVGGT poses, the gain falls to about 0.03 m, showing that refinement depends on pose accuracy.
sents.zh: 使用 FastVGGT 位姿时，增益降至约 0.03 米，这表明细化效果依赖于位姿的准确性。

paragraphs.en: Across all graded queries, mean error decreases in every configuration, but median error does not improve. Some predictions with errors just below 1 m become slightly worse and move above that value, affecting the median. The share of predictions within 0.5 m nevertheless increases. The monocular medians here differ from those of Table 4 by up to 0.04 m because the matcher was re-run.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有分级查询中，平均误差在每种配置下均有所降低，但中位误差并未改善。 一些误差略低于 1 米的预测结果变得稍差，并超过了该值，从而影响了中位误差。 尽管如此，预测结果落在 0.5 米范围内的比例仍在增加。 此处单目摄像头的中位误差与表 4 中的数值最多相差 0.04 米，这是因为匹配器被重新运行了。

sents.en: Across all graded queries, mean error decreases in every configuration, but median error does not improve.
sents.zh: 在所有分级查询中，平均误差在每种配置下均有所降低，但中位误差并未改善。

sents.en: Some predictions with errors just below 1 m become slightly worse and move above that value, affecting the median.
sents.zh: 一些误差略低于 1 米的预测结果变得稍差，并超过了该值，从而影响了中位误差。

sents.en: The share of predictions within 0.5 m nevertheless increases.
sents.zh: 尽管如此，预测结果落在 0.5 米范围内的比例仍在增加。

sents.en: The monocular medians here differ from those of Table 4 by up to 0.04 m because the matcher was re-run.
sents.zh: 此处单目摄像头的中位误差与表 4 中的数值最多相差 0.04 米，这是因为匹配器被重新运行了。

paragraphs.en: ‡ Success is distance to the annotated midpoint below 6 ​ ( ‖ 𝐠 1 − 𝐠 2 ‖ + 1 ​ m ) 6(\|\mathbf{g}_{1}-\mathbf{g}_{2}\|+1\,\mathrm{m}) . The official evaluation sets the success tolerance using the annotated box size, so our scores cannot be compared directly with published Succ values. Our tolerance is permissive enough that always returning the clip’s mean camera position achieves 100% success (Table 20 ). § Not QwP: the fraction of queries for which the memory returned a located object (graded / 164).
paragraphs.zh: ‡ 成功性是指与下方标注的中点之间的距离低于 6 ​ ( ‖ 𝐠 1 − 𝐠 2 ‖ + 1 ​ m ) 6(\|\mathbf{g}_{1}-\mathbf{g}_{2}\|+1\,\mathrm{m})。 官方评估使用标注框的大小来设定成功性容差，因此我们的分数无法与已发表的 Succ 值直接比较。 我们的容差足够宽松，以至于始终返回剪辑的平均相机位置即可实现 100% 的成功率（表 20）。§ 非 QwP：记忆返回已定位对象的查询比例（分级 / 164）。

sents.en: ‡ Success is distance to the annotated midpoint below 6 ​ ( ‖ 𝐠 1 − 𝐠 2 ‖ + 1 ​ m ) 6(\|\mathbf{g}_{1}-\mathbf{g}_{2}\|+1\,\mathrm{m}) .
sents.zh: ‡ 成功性是指与下方标注的中点之间的距离低于 6 ​ ( ‖ 𝐠 1 − 𝐠 2 ‖ + 1 ​ m ) 6(\|\mathbf{g}_{1}-\mathbf{g}_{2}\|+1\,\mathrm{m})。

sents.en: The official evaluation sets the success tolerance using the annotated box size, so our scores cannot be compared directly with published Succ values.
sents.zh: 官方评估使用标注框的大小来设定成功性容差，因此我们的分数无法与已发表的 Succ 值直接比较。

sents.en: Our tolerance is permissive enough that always returning the clip’s mean camera position achieves 100% success (Table 20 ). § Not QwP: the fraction of queries for which the memory returned a located object (graded / 164).
sents.zh: 我们的容差足够宽松，以至于始终返回剪辑的平均相机位置即可实现 100% 的成功率（表 20）。§ 非 QwP：记忆返回已定位对象的查询比例（分级 / 164）。

paragraphs.en: Five differences must be read with Table 19 . (1) The benchmark identifies the target through a visual crop from the VQ2D response track. We instead give the object’s text title to a language model that searches a pre-built memory, so the query input differs. (2) Recent methods report success rates of 96–99%, and our evaluation uses a fixed tolerance rather than one based on box size. Localization error ( L 2 L_{2} ) is therefore more informative than success rate, although the different query inputs still limit direct comparison. (3) EgoLoc states its L 2 L_{2} as an RMSE; the RMSE of our YOLO-World row is 1.80 m (mean 1.44, median 1.06), so our error is comparable if the published values are means and worse if they are RMSEs. (4) A small number of large errors raises our mean. With YOLO-World, 10% of queries have errors above 3 m and account for 26% of the total error. Excluding these queries lowers the mean to 1.19 m. Some misses may involve selecting the wrong instance of the same category, which a query crop could help distinguish. Errors also vary across clips: clip identity explains 42% of the L 2 L_{2} variance. This is consistent with differences in scale accuracy, but does not establish scale error as the cause.
paragraphs.zh: 必须结合表 19 阅读这五个差异。 (1) 该基准通过从 VQ2D 响应轨道中截取视觉图像来识别目标。 我们转而将对象的文本标题提供给语言模型，由其搜索预建记忆库，因此查询输入有所不同。 (2) 近期方法报告的成功率在 96%–99% 之间，而我们的评估采用固定容差，而非基于框大小的容差。 因此，定位误差（L₂ L_{2}）比成功率更具信息量，尽管不同的查询输入仍然限制了直接比较。 (3) EgoLoc 将其 L₂ L_{2} 表示为 RMSE；我们 YOLO-World 行的 RMSE 为 1.80 米（均值为 1.44，中位数为 1.06），因此如果已发表的值是均值，则我们的误差具有可比性；如果它们是 RMSE，则我们的误差更差。 (4) 少数较大的误差拉高了我们的均值。 在使用 YOLO-World 时，10% 的查询误差超过 3 米，并占总误差的 26%。 排除这些查询后，均值降至 1.19 米。 某些未命中可能涉及选择同一类别中的错误实例，而查询截图可能有助于区分这种情况。 误差在不同剪辑片段之间也存在差异：剪辑片段身份解释了 L₂ L_{2} 方差的 42%。 这与尺度准确性的差异一致，但并未证明尺度误差是根本原因。

sents.en: Five differences must be read with Table 19 .
sents.zh: 必须结合表 19 阅读这五个差异。

sents.en: (1) The benchmark identifies the target through a visual crop from the VQ2D response track.
sents.zh: (1) 该基准通过从 VQ2D 响应轨道中截取视觉图像来识别目标。

sents.en: We instead give the object’s text title to a language model that searches a pre-built memory, so the query input differs.
sents.zh: 我们转而将对象的文本标题提供给语言模型，由其搜索预建记忆库，因此查询输入有所不同。

sents.en: (2) Recent methods report success rates of 96–99%, and our evaluation uses a fixed tolerance rather than one based on box size.
sents.zh: (2) 近期方法报告的成功率在 96%–99% 之间，而我们的评估采用固定容差，而非基于框大小的容差。

sents.en: Localization error ( L 2 L_{2} ) is therefore more informative than success rate, although the different query inputs still limit direct comparison.
sents.zh: 因此，定位误差（L₂ L_{2}）比成功率更具信息量，尽管不同的查询输入仍然限制了直接比较。

sents.en: (3) EgoLoc states its L 2 L_{2} as an RMSE; the RMSE of our YOLO-World row is 1.80 m (mean 1.44, median 1.06), so our error is comparable if the published values are means and worse if they are RMSEs.
sents.zh: (3) EgoLoc 将其 L₂ L_{2} 表示为 RMSE；我们 YOLO-World 行的 RMSE 为 1.80 米（均值为 1.44，中位数为 1.06），因此如果已发表的值是均值，则我们的误差具有可比性；如果它们是 RMSE，则我们的误差更差。

sents.en: (4) A small number of large errors raises our mean.
sents.zh: (4) 少数较大的误差拉高了我们的均值。

sents.en: With YOLO-World, 10% of queries have errors above 3 m and account for 26% of the total error.
sents.zh: 在使用 YOLO-World 时，10% 的查询误差超过 3 米，并占总误差的 26%。

sents.en: Excluding these queries lowers the mean to 1.19 m.
sents.zh: 排除这些查询后，均值降至 1.19 米。

sents.en: Some misses may involve selecting the wrong instance of the same category, which a query crop could help distinguish.
sents.zh: 某些未命中可能涉及选择同一类别中的错误实例，而查询截图可能有助于区分这种情况。

sents.en: Errors also vary across clips: clip identity explains 42% of the L 2 L_{2} variance.
sents.zh: 误差在不同剪辑片段之间也存在差异：剪辑片段身份解释了 L₂ L_{2} 方差的 42%。

sents.en: This is consistent with differences in scale accuracy, but does not establish scale error as the cause.
sents.zh: 这与尺度准确性的差异一致，但并未证明尺度误差是根本原因。

paragraphs.en: (5) EAGLE combines depth estimates across views using confidence weights and multi-view consistency, then aligns them to the scan with a similarity transform that includes scale. Our method instead combines per-frame monocular position estimates using an unweighted median. Angular error was not computed. Switching from EgoLoc to FastVGGT poses moves the YOLO-World mean from 1.44 to 1.51 m, with per-query errors correlated at 0.92, so poses are not the difference. We never submitted to the test server, which requires the image crop as input.
paragraphs.zh: (5) EAGLE 使用置信度权重和多视图一致性来融合不同视角的深度估计值，然后通过包含比例变换的相似性变换将其与扫描数据对齐。 我们的方法则采用无加权中位数来融合每帧的单目位置估计值。 未计算角度误差。 从 EgoLoc 切换到 FastVGGT 位姿后，YOLO-World 的平均误差从 1.44 米变为 1.51 米，各查询的误差相关系数为 0.92，因此位姿差异并非简单的差值。 我们从未向测试服务器提交数据，因为该服务器要求以图像裁剪结果为输入。

sents.en: (5) EAGLE combines depth estimates across views using confidence weights and multi-view consistency, then aligns them to the scan with a similarity transform that includes scale.
sents.zh: (5) EAGLE 使用置信度权重和多视图一致性来融合不同视角的深度估计值，然后通过包含比例变换的相似性变换将其与扫描数据对齐。

sents.en: Our method instead combines per-frame monocular position estimates using an unweighted median.
sents.zh: 我们的方法则采用无加权中位数来融合每帧的单目位置估计值。

sents.en: Angular error was not computed.
sents.zh: 未计算角度误差。

sents.en: Switching from EgoLoc to FastVGGT poses moves the YOLO-World mean from 1.44 to 1.51 m, with per-query errors correlated at 0.92, so poses are not the difference.
sents.zh: 从 EgoLoc 切换到 FastVGGT 位姿后，YOLO-World 的平均误差从 1.44 米变为 1.51 米，各查询的误差相关系数为 0.92，因此位姿差异并非简单的差值。

sents.en: We never submitted to the test server, which requires the image crop as input.
sents.zh: 我们从未向测试服务器提交数据，因为该服务器要求以图像裁剪结果为输入。

paragraphs.en: We build every memory on the same 44 clips and query it with the same text: “Where is the ⟨ \langle title ⟩ \rangle ?” All methods use the same GPT-5.4 matcher and scoring procedure, and return positions in the scan coordinate frame. We use released code with default settings, changing only the adapters needed for this dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将所有记忆都构建在相同的 44 个剪辑片段之上，并使用相同的文本进行查询：“⟨ \langle title ⟩ \rangle 在哪里？”所有方法都使用相同的 GPT-5.4 匹配器和评分流程，并在扫描坐标框架中返回位置。 我们使用了已发布的代码及其默认设置，仅修改了该数据集所需的适配器。

sents.en: We build every memory on the same 44 clips and query it with the same text: “Where is the ⟨ \langle title ⟩ \rangle ?” All methods use the same GPT-5.4 matcher and scoring procedure, and return positions in the scan coordinate frame.
sents.zh: 我们将所有记忆都构建在相同的 44 个剪辑片段之上，并使用相同的文本进行查询：“⟨ \langle title ⟩ \rangle 在哪里？”所有方法都使用相同的 GPT-5.4 匹配器和评分流程，并在扫描坐标框架中返回位置。

sents.en: We use released code with default settings, changing only the adapters needed for this dataset.
sents.zh: 我们使用了已发布的代码及其默认设置，仅修改了该数据集所需的适配器。

paragraphs.en: ReMEmbR [ 2 ] uses VILA (Llama-3-VILA1.5-8B) to caption three-second windows and stores the corresponding EgoLoc camera centres. It returns the camera position associated with the retrieved memory, as its original implementation does. This localizes the wearer rather than the object.
paragraphs.zh: ReMEmbR [ 2 ] 使用 VILA (Llama-3-VILA1.5-8B) 为三秒的视频窗口生成描述，并存储相应的 EgoLoc 相机中心位置。 与原始实现一样，它会返回与检索到的记忆相关联的相机位置。 这种方法定位的是佩戴者，而非物体本身。

sents.en: ReMEmbR [ 2 ] uses VILA (Llama-3-VILA1.5-8B) to caption three-second windows and stores the corresponding EgoLoc camera centres.
sents.zh: ReMEmbR [ 2 ] 使用 VILA (Llama-3-VILA1.5-8B) 为三秒的视频窗口生成描述，并存储相应的 EgoLoc 相机中心位置。

sents.en: It returns the camera position associated with the retrieved memory, as its original implementation does.
sents.zh: 与原始实现一样，它会返回与检索到的记忆相关联的相机位置。

sents.en: This localizes the wearer rather than the object.
sents.zh: 这种方法定位的是佩戴者，而非物体本身。

paragraphs.en: DirectMe [ 49 ] builds its graph at 1 fps using the Objects365 vocabulary, YOLO-World, SAM 2, and Depth Anything 3. We align the graph to the scan using a similarity transform fitted to each clip’s camera trajectory, with a camera RMS error of 0.58 m. The answerer receives no frames at query time.
paragraphs.zh: DirectMe [ 49 ] 使用 Objects365 词汇表、YOLO-World、SAM 2 和 Depth Anything 3，以每秒 1 帧的速度构建其图。 我们通过将相似性变换拟合到每个剪辑的相机轨迹，并将相机 RMS 误差设为 0.58 米，从而将图与扫描数据对齐。 回答者在查询时不会接收到任何帧。

sents.en: DirectMe [ 49 ] builds its graph at 1 fps using the Objects365 vocabulary, YOLO-World, SAM 2, and Depth Anything 3.
sents.zh: DirectMe [ 49 ] 使用 Objects365 词汇表、YOLO-World、SAM 2 和 Depth Anything 3，以每秒 1 帧的速度构建其图。

sents.en: We align the graph to the scan using a similarity transform fitted to each clip’s camera trajectory, with a camera RMS error of 0.58 m.
sents.zh: 我们通过将相似性变换拟合到每个剪辑的相机轨迹，并将相机 RMS 误差设为 0.58 米，从而将图与扫描数据对齐。

sents.en: The answerer receives no frames at query time.
sents.zh: 回答者在查询时不会接收到任何帧。

paragraphs.en: OSNOM [ 36 ] uses our SAM 3 detections converted to VISOR-format masks, together with FastVGGT poses and depth. The estimated depth replaces its usual depth rendered from a COLMAP mesh. It returns the selected track’s 3D location. AMEGO [ 16 ] stores hand–object interaction tracklets without object names or 3D positions, so it cannot answer these queries. The no-memory reference always returns the clip’s mean camera position.
paragraphs.zh: OSNOM [ 36 ] 使用我们转换成的 VISOR 格式掩码的 SAM 3 检测结果，以及 FastVGGT 的姿势和深度数据。 估计的深度取代了通常从 COLMAP 网格渲染出的深度。 它会返回所选轨迹的三维位置。 AMEGO [ 16 ] 存储的手–物体交互轨迹片段不包含物体名称或三维位置，因此无法回答这些查询。 无记忆参考始终返回剪辑中的平均相机位置。

sents.en: OSNOM [ 36 ] uses our SAM 3 detections converted to VISOR-format masks, together with FastVGGT poses and depth.
sents.zh: OSNOM [ 36 ] 使用我们转换成的 VISOR 格式掩码的 SAM 3 检测结果，以及 FastVGGT 的姿势和深度数据。

sents.en: The estimated depth replaces its usual depth rendered from a COLMAP mesh.
sents.zh: 估计的深度取代了通常从 COLMAP 网格渲染出的深度。

sents.en: It returns the selected track’s 3D location.
sents.zh: 它会返回所选轨迹的三维位置。

sents.en: AMEGO [ 16 ] stores hand–object interaction tracklets without object names or 3D positions, so it cannot answer these queries.
sents.zh: AMEGO [ 16 ] 存储的手–物体交互轨迹片段不包含物体名称或三维位置，因此无法回答这些查询。

sents.en: The no-memory reference always returns the clip’s mean camera position.
sents.zh: 无记忆参考始终返回剪辑中的平均相机位置。

paragraphs.en: We re-evaluated our variants through this shared protocol on 2026-09-21. Their scores agree with the earlier results in Table 17 within answering variation. Table 21 compares methods on the 138 queries answered by every method capable of returning a position.
paragraphs.zh: 我们于 2026-09-21 通过这一共享协议重新评估了我们的变体。 在回答差异范围内，它们的得分与表 17 中的早期结果一致。 表 21 比较了所有能够返回位置的方法在 138 个查询上的表现。

sents.en: We re-evaluated our variants through this shared protocol on 2026-09-21.
sents.zh: 我们于 2026-09-21 通过这一共享协议重新评估了我们的变体。

sents.en: Their scores agree with the earlier results in Table 17 within answering variation.
sents.zh: 在回答差异范围内，它们的得分与表 17 中的早期结果一致。

sents.en: Table 21 compares methods on the 138 queries answered by every method capable of returning a position.
sents.zh: 表 21 比较了所有能够返回位置的方法在 138 个查询上的表现。

paragraphs.en: SAM 3’s reported time varies with the vocabulary (73–131 tags), whereas the YOLO variants batch prompts. These measurements do not include 3D lifting, consolidation, or descriptions, and are not an end-to-end system speedup. Table 22 also shows that more detections or greater box agreement with SAM 3 need not correspond to lower downstream localization error.
paragraphs.zh: SAM 3 报告的时间会因词汇表（73–131 个标签）而异，而 YOLO 的变体则对提示进行批量处理。 这些测量值不包括三维提升、整合或描述，也不是端到端系统的速度提升。 表 22 还显示，更多的检测或与 SAM 3 更高的框匹配度并不一定意味着下游定位误差更低。

sents.en: SAM 3’s reported time varies with the vocabulary (73–131 tags), whereas the YOLO variants batch prompts.
sents.zh: SAM 3 报告的时间会因词汇表（73–131 个标签）而异，而 YOLO 的变体则对提示进行批量处理。

sents.en: These measurements do not include 3D lifting, consolidation, or descriptions, and are not an end-to-end system speedup.
sents.zh: 这些测量值不包括三维提升、整合或描述，也不是端到端系统的速度提升。

sents.en: Table 22 also shows that more detections or greater box agreement with SAM 3 need not correspond to lower downstream localization error.
sents.zh: 表 22 还显示，更多的检测或与 SAM 3 更高的框匹配度并不一定意味着下游定位误差更低。

paragraphs.en: Coverage estimates vary substantially with the model used to judge whether the query object appears in the tag set. For Qwen tags, both judges accept 108 queries and reject 27. GPT alone accepts another 27, while Qwen alone accepts two. Of these disagreements, 19 in the first group and both in the second contain the exact query word among the tags. A semantic judge can therefore reject even an exact word match.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖范围估计因所用模型而异，该模型用于判断查询对象是否出现在标签集中。 对于 Qwen 标签，两种判断方法都接受 108 个查询并拒绝 27 个。 GPT 单独使用时还接受了另外 27 个，而 Qwen 单独使用时则接受了两个。 在这些分歧中，第一组有 19 个，第二组有两个，其中都包含与标签完全一致的查询词。 因此，语义判断方法甚至可能拒绝完全匹配的词语。

sents.zh: 覆盖范围估计因所用模型而异，该模型用于判断查询对象是否出现在标签集中。

sents.en: For Qwen tags, both judges accept 108 queries and reject 27.
sents.zh: 对于 Qwen 标签，两种判断方法都接受 108 个查询并拒绝 27 个。

sents.en: GPT alone accepts another 27, while Qwen alone accepts two.
sents.zh: GPT 单独使用时还接受了另外 27 个，而 Qwen 单独使用时则接受了两个。

sents.en: Of these disagreements, 19 in the first group and both in the second contain the exact query word among the tags.
sents.zh: 在这些分歧中，第一组有 19 个，第二组有两个，其中都包含与标签完全一致的查询词。

sents.en: A semantic judge can therefore reject even an exact word match.
sents.zh: 因此，语义判断方法甚至可能拒绝完全匹配的词语。

paragraphs.en: A matching tag only indicates vocabulary coverage. It does not show that the object was detected, that the correct instance was identified, or that its position was estimated correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 匹配标签仅表示词汇覆盖范围。 它并未表明该对象已被检测、正确的实例已被识别，或其位置已被正确估计。

sents.en: A matching tag only indicates vocabulary coverage.

paragraphs.en: UCS-Bench contains 8,114 timestamped questions across 532 videos from EgoLife, TeleEgo, HourVideo, EPIC-Kitchens, and EgoBlind. It provides no camera poses, intrinsics, or query boxes [ 49 ] . Most questions have five options; Proximity & Reachability questions have two, giving an overall chance accuracy of 25.7%. Our main evaluation uses 189 EgoLife recordings with 2,569 questions and 22 TeleEgo recordings with 203 questions. Tables 3 and 24 report the 2,771 questions shared across all conditions. We discuss HourVideo separately below.
paragraphs.zh: UCS-Bench 包含来自 EgoLife、TeleEgo、HourVideo、EPIC-Kitchens 和 EgoBlind 的 532 个视频中的 8,114 条带有时间戳的问题。 它不提供相机姿态、内参或查询框 [ 49 ] 。 大多数问题有五个选项；“邻近性”和“可达性”问题有两个选项，因此整体准确率概率为 25.7%。 我们的主要评估使用了 189 段 EgoLife 录像（含 2,569 个问题）和 22 段 TeleEgo 录像（含 203 个问题）。 表 3 和表 24 报告了所有条件下共有的 2,771 个问题。 我们在下文单独讨论 HourVideo。

sents.en: UCS-Bench contains 8,114 timestamped questions across 532 videos from EgoLife, TeleEgo, HourVideo, EPIC-Kitchens, and EgoBlind.
sents.zh: UCS-Bench 包含来自 EgoLife、TeleEgo、HourVideo、EPIC-Kitchens 和 EgoBlind 的 532 个视频中的 8,114 条带有时间戳的问题。

sents.en: It provides no camera poses, intrinsics, or query boxes [ 49 ] .
sents.zh: 它不提供相机姿态、内参或查询框 [ 49 ] 。

sents.en: Most questions have five options; Proximity & Reachability questions have two, giving an overall chance accuracy of 25.7%.
sents.zh: 大多数问题有五个选项；“邻近性”和“可达性”问题有两个选项，因此整体准确率概率为 25.7%。

sents.en: Our main evaluation uses 189 EgoLife recordings with 2,569 questions and 22 TeleEgo recordings with 203 questions.
sents.zh: 我们的主要评估使用了 189 段 EgoLife 录像（含 2,569 个问题）和 22 段 TeleEgo 录像（含 203 个问题）。

sents.en: Tables 3 and 24 report the 2,771 questions shared across all conditions.
sents.zh: 表 3 和表 24 报告了所有条件下共有的 2,771 个问题。

sents.en: We discuss HourVideo separately below.
sents.zh: 我们在下文单独讨论 HourVideo。

paragraphs.en: We sample one frame every four seconds and use the same pipeline as on HD-EPIC: Qwen3.5-9B for tagging, YOLO-World for detection, WildDet3D for 3D lifting, SAM 3 for consolidation, followed by persistence segmentation and segment descriptions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们每四秒采样一帧，并使用与 HD-EPIC 相同的处理流程：Qwen3.5-9B 用于标签标注，YOLO-World 用于检测，WildDet3D 用于三维提升，SAM 3 用于整合，随后进行持续性分割和分段描述。

paragraphs.en: We use Depth Anything 3 poses when they pass three consistency checks: a chunk-alignment residual of at most 0.5 m, chunk scales within [ 0.8 , 1.25 ] [0.8,1.25] , and camera steps of at most 6 m. Otherwise, we use FastVGGT. Circular-fisheye recordings go directly to FastVGGT. We attempt metric scale recovery using pairs of observations of the same object. This fails for most recordings and all TeleEgo recordings, so their distances remain in scene units.
paragraphs.zh: 当深度估计通过三项一致性检查时，我们使用 Depth Anything 3 的姿态：块对齐残差最多为 0.5 米，块缩放比例在 [0.8, 1.25] 范围内，且相机步长最多为 6 米。 否则，我们使用 FastVGGT。 圆形鱼眼镜头的录制数据直接输入 FastVGGT。 我们尝试利用对同一物体的成对观测来恢复度量尺度。 大多数录制数据和所有 TeleEgo 录制数据都无法成功恢复，因此其距离仍以场景单位表示。

sents.en: We use Depth Anything 3 poses when they pass three consistency checks: a chunk-alignment residual of at most 0.5 m, chunk scales within [ 0.8 , 1.25 ] [0.8,1.25] , and camera steps of at most 6 m.
sents.zh: 当深度估计通过三项一致性检查时，我们使用 Depth Anything 3 的姿态：块对齐残差最多为 0.5 米，块缩放比例在 [0.8, 1.25] 范围内，且相机步长最多为 6 米。

sents.en: Otherwise, we use FastVGGT.
sents.zh: 否则，我们使用 FastVGGT。

sents.zh: 圆形鱼眼镜头的录制数据直接输入 FastVGGT。

sents.zh: 我们尝试利用对同一物体的成对观测来恢复度量尺度。

sents.en: This fails for most recordings and all TeleEgo recordings, so their distances remain in scene units.
sents.zh: 大多数录制数据和所有 TeleEgo 录制数据都无法成功恢复，因此其距离仍以场景单位表示。

paragraphs.en: For each question, we filter the memory at its timestamp. We remove later observations, segments, and descriptions, truncate the current segment and wearer path, and recompute positions. We also withhold object summaries written using all segments. The adapter ranks entries by
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个问题，我们都会根据时间戳筛选记忆内容。 我们会移除后续的观察结果、片段和描述，截断当前片段和穿戴者路径，并重新计算位置。 我们还会保留使用所有片段编写而成的物体摘要。 适配器会按照……对条目进行排序。

sents.en: For each question, we filter the memory at its timestamp.
sents.zh: 对于每个问题，我们都会根据时间戳筛选记忆内容。

sents.en: We remove later observations, segments, and descriptions, truncate the current segment and wearer path, and recompute positions.
sents.zh: 我们会移除后续的观察结果、片段和描述，截断当前片段和穿戴者路径，并重新计算位置。

sents.en: We also withhold object summaries written using all segments.
sents.zh: 我们还会保留使用所有片段编写而成的物体摘要。

sents.en: The adapter ranks entries by
sents.zh: 适配器会按照……对条目进行排序。

paragraphs.en: where n name n_{\rm name} and n desc n_{\rm desc} count question-word matches in names and descriptions, and Δ ​ t \Delta t is the time gap to the nearest observation in seconds. The answerer receives the top four entries and the wearer’s path.
paragraphs.zh: 其中 n name n_{\rm name} 和 n desc n_{\rm desc} 统计名称和描述中问题词的出现次数，而 Δ ​ t \Delta t 是到最近一次观察的时间间隔（单位：秒）。 回答者会收到排名靠前的四条记录以及佩戴者的路径。

sents.en: where n name n_{\rm name} and n desc n_{\rm desc} count question-word matches in names and descriptions, and Δ ​ t \Delta t is the time gap to the nearest observation in seconds.
sents.zh: 其中 n name n_{\rm name} 和 n desc n_{\rm desc} 统计名称和描述中问题词的出现次数，而 Δ ​ t \Delta t 是到最近一次观察的时间间隔（单位：秒）。

sents.en: The answerer receives the top four entries and the wearer’s path.
sents.zh: 回答者会收到排名靠前的四条记录以及佩戴者的路径。

paragraphs.en: Every condition uses GPT-5.4 with one call per question. Blind receives only the question and options. Memory also receives the filtered memory as text. Frames receives 48 frames at 448 pixels, sampled uniformly from the recording’s start to the question time. The benchmark uses 64 frames; we use 48 because this is the API limit.
paragraphs.zh: 每个条件都使用 GPT-5.4，每道题仅调用一次。 Blind 仅接收问题和选项。 Memory 也以文本形式接收过滤后的记忆内容。 Frames 接收 48 帧、分辨率为 448 像素的图像，这些图像从记录开始到问题出现的时间段内均匀采样。 该基准测试使用 64 帧；我们使用 48 帧，因为这是 API 的限制。

sents.en: Every condition uses GPT-5.4 with one call per question.
sents.zh: 每个条件都使用 GPT-5.4，每道题仅调用一次。

sents.en: Blind receives only the question and options.
sents.zh: Blind 仅接收问题和选项。

sents.en: Memory also receives the filtered memory as text.
sents.zh: Memory 也以文本形式接收过滤后的记忆内容。

sents.en: Frames receives 48 frames at 448 pixels, sampled uniformly from the recording’s start to the question time.
sents.zh: Frames 接收 48 帧、分辨率为 448 像素的图像，这些图像从记录开始到问题出现的时间段内均匀采样。

sents.en: The benchmark uses 64 frames; we use 48 because this is the API limit.
sents.zh: 该基准测试使用 64 帧；我们使用 48 帧，因为这是 API 的限制。

paragraphs.en: Frames + memory adds memory text on spatial questions identified by a keyword rule, covering about 55% of questions. Adding memory to every question gives no gain over frames alone ( − 0.8 -0.8 points, n.s.), and a split-roles prompt does not improve this result. When the API’s image filter rejects frames, we fall back to the text condition. This affects 10–18% of EgoLife questions; restricting evaluation to questions whose images are never rejected gives the same differences.
paragraphs.zh: 框架 + 记忆机制通过关键词规则为空间问题添加记忆文本，覆盖了约 55% 的问题。 为每个问题都添加记忆机制并未比仅使用框架带来任何提升（−0.8 分，无显著性），而角色拆分提示也未改善这一结果。 当 API 的图像过滤器拒绝框架时，我们会转而使用文本条件。 这种情况影响了 EgoLife 中 10%–18% 的问题；若将评估限制在图像从未被拒绝的问题上，结果差异依然相同。

sents.en: Frames + memory adds memory text on spatial questions identified by a keyword rule, covering about 55% of questions.
sents.zh: 框架 + 记忆机制通过关键词规则为空间问题添加记忆文本，覆盖了约 55% 的问题。

sents.en: Adding memory to every question gives no gain over frames alone ( − 0.8 -0.8 points, n.s.), and a split-roles prompt does not improve this result.
sents.zh: 为每个问题都添加记忆机制并未比仅使用框架带来任何提升（−0.8 分，无显著性），而角色拆分提示也未改善这一结果。

sents.en: When the API’s image filter rejects frames, we fall back to the text condition.
sents.zh: 当 API 的图像过滤器拒绝框架时，我们会转而使用文本条件。

sents.en: This affects 10–18% of EgoLife questions; restricting evaluation to questions whose images are never rejected gives the same differences.
sents.zh: 这种情况影响了 EgoLife 中 10%–18% 的问题；若将评估限制在图像从未被拒绝的问题上，结果差异依然相同。

paragraphs.en: We run DirectMe [ 49 ] with its released graph builder and retrieval, using the Objects365 vocabulary, YOLO-World, SAM 2, and Depth Anything 3 at 1 fps. Its memory-only condition receives the graph as text. We test frames plus graph both with the graph always included, as in its original configuration, and with the same spatial-question routing used for our memory. DirectMe’s own prompt without the graph scores 31.0%. Its single-threaded builder scales super-linearly with graph size, taking 7–40 hours for a 40-minute stream. We therefore use a batched wrapper, verified to produce identical output.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以 1 fps 的速度运行 DirectMe [ 49 ]，使用其已发布的图构建和检索模块，并采用 Objects365 词汇表、YOLO-World、SAM 2 和 Depth Anything 3。 在仅使用内存的模式下，它以文本形式接收该图。 我们测试了包含帧和图的情况：既包括始终包含图的原始配置，也包括与我们内存模块相同的空间问题路由方式。 DirectMe 自身不带图的提示得分是 31.0%。 其单线程构建器随图的大小呈现超线性扩展，处理一个 40 分钟的视频流需要 7–40 小时。 因此，我们使用了一个批处理包装器，并验证了其输出结果完全一致。

sents.en: We run DirectMe [ 49 ] with its released graph builder and retrieval, using the Objects365 vocabulary, YOLO-World, SAM 2, and Depth Anything 3 at 1 fps.
sents.zh: 我们以 1 fps 的速度运行 DirectMe [ 49 ]，使用其已发布的图构建和检索模块，并采用 Objects365 词汇表、YOLO-World、SAM 2 和 Depth Anything 3。

sents.en: Its memory-only condition receives the graph as text.
sents.zh: 在仅使用内存的模式下，它以文本形式接收该图。

sents.en: We test frames plus graph both with the graph always included, as in its original configuration, and with the same spatial-question routing used for our memory.
sents.zh: 我们测试了包含帧和图的情况：既包括始终包含图的原始配置，也包括与我们内存模块相同的空间问题路由方式。

sents.en: DirectMe’s own prompt without the graph scores 31.0%.
sents.zh: DirectMe 自身不带图的提示得分是 31.0%。

sents.en: Its single-threaded builder scales super-linearly with graph size, taking 7–40 hours for a 40-minute stream.
sents.zh: 其单线程构建器随图的大小呈现超线性扩展，处理一个 40 分钟的视频流需要 7–40 小时。

sents.en: We therefore use a batched wrapper, verified to produce identical output.
sents.zh: 因此，我们使用了一个批处理包装器，并验证了其输出结果完全一致。

paragraphs.en: We compare conditions on the same questions using exact McNemar tests. Our memory outperforms DirectMe’s graph by 8.6 points ( p < 10 − 12 p<10^{-12} ) and the blind control by 4.7 points ( p < 10 − 4 p<10^{-4} ). DirectMe’s graph scores 1.0 point below its own blind prompt ( p = 0.32 p=0.32 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用精确的麦克尼马尔检验来比较同一问题上的不同条件。 我们的记忆系统在得分上比 DirectMe 的图模型高出 8.6 分（p < 10⁻¹²），比盲控模型高出 4.7 分（p < 10⁻⁴）。 DirectMe 的图模型得分比其自身的盲提示低 1.0 分（p = 0.32）。

sents.en: We compare conditions on the same questions using exact McNemar tests.
sents.zh: 我们使用精确的麦克尼马尔检验来比较同一问题上的不同条件。

sents.en: Our memory outperforms DirectMe’s graph by 8.6 points ( p < 10 − 12 p<10^{-12} ) and the blind control by 4.7 points ( p < 10 − 4 p<10^{-4} ).
sents.zh: 我们的记忆系统在得分上比 DirectMe 的图模型高出 8.6 分（p < 10⁻¹²），比盲控模型高出 4.7 分（p < 10⁻⁴）。

sents.en: DirectMe’s graph scores 1.0 point below its own blind prompt ( p = 0.32 p=0.32 ).
sents.zh: DirectMe 的图模型得分比其自身的盲提示低 1.0 分（p = 0.32）。

paragraphs.en: With frames, our memory outperforms DirectMe’s graph by 3.4 points under the same routing ( p = 0.0005 p=0.0005 ) and improves on frames alone by 1.9 points ( p = 0.047 p=0.047 ). Adding DirectMe’s graph lowers accuracy relative to frames alone by 1.4 points with our routing ( p = 0.13 p=0.13 ) and 4.6 points in its original configuration ( p < 10 − 5 p<10^{-5} ).
paragraphs.zh: 在相同的路由条件下，使用框架后，我们的记忆性能比 DirectMe 的图高出 3.4 分（p = 0.0005 p=0.0005），并且相比仅使用框架的情况提升了 1.9 分（p = 0.047 p=0.047）。 添加 DirectMe 的图后，与仅使用框架的情况相比，在我们的路由配置下准确率下降了 1.4 分（p = 0.13 p=0.13），而在其原始配置中则下降了 4.6 分（p < 10^{-5} p<10^{-5}）。

sents.en: With frames, our memory outperforms DirectMe’s graph by 3.4 points under the same routing ( p = 0.0005 p=0.0005 ) and improves on frames alone by 1.9 points ( p = 0.047 p=0.047 ).
sents.zh: 在相同的路由条件下，使用框架后，我们的记忆性能比 DirectMe 的图高出 3.4 分（p = 0.0005 p=0.0005），并且相比仅使用框架的情况提升了 1.9 分（p = 0.047 p=0.047）。

sents.en: Adding DirectMe’s graph lowers accuracy relative to frames alone by 1.4 points with our routing ( p = 0.13 p=0.13 ) and 4.6 points in its original configuration ( p < 10 − 5 p<10^{-5} ).
sents.zh: 添加 DirectMe 的图后，与仅使用框架的情况相比，在我们的路由配置下准确率下降了 1.4 分（p = 0.13 p=0.13），而在其原始配置中则下降了 4.6 分（p < 10^{-5} p<10^{-5}）。

paragraphs.en: DirectMe uses a deterministic counting rule on 297 of the 2,771 questions, answering only 4.7% correctly. Excluding these questions, our memory still outperforms its graph by 6.1 points without frames.
paragraphs.zh: DirectMe 对 2,771 个问题中的 297 个应用了确定性计数规则，但正确率仅为 4.7%。 排除这些问题后，即使没有帧结构，我们的记忆表现仍比其图模型高出 6.1 分。

sents.en: DirectMe uses a deterministic counting rule on 297 of the 2,771 questions, answering only 4.7% correctly.
sents.zh: DirectMe 对 2,771 个问题中的 297 个应用了确定性计数规则，但正确率仅为 4.7%。

sents.en: Excluding these questions, our memory still outperforms its graph by 6.1 points without frames.
sents.zh: 排除这些问题后，即使没有帧结构，我们的记忆表现仍比其图模型高出 6.1 分。

paragraphs.en: Repeated frame-based runs on identical inputs change 16–20% of selected answers. On an earlier set of 1,581 questions, averaging two runs gives a frames-plus-memory gain over frames alone of 0.9 points, with an interval of [ − 1.1 , + 3.0 ] [-1.1,+3.0] . These checks suggest that single-run differences below roughly 1.5 points may reflect answering variation.
paragraphs.zh: 对相同输入进行重复的基于帧的运行，会使 16%–20% 的所选答案发生变化。 在早期的一组包含 1,581 个问题的测试中，两次运行的平均值显示，与仅使用帧相比，结合帧和记忆的方法提升了 0.9 分，区间为 [ − 1.1 , + 3.0 ] [-1.1,+3.0]。 这些检查表明，单次运行之间的差异若低于大约 1.5 分，可能反映了回答上的差异。

sents.en: Repeated frame-based runs on identical inputs change 16–20% of selected answers.
sents.zh: 对相同输入进行重复的基于帧的运行，会使 16%–20% 的所选答案发生变化。

sents.en: On an earlier set of 1,581 questions, averaging two runs gives a frames-plus-memory gain over frames alone of 0.9 points, with an interval of [ − 1.1 , + 3.0 ] [-1.1,+3.0] .
sents.zh: 在早期的一组包含 1,581 个问题的测试中，两次运行的平均值显示，与仅使用帧相比，结合帧和记忆的方法提升了 0.9 分，区间为 [ − 1.1 , + 3.0 ] [-1.1,+3.0]。

sents.en: These checks suggest that single-run differences below roughly 1.5 points may reflect answering variation.
sents.zh: 这些检查表明，单次运行之间的差异若低于大约 1.5 分，可能反映了回答上的差异。

paragraphs.en: The UCS-Bench paper reports DirectMe with Qwen3-VL-8B, 64 frames, and graph plus keyframes on the full 8,114-question benchmark at 50.5% overall (54.1 / 47.6 / 58.0 / 46.4 by category) against 44.0% for the same model with frames only (44.6 / 40.1 / 50.9 / 42.9); it reports no graph-only number. Those numbers use a different answerer and question set and are not comparable with Table 3 . The paper’s setting with Qwen3-VL was not rerun.
paragraphs.zh: UCS-Bench 论文报告了 DirectMe 在 Qwen3-VL-8B、64 帧以及完整 8,114 个问题基准测试中结合图与关键帧的表现，总准确率为 50.5%（按类别分为 54.1 / 47.6 / 58.0 / 46.4），而同一模型仅使用帧时的准确率为 44.0%（44.6 / 40.1 / 50.9 / 42.9）；论文未报告仅使用图时的数据。 这些数字使用了不同的回答者和问题集，因此无法与表 3 中的数据进行比较。 该论文中基于 Qwen3-VL 的设置并未重新运行。

sents.en: The UCS-Bench paper reports DirectMe with Qwen3-VL-8B, 64 frames, and graph plus keyframes on the full 8,114-question benchmark at 50.5% overall (54.1 / 47.6 / 58.0 / 46.4 by category) against 44.0% for the same model with frames only (44.6 / 40.1 / 50.9 / 42.9); it reports no graph-only number.
sents.zh: UCS-Bench 论文报告了 DirectMe 在 Qwen3-VL-8B、64 帧以及完整 8,114 个问题基准测试中结合图与关键帧的表现，总准确率为 50.5%（按类别分为 54.1 / 47.6 / 58.0 / 46.4），而同一模型仅使用帧时的准确率为 44.0%（44.6 / 40.1 / 50.9 / 42.9）；论文未报告仅使用图时的数据。

sents.zh: 这些数字使用了不同的回答者和问题集，因此无法与表 3 中的数据进行比较。

sents.en: The paper’s setting with Qwen3-VL was not rerun.
sents.zh: 该论文中基于 Qwen3-VL 的设置并未重新运行。

paragraphs.en: Paired against blind, the memory gains + 4.9 +4.9 on EgoLife ( p < 10 − 4 p<10^{-4} ), + 2.0 +2.0 on TeleEgo (n.s.), and + 1.4 +1.4 on HourVideo (n.s.); pooled + 4.3 +4.3 [ + 2.3 , + 6.3 ] [+2.3,+6.3] (Table 25 ). On TeleEgo the questioned noun is absent from the memory as a track for 40 to 60% of questions and every pose set is unscaled. On HourVideo (20 to 96 minutes, median 30) only 21 of 167 memories were built: the tracking stage scales worse than linearly with the number of instances, 50 to 60-minute recordings hold about 4,000, and the measured cost reached 74 to 3,500 hours per recording, so the build was stopped. On the 21 built, adding the memory to the frames costs 3.6 points ( p = 0.20 p=0.20 ), with − 16.5 -16.5 on Relative Position ( p = 0.004 p=0.004 ), the opposite of EgoLife, where the memory adds 5 to 6 points on the two egocentric-geometry subcategories.
paragraphs.zh: 在与盲测结果的对比中，记忆系统在 EgoLife 上的得分提升了 +4.9（p < 10⁻⁴），在 TeleEgo 上提升了 +2.0（无显著性），在 HourVideo 上提升了 +1.4（无显著性）；综合来看，提升幅度为 +4.3（[+2.3, +6.3]）（表 25）。 在 TeleEgo 中，被提问的名词在记忆系统中作为追踪线索缺失的比例为 40% 至 60%，且所有姿态集合均未进行缩放。 在 HourVideo 中（时长 20 至 96 分钟，中位数为 30 分钟），167 个记忆系统中仅有 21 个成功构建：追踪阶段的表现随实例数量增长的速度低于线性关系；50 至 60 分钟的录像包含约 4,000 个实例，而测得的成本达到每段录像 74 至 3,500 小时，因此构建过程被中止。 在这 21 个成功构建的记忆系统中，将记忆添加到帧中的成本为 3.6 分（p = 0.20），其中相对位置得分下降了 −16.5（p = 0.004），这与 EgoLife 的情况相反——在 EgoLife 中，记忆系统为两个以自我为中心的几何子类别分别增加了 5 至 6 分。

paragraphs.en: No use of the memory helps counting (Table 26 ), and showing its counts to the answerer costs 6.4 points ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). We evaluate counts on 257 questions with numeric answers whose target noun appears in memory. Counting tracks gives the correct answer on 11% of questions and is within one on 22%. The median estimate is seven objects, compared with a true count of three. Using the largest number of tracks visible in a single frame improves these rates to 16% and 45%, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 任何对记忆的使用都有助于计数（表26），而向回答者展示计数结果会损失6.4分（p < 0.001 p<0.001）。 我们在257个具有数值答案的问题上评估了计数效果，这些问题的目标名词都出现在记忆中。 计数追踪在11%的问题中给出了正确答案，在22%的问题中误差未超过一个。 估计值的中位数为七个物体，而实际数量仅为三个。 使用单帧中可见的最多追踪线可将这些准确率分别提升至16%和45%。

paragraphs.en: The memory both splits one object into several tracks and misses other objects. On recordings without metric scale, the consolidation step’s fixed 3D-distance threshold blocks 98% of proposed merges. Removing this check reduces the number of stored objects from 6,490 to 4,404 across 12 recordings, without lowering measured overall accuracy. Counting remains unresolved: the two configurations score 33.7% and 31.6% on 95 counting questions, both below the 35.8% blind score. Frames help with action and people counts, but object counts remain near the blind baseline. These results point to instance association and consistent geometric scale during construction as priorities for improving object counts.
paragraphs.zh: 该记忆机制既会将一个对象拆分成多个轨迹，又会遗漏其他对象。 在没有度量尺度的记录中，整合步骤固定的三维距离阈值会阻止 98% 的拟议合并操作。 移除这一检查后，在 12 段记录中存储的对象数量从 6,490 减少到 4,404，但测得的总体准确率并未下降。 计数问题仍未解决：两种配置在 95 道计数问题上的得分分别为 33.7% 和 31.6%，均低于 35.8% 的盲测得分。 帧数据有助于动作和人物计数，但对象计数仍接近盲测基线水平。 这些结果表明，在构建过程中，实例关联和一致的几何尺度是提升对象计数的关键优先事项。

paragraphs.en: We developed the adapter on a ten-video pilot with 138 questions. These results are therefore not a held-out evaluation. The first version scored 36.2%, compared with 25.4% for the blind control, but included future evidence. On 57 questions, it retrieved a candidate first observed after the question time, and 43.6% of the displayed path waypoints were in the future. We exclude this gain from our claims.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个包含 138 个问题的十视频试点项目上开发了该适配器。 因此，这些结果并非来自预留的测试集评估。 第一版得分为 36.2%，而盲控组为 25.4%，但这一分数包含了未来证据。 在 57 个问题中，它检索到了一个在问题出现时间之后首次观察到的候选项，且所显示路径中 43.6% 的路点位于未来。 我们在主张中排除了这一提升。

sents.en: We developed the adapter on a ten-video pilot with 138 questions.
sents.zh: 我们在一个包含 138 个问题的十视频试点项目上开发了该适配器。

sents.en: These results are therefore not a held-out evaluation.
sents.zh: 因此，这些结果并非来自预留的测试集评估。

sents.en: The first version scored 36.2%, compared with 25.4% for the blind control, but included future evidence.
sents.zh: 第一版得分为 36.2%，而盲控组为 25.4%，但这一分数包含了未来证据。

sents.en: On 57 questions, it retrieved a candidate first observed after the question time, and 43.6% of the displayed path waypoints were in the future.
sents.zh: 在 57 个问题中，它检索到了一个在问题出现时间之后首次观察到的候选项，且所显示路径中 43.6% 的路点位于未来。
