sents.zh: 我们在主张中排除了这一提升。

paragraphs.en: The timestamp filtering described above removes explicit future evidence from the prompt. On the pilot, the filtered memory scores 38.4% with GPT-5.4, compared with 31.9% blind: a gain of 6.5 points with an interval of [ − 2.9 , + 15.9 ] [-2.9,+15.9] . Direction labels, relation episodes, and place context provide no measurable additional gain.
paragraphs.zh: 上述描述的时间戳过滤机制会从提示中移除明确指向未来的证据。 在试点测试中，经过过滤的记忆在 GPT-5.4 上的得分为 38.4%，而盲测得分为 31.9%：这意味着得分提升了 6.5 分，置信区间为 [ − 2.9 , + 15.9 ] [-2.9,+15.9]。 方向标签、关系事件和地点上下文均未带来可测量的额外增益。

sents.en: The timestamp filtering described above removes explicit future evidence from the prompt.
sents.zh: 上述描述的时间戳过滤机制会从提示中移除明确指向未来的证据。

sents.en: On the pilot, the filtered memory scores 38.4% with GPT-5.4, compared with 31.9% blind: a gain of 6.5 points with an interval of [ − 2.9 , + 15.9 ] [-2.9,+15.9] .
sents.zh: 在试点测试中，经过过滤的记忆在 GPT-5.4 上的得分为 38.4%，而盲测得分为 31.9%：这意味着得分提升了 6.5 分，置信区间为 [ − 2.9 , + 15.9 ] [-2.9,+15.9]。

sents.en: Direction labels, relation episodes, and place context provide no measurable additional gain.
sents.zh: 方向标签、关系事件和地点上下文均未带来可测量的额外增益。

paragraphs.en: However, construction still uses the full recording. The vocabulary draws on frames throughout the video, and pose estimation, consolidation, and segmentation all run offline. Filtering their outputs does not show that earlier memory states are independent of later frames. To establish this, we would need to build every stage using only footage available by each query time and verify that appending footage does not change those earlier states. We therefore describe these runs as timestamp-filtered, rather than as a validated streaming evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，构建过程仍然使用了完整的记录。 词汇表参考了视频中的所有帧，而姿态估计、整合和分割均在离线状态下运行。 过滤它们的输出并未表明早期的记忆状态与后续帧相互独立。 为了证实这一点，我们需要在每一查询时刻仅使用当时可用的画面来构建每个阶段，并验证追加画面不会改变这些早期状态。 因此，我们将这些运行描述为时间戳过滤的，而非经过验证的流式评估。

sents.en: However, construction still uses the full recording.
sents.zh: 然而，构建过程仍然使用了完整的记录。

sents.en: The vocabulary draws on frames throughout the video, and pose estimation, consolidation, and segmentation all run offline.
sents.zh: 词汇表参考了视频中的所有帧，而姿态估计、整合和分割均在离线状态下运行。

sents.en: Filtering their outputs does not show that earlier memory states are independent of later frames.
sents.zh: 过滤它们的输出并未表明早期的记忆状态与后续帧相互独立。

sents.en: To establish this, we would need to build every stage using only footage available by each query time and verify that appending footage does not change those earlier states.
sents.zh: 为了证实这一点，我们需要在每一查询时刻仅使用当时可用的画面来构建每个阶段，并验证追加画面不会改变这些早期状态。

sents.en: We therefore describe these runs as timestamp-filtered, rather than as a validated streaming evaluation.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将这些运行描述为时间戳过滤的，而非经过验证的流式评估。

paragraphs.en: Repeating GPT-5.4 on identical inputs changes the selected option on about a quarter of pilot questions. Our main claims therefore rely on paired comparisons across thousands of questions, rather than these pilot estimates.
paragraphs.zh: 对相同输入重复运行 GPT-5.4，会导致大约四分之一的试点问题所选选项发生变化。 因此，我们的主要论点依赖于数千个问题之间的成对比较，而非这些试点估计结果。

sents.en: Repeating GPT-5.4 on identical inputs changes the selected option on about a quarter of pilot questions.
sents.zh: 对相同输入重复运行 GPT-5.4，会导致大约四分之一的试点问题所选选项发生变化。

sents.en: Our main claims therefore rely on paired comparisons across thousands of questions, rather than these pilot estimates.
sents.zh: 因此，我们的主要论点依赖于数千个问题之间的成对比较，而非这些试点估计结果。

paragraphs.en: Tagging uses at most 80 frames per recording, with a budget of 130 tokens per frame. Detection runs at 1280 pixels with a confidence threshold of 0.25 and at most 40 detections per frame. Lifting uses the HD-EPIC budgets. Consolidation uses a mask-IoU threshold of 0.3 and a 3D-distance limit of 1.0. Persistence requires three observations outside a radius of 0.3. Both distance thresholds are in scene units when metric scale is unavailable.
paragraphs.zh: 标记功能每次录音最多使用 80 帧，每帧的令牌预算为 130。 检测功能以 1280 像素运行，置信度阈值为 0.25，每帧最多检测 40 个目标。 提取功能使用 HD-EPIC 预算。 整合功能使用 0.3 的掩码 IoU 阈值和 1.0 的三维距离限制。 持续性功能要求在半径为 0.3 的范围外进行三次观察。 当缺少度量标定时，两个距离阈值均以场景单位为基准。

sents.en: Tagging uses at most 80 frames per recording, with a budget of 130 tokens per frame.
sents.zh: 标记功能每次录音最多使用 80 帧，每帧的令牌预算为 130。

sents.en: Detection runs at 1280 pixels with a confidence threshold of 0.25 and at most 40 detections per frame.
sents.zh: 检测功能以 1280 像素运行，置信度阈值为 0.25，每帧最多检测 40 个目标。

sents.en: Lifting uses the HD-EPIC budgets.
sents.zh: 提取功能使用 HD-EPIC 预算。

sents.en: Consolidation uses a mask-IoU threshold of 0.3 and a 3D-distance limit of 1.0.
sents.zh: 整合功能使用 0.3 的掩码 IoU 阈值和 1.0 的三维距离限制。

sents.en: Persistence requires three observations outside a radius of 0.3.
sents.zh: 持续性功能要求在半径为 0.3 的范围外进行三次观察。

sents.en: Both distance thresholds are in scene units when metric scale is unavailable.
sents.zh: 当缺少度量标定时，两个距离阈值均以场景单位为基准。

paragraphs.en: GPT-5.4 answers each question in one call, using about 1,500–1,800 input tokens with memory and 500 for the blind control. Depth Anything 3 estimates poses in 48-frame chunks with 12 overlapping frames. FastVGGT uses 96-frame chunks with 16 overlapping frames and joins them by Sim(3) alignment. If a chunk cannot be aligned, it starts from a new anchor instead of failing. This fallback was needed for scene-change streams, where some alignment errors at the boundary reached 3–21 scene units.
paragraphs.zh: GPT-5.4 每次调用仅回答一个问题，使用约 1,500–1,800 个输入令牌（含记忆）和 500 个用于盲控制的令牌。 Depth Anything 3 以 48 帧的片段为单位估算姿态，其中包含 12 帧重叠的图像。 FastVGGT 使用 96 帧的片段，包含 16 帧重叠的图像，并通过 Sim(3) 对齐将它们合并。 如果某个片段无法对齐，系统会从新的锚点重新开始，而不是直接失败。 对于存在场景切换的视频流，需要这种备用机制，因为边界处的某些对齐错误可能达到 3–21 个场景单位。

sents.en: GPT-5.4 answers each question in one call, using about 1,500–1,800 input tokens with memory and 500 for the blind control.
sents.zh: GPT-5.4 每次调用仅回答一个问题，使用约 1,500–1,800 个输入令牌（含记忆）和 500 个用于盲控制的令牌。

sents.en: Depth Anything 3 estimates poses in 48-frame chunks with 12 overlapping frames.
sents.zh: Depth Anything 3 以 48 帧的片段为单位估算姿态，其中包含 12 帧重叠的图像。

sents.en: FastVGGT uses 96-frame chunks with 16 overlapping frames and joins them by Sim(3) alignment.
sents.zh: FastVGGT 使用 96 帧的片段，包含 16 帧重叠的图像，并通过 Sim(3) 对齐将它们合并。

sents.en: If a chunk cannot be aligned, it starts from a new anchor instead of failing.
sents.zh: 如果某个片段无法对齐，系统会从新的锚点重新开始，而不是直接失败。

sents.en: This fallback was needed for scene-change streams, where some alignment errors at the boundary reached 3–21 scene units.
sents.zh: 对于存在场景切换的视频流，需要这种备用机制，因为边界处的某些对齐错误可能达到 3–21 个场景单位。

paragraphs.en: We construct 100 streams from 212 UCS-Bench recordings, using each recording once. Sixty same-scene streams combine two 12-minute EgoLife recordings of the same house on different days. Forty scene-change streams combine a 1–12-minute EPIC-Kitchens or EgoBlind clip with a 20-minute TeleEgo recording; twelve contain three parts. In these streams, the place, wearer, and camera change at the recording boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 212 段 UCS-Bench 录音中构建出 100 个流，每段录音仅使用一次。 60 个同一场景的流将两段时长为 12 分钟的 EgoLife 录音结合，这两段录音记录了不同日期对同一栋房屋的拍摄。 40 个场景切换的流将一段 1–12 分钟的 EPIC-Kitchens 或 EgoBlind 片段与一段 20 分钟的 TeleEgo 录音结合；其中 12 个流包含三个部分。 在这些流中，地点、佩戴者和摄像头会在录音的边界处发生变化。

sents.en: We construct 100 streams from 212 UCS-Bench recordings, using each recording once.
sents.zh: 我们从 212 段 UCS-Bench 录音中构建出 100 个流，每段录音仅使用一次。

sents.en: Sixty same-scene streams combine two 12-minute EgoLife recordings of the same house on different days.
sents.zh: 60 个同一场景的流将两段时长为 12 分钟的 EgoLife 录音结合，这两段录音记录了不同日期对同一栋房屋的拍摄。

sents.en: Forty scene-change streams combine a 1–12-minute EPIC-Kitchens or EgoBlind clip with a 20-minute TeleEgo recording; twelve contain three parts.
sents.zh: 40 个场景切换的流将一段 1–12 分钟的 EPIC-Kitchens 或 EgoBlind 片段与一段 20 分钟的 TeleEgo 录音结合；其中 12 个流包含三个部分。

sents.en: In these streams, the place, wearer, and camera change at the recording boundary.
sents.zh: 在这些流中，地点、佩戴者和摄像头会在录音的边界处发生变化。

paragraphs.en: We build one memory and one DirectMe graph over each complete stream. Tagging, pose estimation, association, and description generation therefore operate across recording boundaries. We ask every source question again, shifting its timestamp to its position in the stream. Frame-based conditions sample from the stream’s start up to the question time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为每个完整的流构建一个记忆和一个 DirectMe 图。 因此，标签添加、姿态估计、关联和描述生成操作会跨越记录边界进行。 我们会重新提出每个源问题，并将其时间戳调整到其在流中的位置。 基于帧的条件会从流的开始处一直采样到问题出现的时间点。

sents.en: We build one memory and one DirectMe graph over each complete stream.
sents.zh: 我们为每个完整的流构建一个记忆和一个 DirectMe 图。

sents.en: Tagging, pose estimation, association, and description generation therefore operate across recording boundaries.
sents.zh: 因此，标签添加、姿态估计、关联和描述生成操作会跨越记录边界进行。

sents.en: We ask every source question again, shifting its timestamp to its position in the stream.
sents.zh: 我们会重新提出每个源问题，并将其时间戳调整到其在流中的位置。

sents.en: Frame-based conditions sample from the stream’s start up to the question time.
sents.zh: 基于帧的条件会从流的开始处一直采样到问题出现的时间点。

paragraphs.en: The same questions were answered on their original recordings two to five days earlier using the same code. Between these runs, blind accuracy changes by 0.3 points and 27% of selected options differ, providing a check on answering variation. Of 3,264 questions paired across all seven conditions, 3,244 remain after excluding questions affected by API errors. We recorded 23 such errors and excluded them rather than scoring them as incorrect. Image-refusal rates are similar: 11.4% on individual recordings and 11.5% on stitched streams. Table 27 gives paired accuracy for every condition.
paragraphs.zh: 这些问题在早两到五天的原始录音中，使用相同的代码得到了同样的回答。 在这几次运行之间，盲测准确率变化了 0.3 个百分点，且 27% 的所选选项存在差异，这为回答差异提供了验证依据。 在所有七种条件下配对的 3,264 个问题中，排除受 API 错误影响的问题后，剩余 3,244 个问题。 我们记录了 23 个此类错误，并将其排除在外，而不是将其计为错误答案。 图像拒绝率相似：单独录音中的拒绝率为 11.4%，拼接流中的拒绝率为 11.5%。 表 27 列出了每种条件下的配对准确率。

sents.en: The same questions were answered on their original recordings two to five days earlier using the same code.
sents.zh: 这些问题在早两到五天的原始录音中，使用相同的代码得到了同样的回答。

sents.en: Between these runs, blind accuracy changes by 0.3 points and 27% of selected options differ, providing a check on answering variation.
sents.zh: 在这几次运行之间，盲测准确率变化了 0.3 个百分点，且 27% 的所选选项存在差异，这为回答差异提供了验证依据。

sents.en: Of 3,264 questions paired across all seven conditions, 3,244 remain after excluding questions affected by API errors.
sents.zh: 在所有七种条件下配对的 3,264 个问题中，排除受 API 错误影响的问题后，剩余 3,244 个问题。

sents.en: We recorded 23 such errors and excluded them rather than scoring them as incorrect.
sents.zh: 我们记录了 23 个此类错误，并将其排除在外，而不是将其计为错误答案。

sents.en: Image-refusal rates are similar: 11.4% on individual recordings and 11.5% on stitched streams.
sents.zh: 图像拒绝率相似：单独录音中的拒绝率为 11.4%，拼接流中的拒绝率为 11.5%。

sents.en: Table 27 gives paired accuracy for every condition.
sents.zh: 表 27 列出了每种条件下的配对准确率。

paragraphs.en: The protocol changes recording length as well as scene identity: scene-change streams place a short clip before a longer recording. Their effects therefore cannot be separated in this comparison. An earlier experiment on 303 streams merged memories built separately for each recording and showed little accuracy change ( − 1.6 -1.6 and + 0.9 +0.9 points). That setup kept construction within each recording; constructing memory over the joined stream exposes failures that merging completed memories does not test.
paragraphs.zh: 该协议会改变记录长度以及场景身份：场景转换流会在较长的记录前插入一个短片段。 因此，在这项比较中无法将它们的效果区分开来。 一项针对 303 个流的早期实验合并了为每次记录分别构建的记忆，结果显示准确性几乎没有变化（−1.6 和 +0.9 分）。 该设置使记忆构建局限于每次记录内部；而在合并后的流上构建记忆，则会暴露出合并已完成记忆所无法检测到的问题。

sents.en: The protocol changes recording length as well as scene identity: scene-change streams place a short clip before a longer recording.
sents.zh: 该协议会改变记录长度以及场景身份：场景转换流会在较长的记录前插入一个短片段。

sents.en: Their effects therefore cannot be separated in this comparison.
sents.zh: 因此，在这项比较中无法将它们的效果区分开来。

sents.en: An earlier experiment on 303 streams merged memories built separately for each recording and showed little accuracy change ( − 1.6 -1.6 and + 0.9 +0.9 points).
sents.zh: 一项针对 303 个流的早期实验合并了为每次记录分别构建的记忆，结果显示准确性几乎没有变化（−1.6 和 +0.9 分）。

sents.en: That setup kept construction within each recording; constructing memory over the joined stream exposes failures that merging completed memories does not test.
sents.zh: 该设置使记忆构建局限于每次记录内部；而在合并后的流上构建记忆，则会暴露出合并已完成记忆所无法检测到的问题。

paragraphs.en: Questions in a stream’s first recording are unchanged for every arm (Table 28 ); the loss grows with the number of earlier scenes. The loss on scene-change streams varies by the question’s source recording. EPIC-Kitchens questions lose 8.0 points with memory ( p < 10 − 4 p<10^{-4} ) and 8.5 with frames. Memory losses on TeleEgo and EgoBlind are smaller, at 2.5 and 1.4 points, respectively, and neither is significant.
paragraphs.zh: 在流的首次记录中，所有分支的问题均保持不变（表 28）；损失会随着早期场景数量的增加而增大。 场景切换流中的损失因问题的来源记录而异。 EPIC-Kitchens 的问题在使用记忆时损失 8.0 分（p < 10⁻⁴），使用帧时损失 8.5 分。 TeleEgo 和 EgoBlind 中记忆相关的损失较小，分别为 2.5 分和 1.4 分，且两者均不显著。

sents.en: Questions in a stream’s first recording are unchanged for every arm (Table 28 ); the loss grows with the number of earlier scenes.
sents.zh: 在流的首次记录中，所有分支的问题均保持不变（表 28）；损失会随着早期场景数量的增加而增大。

sents.en: The loss on scene-change streams varies by the question’s source recording.
sents.zh: 场景切换流中的损失因问题的来源记录而异。

sents.en: EPIC-Kitchens questions lose 8.0 points with memory ( p < 10 − 4 p<10^{-4} ) and 8.5 with frames.
sents.zh: EPIC-Kitchens 的问题在使用记忆时损失 8.0 分（p < 10⁻⁴），使用帧时损失 8.5 分。

sents.en: Memory losses on TeleEgo and EgoBlind are smaller, at 2.5 and 1.4 points, respectively, and neither is significant.
sents.zh: TeleEgo 和 EgoBlind 中记忆相关的损失较小，分别为 2.5 分和 1.4 分，且两者均不显著。

paragraphs.en: Timestamp-filtered retrieval still returns objects first seen in an earlier recording for 29% of EPIC-Kitchens questions and 4% of TeleEgo questions. Accuracy falls from 42% to 24% on questions with such a candidate, compared with 41% to 37% on questions without one. On same-scene streams, these objects come from the same kitchen, and we observe no corresponding drop (38.9% to 39.9%). Across question categories, the memory’s consistent decline is in Proximity & Reachability, from 51.0% to 45.1%.
paragraphs.zh: 经过时间戳过滤的检索仍然会返回在早期录像中首次出现的物体，这种情况在 EPIC-Kitchens 问题中占 29%，在 TeleEgo 问题中占 4%。 对于存在此类候选答案的问题，准确率从 42% 下降至 24%，而在不存在此类候选答案的问题中，准确率为 41% 至 37%。 在同一场景的视频流中，这些物体来自同一个厨房，但我们并未观察到相应的准确率下降（从 38.9% 升至 39.9%）。 在各个问题类别中，记忆模块的准确率持续下降最明显的是“邻近性与可达性”类别，从 51.0% 降至 45.1%。

sents.en: Timestamp-filtered retrieval still returns objects first seen in an earlier recording for 29% of EPIC-Kitchens questions and 4% of TeleEgo questions.
sents.zh: 经过时间戳过滤的检索仍然会返回在早期录像中首次出现的物体，这种情况在 EPIC-Kitchens 问题中占 29%，在 TeleEgo 问题中占 4%。

sents.en: Accuracy falls from 42% to 24% on questions with such a candidate, compared with 41% to 37% on questions without one.
sents.zh: 对于存在此类候选答案的问题，准确率从 42% 下降至 24%，而在不存在此类候选答案的问题中，准确率为 41% 至 37%。

sents.en: On same-scene streams, these objects come from the same kitchen, and we observe no corresponding drop (38.9% to 39.9%).
sents.zh: 在同一场景的视频流中，这些物体来自同一个厨房，但我们并未观察到相应的准确率下降（从 38.9% 升至 39.9%）。

sents.en: Across question categories, the memory’s consistent decline is in Proximity & Reachability, from 51.0% to 45.1%.
sents.zh: 在各个问题类别中，记忆模块的准确率持续下降最明显的是“邻近性与可达性”类别，从 51.0% 降至 45.1%。

paragraphs.en: On stitched streams, our memory outperforms DirectMe’s graph by 6.8 points overall ( p < 10 − 9 p<10^{-9} ), or 4.0 points after excluding questions handled by DirectMe’s counting rule. The advantage is 4.6 points on scene-change streams. With frames and the same memory-routing rule, our memory outperforms DirectMe’s graph by 3.1 points overall ( p = 0.0009 p=0.0009 ) and 0.4 points on scene-change streams.
paragraphs.zh: 在拼接流中，我们的记忆系统整体表现比 DirectMe 的图结构高出 6.8 分（p < 10⁻⁹），若排除由 DirectMe 的计数规则处理的问题，则高出 4.0 分。 在场景切换流中，这一优势为 4.6 分。 在使用帧和相同的记忆路由规则时，我们的记忆系统整体表现比 DirectMe 的图结构高出 3.1 分（p = 0.0009），在场景切换流中则高出 0.4 分。

sents.en: On stitched streams, our memory outperforms DirectMe’s graph by 6.8 points overall ( p < 10 − 9 p<10^{-9} ), or 4.0 points after excluding questions handled by DirectMe’s counting rule.
sents.zh: 在拼接流中，我们的记忆系统整体表现比 DirectMe 的图结构高出 6.8 分（p < 10⁻⁹），若排除由 DirectMe 的计数规则处理的问题，则高出 4.0 分。

sents.en: The advantage is 4.6 points on scene-change streams.
sents.zh: 在场景切换流中，这一优势为 4.6 分。

sents.en: With frames and the same memory-routing rule, our memory outperforms DirectMe’s graph by 3.1 points overall ( p = 0.0009 p=0.0009 ) and 0.4 points on scene-change streams.
sents.zh: 在使用帧和相同的记忆路由规则时，我们的记忆系统整体表现比 DirectMe 的图结构高出 3.1 分（p = 0.0009），在场景切换流中则高出 0.4 分。

paragraphs.en: Compared with frames alone, adding our memory gains 1.1 points on stitched streams, which is not significant, and 0.7 points on individual recordings.
paragraphs.zh: 与仅使用帧相比，加入我们的记忆机制后，在拼接流上的得分提升了 1.1 分（这一提升并不显著），在单个录像上的得分则提升了 0.7 分。

paragraphs.en: Using the true scene boundaries to restrict retrieved candidates recovers 1.1 accuracy points ( p = 0.37 p=0.37 ; Table 29 ). Also trimming the displayed histories to the current scene increases the recovery to 3.0 points ( p = 0.011 p=0.011 ) on the same questions. This supports cross-scene retrieval as one source of the loss.
paragraphs.zh: 利用真实的场景边界来限制检索到的候选项，可使准确率恢复 1.1 个点（p = 0.37；表 29）。 此外，将显示的历史记录裁剪至当前场景，在同一组问题上也能使准确率恢复 3.0 个点（p = 0.011）。 这表明跨场景检索是造成损失的原因之一。

sents.en: Using the true scene boundaries to restrict retrieved candidates recovers 1.1 accuracy points ( p = 0.37 p=0.37 ; Table 29 ).
sents.zh: 利用真实的场景边界来限制检索到的候选项，可使准确率恢复 1.1 个点（p = 0.37；表 29）。

sents.en: Also trimming the displayed histories to the current scene increases the recovery to 3.0 points ( p = 0.011 p=0.011 ) on the same questions.
sents.zh: 此外，将显示的历史记录裁剪至当前场景，在同一组问题上也能使准确率恢复 3.0 个点（p = 0.011）。

sents.en: This supports cross-scene retrieval as one source of the loss.
sents.zh: 这表明跨场景检索是造成损失的原因之一。

paragraphs.en: Memory construction introduces two further problems. First, tag canonicalization assumes a single physical scene and drops labels that appear inconsistent with it. In one stitched stream, it retains 98 distinct labels, compared with 121 across the original recordings. For 96% of questions after a scene boundary, the retrieved candidates differ from those returned by the separate builds; their label multisets have a Jaccard similarity of 0.3.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆构建带来了另外两个问题。 首先，标签规范化假设存在一个单一的物理场景，并丢弃那些与之不一致的标签。 在一条拼接后的数据流中，它保留了 98 个不同的标签，而原始记录中的总数为 121 个。 在场景边界之后提出的 96% 的问题中，检索到的候选答案与单独构建的记忆返回的结果不同；它们的标签多重集之间的贾卡德相似度为 0.3。

sents.en: Memory construction introduces two further problems.
sents.zh: 记忆构建带来了另外两个问题。

sents.en: First, tag canonicalization assumes a single physical scene and drops labels that appear inconsistent with it.
sents.zh: 首先，标签规范化假设存在一个单一的物理场景，并丢弃那些与之不一致的标签。

sents.en: In one stitched stream, it retains 98 distinct labels, compared with 121 across the original recordings.
sents.zh: 在一条拼接后的数据流中，它保留了 98 个不同的标签，而原始记录中的总数为 121 个。

sents.en: For 96% of questions after a scene boundary, the retrieved candidates differ from those returned by the separate builds; their label multisets have a Jaccard similarity of 0.3.
sents.zh: 在场景边界之后提出的 96% 的问题中，检索到的候选答案与单独构建的记忆返回的结果不同；它们的标签多重集之间的贾卡德相似度为 0.3。

paragraphs.en: Second, the Depth Anything 3 pose check can reject an entire stream because of an error at the boundary. One boundary residual is 0.61 m, exceeding the 0.5 m limit. Across 29 of 37 scene-change streams, the pipeline falls back to unscaled FastVGGT poses. The number of metric-distance mentions in the prompts falls from 2,305 to 856. Neither failure occurs in the same-scene streams.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，Depth Anything 3 的姿态检查可能会因边界处的错误而拒绝整个数据流。 其中一个边界的残差为 0.61 米，超过了 0.5 米的限制。 在 37 个场景切换数据流中，有 29 个场景的管道会回退到未缩放的 FastVGGT 姿态。 提示词中提及的度量距离数量从 2,305 降至 856。 这两种故障均未出现在同一场景的数据流中。

sents.en: Second, the Depth Anything 3 pose check can reject an entire stream because of an error at the boundary.
sents.zh: 其次，Depth Anything 3 的姿态检查可能会因边界处的错误而拒绝整个数据流。

sents.en: One boundary residual is 0.61 m, exceeding the 0.5 m limit.
sents.zh: 其中一个边界的残差为 0.61 米，超过了 0.5 米的限制。

sents.en: Across 29 of 37 scene-change streams, the pipeline falls back to unscaled FastVGGT poses.
sents.zh: 在 37 个场景切换数据流中，有 29 个场景的管道会回退到未缩放的 FastVGGT 姿态。

sents.en: The number of metric-distance mentions in the prompts falls from 2,305 to 856.
sents.zh: 提示词中提及的度量距离数量从 2,305 降至 856。

sents.en: Neither failure occurs in the same-scene streams.
sents.zh: 这两种故障均未出现在同一场景的数据流中。

paragraphs.en: Building memory separately for each recording brings accuracy closer to the single-recording results at every stream position: 37.0% versus 37.2% for questions in the first recording, 40.4% versus 42.9% after one earlier scene, and 36.6% versus 38.3% after two. Recovery is therefore substantial but incomplete.
paragraphs.zh: 为每次记录单独构建记忆，使准确性在每一流位置都更接近单次记录的结果：第一次记录中的问题准确率为 37.0%，而单次记录为 37.2%；经过一个早期场景后，准确率为 40.4%，而单次记录为 42.9%；经过两个场景后，准确率为 36.6%，而单次记录为 38.3%。 因此，恢复效果显著但并不完全。

sents.en: Building memory separately for each recording brings accuracy closer to the single-recording results at every stream position: 37.0% versus 37.2% for questions in the first recording, 40.4% versus 42.9% after one earlier scene, and 36.6% versus 38.3% after two.
sents.zh: 为每次记录单独构建记忆，使准确性在每一流位置都更接近单次记录的结果：第一次记录中的问题准确率为 37.0%，而单次记录为 37.2%；经过一个早期场景后，准确率为 40.4%，而单次记录为 42.9%；经过两个场景后，准确率为 36.6%，而单次记录为 38.3%。

sents.en: Recovery is therefore substantial but incomplete.
sents.zh: 因此，恢复效果显著但并不完全。

paragraphs.en: Cuts are detected by a no-revisit test on CLIP embeddings of the 1 fps frames: r 10 r_{10} is the 10th percentile of the distance from the next five minutes of frames to their nearest earlier frame, divided by the median nearest-neighbour distance among earlier frames at least 30 s apart, and a cut is declared where r 10 ≥ 1 r_{10}\geq 1 . Across the 100 streams, the detector finds 89 of 112 true boundaries within 60 s, including 42 of 52 on scene-change streams. It also adds 2.3 extra cuts per stream, mostly at room changes within EgoLife recordings, and 1.1 per individual recording. These extra cuts have little measured effect on same-scene accuracy (37.6% versus 37.9%). Grayscale thumbnails and colour histograms did not reliably distinguish boundaries, while a place-label consistency filter removed genuine cuts.
paragraphs.zh: 通过针对 CLIP 嵌入中每秒 1 帧的帧进行无重访测试来检测剪辑：r_{10} 是接下来五分钟内的帧与其最近的前一帧之间距离的第 10 百分位数，该距离除以至少相隔 30 秒的前序帧之间的最近邻距离的中位数；当 r_{10} ≥ 1 时，即判定存在剪辑。 在 100 个流中，检测器在 60 秒内找到了 112 个真实边界中的 89 个，其中包括场景切换流中 52 个边界中的 42 个。 此外，该检测器还为每个流增加了 2.3 个额外剪辑，主要出现在 EgoLife 记录中的房间转换处，以及每个单独记录中增加 1.1 个剪辑。 这些额外剪辑对同一场景的准确率几乎没有可测量的影响（37.6% 对比 37.9%）。 灰度缩略图和颜色直方图无法可靠地区分边界，而地点标签一致性过滤器则错误地移除了真实剪辑。

sents.en: Cuts are detected by a no-revisit test on CLIP embeddings of the 1 fps frames: r 10 r_{10} is the 10th percentile of the distance from the next five minutes of frames to their nearest earlier frame, divided by the median nearest-neighbour distance among earlier frames at least 30 s apart, and a cut is declared where r 10 ≥ 1 r_{10}\geq 1 .
sents.zh: 通过针对 CLIP 嵌入中每秒 1 帧的帧进行无重访测试来检测剪辑：r_{10} 是接下来五分钟内的帧与其最近的前一帧之间距离的第 10 百分位数，该距离除以至少相隔 30 秒的前序帧之间的最近邻距离的中位数；当 r_{10} ≥ 1 时，即判定存在剪辑。

sents.en: Across the 100 streams, the detector finds 89 of 112 true boundaries within 60 s, including 42 of 52 on scene-change streams.
sents.zh: 在 100 个流中，检测器在 60 秒内找到了 112 个真实边界中的 89 个，其中包括场景切换流中 52 个边界中的 42 个。

sents.en: It also adds 2.3 extra cuts per stream, mostly at room changes within EgoLife recordings, and 1.1 per individual recording.
sents.zh: 此外，该检测器还为每个流增加了 2.3 个额外剪辑，主要出现在 EgoLife 记录中的房间转换处，以及每个单独记录中增加 1.1 个剪辑。

sents.en: These extra cuts have little measured effect on same-scene accuracy (37.6% versus 37.9%).
sents.zh: 这些额外剪辑对同一场景的准确率几乎没有可测量的影响（37.6% 对比 37.9%）。

sents.en: Grayscale thumbnails and colour histograms did not reliably distinguish boundaries, while a place-label consistency filter removed genuine cuts.
sents.zh: 灰度缩略图和颜色直方图无法可靠地区分边界，而地点标签一致性过滤器则错误地移除了真实剪辑。

paragraphs.en: We first emulate per-scene construction using existing per-recording memories. A detected segment contained within one recording uses that recording’s memory restricted to the segment’s time window. A segment spanning a missed boundary uses the memory built over the joined stream. Of 422 detected segments, 61 coincide with an entire recording.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先利用现有的每条记录的记忆，模拟每场景的构建过程。 若检测到的片段位于单条记录内，则使用该记录的、限定于该片段时间窗口的记忆。 若片段跨越了被遗漏的边界，则使用在整个合并流中构建的记忆。 在检测到的 422 个片段中，有 61 个与整条记录完全重合。

sents.en: We first emulate per-scene construction using existing per-recording memories.
sents.zh: 我们首先利用现有的每条记录的记忆，模拟每场景的构建过程。

sents.en: A detected segment contained within one recording uses that recording’s memory restricted to the segment’s time window.
sents.zh: 若检测到的片段位于单条记录内，则使用该记录的、限定于该片段时间窗口的记忆。

sents.en: A segment spanning a missed boundary uses the memory built over the joined stream.
sents.zh: 若片段跨越了被遗漏的边界，则使用在整个合并流中构建的记忆。

sents.en: Of 422 detected segments, 61 coincide with an entire recording.
sents.zh: 在检测到的 422 个片段中，有 61 个与整条记录完全重合。

paragraphs.en: Across all streams, this emulated memory scores 37.4%, compared with 36.4% when building one memory over each stream ( + 1.0 +1.0 points, p = 0.29 p=0.29 ). It remains below the 38.9% score on individual recordings ( − 1.5 -1.5 points, p = 0.048 p=0.048 ). For questions after two earlier scenes, the gain over the whole-stream build is 6.6 points ( p = 0.13 p=0.13 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在所有流中，这种模拟记忆的得分为 37.4%，而每个流单独构建一个记忆时的得分为 36.4%（+1.0 +1.0 分，p = 0.29 p=0.29）。 该得分仍低于单个录音的 38.9%（−1.5 -1.5 分，p = 0.048 p=0.048）。 对于发生在两个早期场景之后的问题，与整个流构建方式相比，得分提升了 6.6 分（p = 0.13 p=0.13）。

sents.en: Across all streams, this emulated memory scores 37.4%, compared with 36.4% when building one memory over each stream ( + 1.0 +1.0 points, p = 0.29 p=0.29 ).
sents.zh: 在所有流中，这种模拟记忆的得分为 37.4%，而每个流单独构建一个记忆时的得分为 36.4%（+1.0 +1.0 分，p = 0.29 p=0.29）。

sents.en: It remains below the 38.9% score on individual recordings ( − 1.5 -1.5 points, p = 0.048 p=0.048 ).
For questions after two earlier scenes, the gain over the whole-stream build is 6.6 points ( p = 0.13 p=0.13 ).
sents.zh: 对于发生在两个早期场景之后的问题，与整个流构建方式相比，得分提升了 6.6 分（p = 0.13 p=0.13）。

paragraphs.en: We also run the full pipeline separately on each detected segment, including tag canonicalization, pose checks, and scale recovery. We evaluate this rebuild on 39 of the 40 scene-change streams, covering 1,251 questions; one stream is excluded because a segment has no usable tags. Accuracy reaches 36.5%, compared with 33.8% for the whole-stream build ( + 2.7 +2.7 points, p = 0.08 p=0.08 ) and 39.5% for individual-recording builds. Gains are 4.4 points after one earlier scene and 7.1 after two. These results are consistent with the partial recovery estimated by emulation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还对每个检测到的片段单独运行完整的处理流程，包括标签标准化、姿态检查和尺度恢复。 我们在 40 个场景切换流中的 39 个流上评估了这种重建方法，共涵盖 1,251 个问题；其中一个流被排除在外，因为其中某个片段没有可用的标签。 准确率达到 36.5%，而整个流程构建的准确率为 33.8%（+2.7 个百分点，p = 0.08），单独记录构建的准确率为 39.5%。 经过一个早期场景后，准确率提升了 4.4 个百分点；经过两个早期场景后，提升了 7.1 个百分点。 这些结果与通过模拟估算出的部分恢复效果一致。

sents.en: We also run the full pipeline separately on each detected segment, including tag canonicalization, pose checks, and scale recovery.
sents.zh: 我们还对每个检测到的片段单独运行完整的处理流程，包括标签标准化、姿态检查和尺度恢复。

sents.en: We evaluate this rebuild on 39 of the 40 scene-change streams, covering 1,251 questions; one stream is excluded because a segment has no usable tags.
sents.zh: 我们在 40 个场景切换流中的 39 个流上评估了这种重建方法，共涵盖 1,251 个问题；其中一个流被排除在外，因为其中某个片段没有可用的标签。

sents.en: Accuracy reaches 36.5%, compared with 33.8% for the whole-stream build ( + 2.7 +2.7 points, p = 0.08 p=0.08 ) and 39.5% for individual-recording builds.
sents.zh: 准确率达到 36.5%，而整个流程构建的准确率为 33.8%（+2.7 个百分点，p = 0.08），单独记录构建的准确率为 39.5%。

sents.en: Gains are 4.4 points after one earlier scene and 7.1 after two.
sents.zh: 经过一个早期场景后，准确率提升了 4.4 个百分点；经过两个早期场景后，提升了 7.1 个百分点。

sents.en: These results are consistent with the partial recovery estimated by emulation.
sents.zh: 这些结果与通过模拟估算出的部分恢复效果一致。

paragraphs.en: For each sampled frame, Qwen3.5-9B writes an event line of about 18 words describing what the wearer is doing, the objects or people involved, and the location. We store these lines alongside the object records. At answer time, the reader receives the last six lines before the question and the ten that best match its words.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个采样帧，Qwen3.5-9B 都会生成一行约 18 个词的事件描述，说明穿戴者正在做什么、涉及哪些物体或人物以及所处的位置。 我们将这些描述行与物体记录一同存储。 在回答时，阅读器会收到问题之前的最后六行描述，以及与问题关键词最匹配的前十行描述。

sents.en: For each sampled frame, Qwen3.5-9B writes an event line of about 18 words describing what the wearer is doing, the objects or people involved, and the location.
sents.zh: 对于每个采样帧，Qwen3.5-9B 都会生成一行约 18 个词的事件描述，说明穿戴者正在做什么、涉及哪些物体或人物以及所处的位置。

sents.en: We store these lines alongside the object records.
sents.zh: 我们将这些描述行与物体记录一同存储。

sents.en: At answer time, the reader receives the last six lines before the question and the ten that best match its words.
sents.zh: 在回答时，阅读器会收到问题之前的最后六行描述，以及与问题关键词最匹配的前十行描述。

paragraphs.en: We developed this extension on 22 of the 100 stitched streams (807 questions). Unless stated otherwise, the main text reports results on the remaining 78 streams (2,461 questions). On these held-out streams, event lines improve accuracy by 2.0 points [ 0.5 , 3.6 ] [0.5,3.6] on individual recordings ( p = 0.023 p=0.023 ) and 2.6 points [ 0.9 , 4.4 ] [0.9,4.4] on stitched streams ( p = 0.004 p=0.004 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 100 条拼接流中的 22 条（807 个问题）上开发了这个扩展。 除非另有说明，正文报告的是其余 78 条流（2,461 个问题）上的结果。 在这些预留的流中，事件行将单个录音的准确率提升了 2.0 分 [ 0.5 , 3.6 ] [0.5,3.6]（p = 0.023 p=0.023），拼接流的准确率则提升了 2.6 分 [ 0.9 , 4.4 ] [0.9,4.4]（p = 0.004 p=0.004）。

sents.en: We developed this extension on 22 of the 100 stitched streams (807 questions).
sents.zh: 我们在 100 条拼接流中的 22 条（807 个问题）上开发了这个扩展。

sents.en: Unless stated otherwise, the main text reports results on the remaining 78 streams (2,461 questions).
sents.zh: 除非另有说明，正文报告的是其余 78 条流（2,461 个问题）上的结果。

sents.en: On these held-out streams, event lines improve accuracy by 2.0 points [ 0.5 , 3.6 ] [0.5,3.6] on individual recordings ( p = 0.023 p=0.023 ) and 2.6 points [ 0.9 , 4.4 ] [0.9,4.4] on stitched streams ( p = 0.004 p=0.004 ).

paragraphs.en: We also tested longer, 60-word lines and nine retrieval or prompt variants. Only one variant improved development accuracy ( + 4.2 +4.2 points), and that gain did not carry over to the held-out streams. All ablations below use one GPT-5.4 run per condition, evaluated on the questions answered by every condition in the table. We use exact McNemar tests; overall accuracy varies by about ± 1 \pm 1 point across repeated runs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还测试了更长、包含 60 个单词的文本行，以及九种检索或提示变体。 仅有一种变体提升了开发集准确率（+4.2 分），且这一提升并未延续到预留的数据流中。 以下所有消融实验均对每种条件执行一次 GPT-5.4 运行，并在表格中每个条件所回答的问题上进行评估。 我们使用精确的麦克尼马尔检验；重复运行中，整体准确率的变化约为 ±1 分。

sents.en: We also tested longer, 60-word lines and nine retrieval or prompt variants.
sents.zh: 我们还测试了更长、包含 60 个单词的文本行，以及九种检索或提示变体。

sents.en: Only one variant improved development accuracy ( + 4.2 +4.2 points), and that gain did not carry over to the held-out streams.
sents.zh: 仅有一种变体提升了开发集准确率（+4.2 分），且这一提升并未延续到预留的数据流中。

sents.en: All ablations below use one GPT-5.4 run per condition, evaluated on the questions answered by every condition in the table.
sents.zh: 以下所有消融实验均对每种条件执行一次 GPT-5.4 运行，并在表格中每个条件所回答的问题上进行评估。

sents.en: We use exact McNemar tests; overall accuracy varies by about ± 1 \pm 1 point across repeated runs.
sents.zh: 我们使用精确的麦克尼马尔检验；重复运行中，整体准确率的变化约为 ±1 分。

paragraphs.en: The same event lines were built on the HD-EPIC frames (36,633 lines, one per sampled frame) and shown to the answerer as the 16 lines that best match the question, together with the names of the retrieved candidates, since HD-EPIC questions mark objects by box. Table 30 compares them with the same memory re-answered in the same session. The mean moves by + 0.7 +0.7 [ − 1.3 , + 2.5 ] [-1.3,+2.5] , no prototype changes significantly, and the gap to AMEGO on fixture-interaction counting and stationary localization remains.
paragraphs.zh: 相同的事件线构建于 HD-EPIC 帧之上（共 36,633 条线，每帧采样一条），并以与问题最匹配的 16 条线的形式展示给回答者，同时附上检索到的候选项名称，因为 HD-EPIC 的问题通过方框来标记物体。 表 30 将它们与在同一会话中以相同方式重新回答的相同记忆进行了比较。 平均移动量为 +0.7 +0.7 [−1.3, +2.5] [−1.3,+2.5]，没有原型发生显著变化，但与 AMEGO 在固定装置交互计数和静止定位方面的差距仍然存在。

sents.en: The same event lines were built on the HD-EPIC frames (36,633 lines, one per sampled frame) and shown to the answerer as the 16 lines that best match the question, together with the names of the retrieved candidates, since HD-EPIC questions mark objects by box.
sents.zh: 相同的事件线构建于 HD-EPIC 帧之上（共 36,633 条线，每帧采样一条），并以与问题最匹配的 16 条线的形式展示给回答者，同时附上检索到的候选项名称，因为 HD-EPIC 的问题通过方框来标记物体。

sents.en: Table 30 compares them with the same memory re-answered in the same session.
sents.zh: 表 30 将它们与在同一会话中以相同方式重新回答的相同记忆进行了比较。

sents.en: The mean moves by + 0.7 +0.7 [ − 1.3 , + 2.5 ] [-1.3,+2.5] , no prototype changes significantly, and the gap to AMEGO on fixture-interaction counting and stationary localization remains.
sents.zh: 平均移动量为 +0.7 +0.7 [−1.3, +2.5] [−1.3,+2.5]，没有原型发生显著变化，但与 AMEGO 在固定装置交互计数和静止定位方面的差距仍然存在。

paragraphs.en: Table 31 removes one part of the memory with event lines at a time (Figure 7 a). No removal moves the overall score by more than 1.3 points on the questions every arm answered, whereas the changes by category reach 13 points (egocentric position without 3D geometry) and differ in sign across categories. On the larger set of questions answered by both the reference and a given arm (3,103 to 3,171), removing the event lines costs 2.2 points ( p = 0.006 p=0.006 ) and the descriptions 1.8 ( p = 0.02 p=0.02 ); the other removals stay within noise.
paragraphs.zh: 表31每次移除记忆中与事件行相关的部分（图7a）。 在所有各臂都回答的问题中，任何移除操作都不会使总分变化超过1.3分，但按类别计算的变化可达13分（以自我为中心的位置且不含三维几何），并且不同类别的变化方向相反。 在参考模型和给定臂共同回答的更大问题集（3,103至3,171题）中，移除事件行会导致2.2分的损失（p = 0.006 p=0.006），移除描述则导致1.8分的损失（p = 0.02 p=0.02）；其他移除操作的影响则在噪声范围内。

sents.en: Table 31 removes one part of the memory with event lines at a time (Figure 7 a).
sents.zh: 表31每次移除记忆中与事件行相关的部分（图7a）。

sents.en: No removal moves the overall score by more than 1.3 points on the questions every arm answered, whereas the changes by category reach 13 points (egocentric position without 3D geometry) and differ in sign across categories.
sents.zh: 在所有各臂都回答的问题中，任何移除操作都不会使总分变化超过1.3分，但按类别计算的变化可达13分（以自我为中心的位置且不含三维几何），并且不同类别的变化方向相反。

paragraphs.en: ReMEmbR [ 2 ] captions every sampled frame with VILA, stores the camera position and time of each caption, and answers with an agent that issues embedding searches over the captions in several rounds, about four calls and 23k tokens per question; our reader is one keyword lookup and one call, about 3 to 5k tokens. Table 32 crosses the two records with the two readers (Figure 7 b). To be indexed by ReMEmbR’s embedder, our record is re-expressed as one text item per sampled moment (event line, place, and the objects in view with their descriptions and positions); adding each object’s direction and distance from the wearer to the items did not help. We use ReMEmbR’s captions read by its own agent as the reference. On paired questions, switching those captions to our reader lowers accuracy by 5.0 points ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 , exact McNemar test). Our records score 1.2 points below the reference with our reader ( p = 0.35 p=0.35 ) and 0.8 points above it with ReMEmbR’s agent ( p = 0.42 p=0.42 ).
paragraphs.zh: ReMEmbR [ 2 ] 使用 VILA 为每个采样帧添加描述，存储每个描述的摄像头位置和时间，并通过一个智能体进行回答；该智能体会围绕这些描述进行多轮嵌入搜索，每问题平均约四次调用和 23k 个词元；而我们的阅读器仅需一次关键词查找和一次调用，平均约 3 到 5k 个词元。 表 32 将这两种记录与两种阅读器进行了对比（图 7b）。 为了能被 ReMEmbR 的嵌入器索引，我们的记录被重新表达为每个采样时刻的一项文本内容（事件行、地点以及视野中的物体及其描述和位置）；为这些项目添加每个物体相对于佩戴者的方向和距离并未带来帮助。 我们将 ReMEmbR 由其自身智能体读取的描述作为参考。 在配对问题中，将这些描述替换为我们的阅读器会使准确率下降 5.0 分（p < 0.001 p<0.001，精确的 McNemar 检验）。 使用我们的阅读器时，我们的记录得分比参考值低 1.2 分（p = 0.35 p=0.35）；而使用 ReMEmbR 的智能体时，则比参考值高 0.8 分（p = 0.42 p=0.42）。

sents.en: ReMEmbR [ 2 ] captions every sampled frame with VILA, stores the camera position and time of each caption, and answers with an agent that issues embedding searches over the captions in several rounds, about four calls and 23k tokens per question; our reader is one keyword lookup and one call, about 3 to 5k tokens.

sents.en: On paired questions, switching those captions to our reader lowers accuracy by 5.0 points ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 , exact McNemar test).
sents.zh: 在配对问题中，将这些描述替换为我们的阅读器会使准确率下降 5.0 分（p < 0.001 p<0.001，精确的 McNemar 检验）。

sents.en: Our records score 1.2 points below the reference with our reader ( p = 0.35 p=0.35 ) and 0.8 points above it with ReMEmbR’s agent ( p = 0.42 p=0.42 ).
sents.zh: 使用我们的阅读器时，我们的记录得分比参考值低 1.2 分（p = 0.35 p=0.35）；而使用 ReMEmbR 的智能体时，则比参考值高 0.8 分（p = 0.42 p=0.42）。

paragraphs.en: ReMEmbR’s captions still outperform the blind control under our reader by 2.6 points ( p = 0.01 p=0.01 ), showing that they contain useful evidence. However, their advantage under the native-system comparison does not persist when both memories use the same reader. Routing spatial questions to our reader and all remaining questions to ReMEmbR’s agent yields 42.0% accuracy on 3,357 questions.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的阅读器中，ReMEmbR的标题描述仍然比盲控组高出2.6分（p = 0.01 p=0.01），这表明其中包含了有用的证据。 然而，当两个记忆系统都使用相同的阅读器时，它们在原生系统比较中的优势便不复存在。 将空间问题路由到我们的阅读器，并将所有剩余问题路由到ReMEmbR的智能体，在3,357个问题中实现了42.0%的准确率。

paragraphs.en: The 763 questions about an earlier scene that do not depend on the present moment (object recall, counting, and object and wearer trajectories) are re-asked at the end of the stream, about their original moment, from the memory held at the end. Rewording a question as delayed moves the blind prior by + 5.5 +5.5 on the same questions, so Table 34 reports each arm’s change net of blind: the frame reader loses most, since its 48 frames must cover the whole stream, and the memories lose 3 to 4 points. When the original moment is given exactly, rounded to 1, 5, or 10 minutes, or not at all, ReMEmbR is insensitive to the hint (40.9 to 42.7), Ledger agent {}_{\text{agent}} is within 1 to 2 points of it at every level (n.s.), and our single-shot reader is weaker (30.7 to 36.7) because its time bonus favours what was seen near the question, which for a delayed question is the end of the stream.

paragraphs.en: Table 39 follows the evidence through the pipeline. The largest measured losses happen before the answerer reads the record: on development videos, giving GPT-5.4 the ground-truth trajectory of the queried object in place of the stored one adds 12 points, and naming the fixtures it rested on adds another 25, whereas a fixed rule improves on the answerer’s reasoning by only 3 points on fixture location (Appendices B.7 and B.2 ). Each weak category of RQ1 (Section 4 ) maps to one row: stationary localization and fixture-interaction counting to what the record keeps about rest and hands, counting to association, and long recordings to construction.
paragraphs.zh: 表 39 沿着整个流程追踪了相关证据。 测得的最大损失发生在回答者阅读记录之前：在开发视频中，用所查询对象的真实轨迹替换存储的轨迹可为 GPT-5.4 增加 12 分，而指出其支撑的固定装置又能增加 25 分；相比之下，一条固定规则对回答者关于固定装置位置的推理仅能提升 3 分（附录 B.7 和 B.2）。 RQ1（第 4 节）的每个弱类别对应一行：静态定位和与固定装置的互动对应记录中关于静止状态和双手的信息，计数对应关联，而长时录像则对应构建。

The questions were chosen to show how the memories differ, not how often; rates are in Tables 3 and 27 . Our memory answers all four stream questions, DirectMe’s graph answers one, and ReMEmbR none.

paragraphs.en: The differences follow from what each memory keeps. For Q2, “What did I take out of the cabinet?”, DirectMe’s graph has no node for the object, and ReMEmbR’s captions near that time do not name it. Our detector labelled the object a coffee maker, but its segment description reads “a digital immersion circulator, not a coffee maker … the person’s hands are holding the device”, and the answerer matches it to the heating rod. For the chair in Q5, our stored position is 0.73 m from the annotated one, against 1.81 m for DirectMe and 2.37 m for ReMEmbR, which stores where the wearer was rather than where the object is.

paragraphs.en: A memory is built once per recording and read many times, whereas frames are re-read at every question. This appendix measures what each memory costs the answering model at answer time, on the same questions for every arm. Tokens are the answering model’s own usage, averaged per question, and calls are language-model calls per question. Memory construction is excluded: every method builds its memory locally, with no API calls, so its cost is compute time rather than tokens. Published video models and video-retrieval methods that we did not run on these questions are absent.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆在一次记录中构建一次，但会被多次读取；而帧则会在每次提问时重新读取。 本附录衡量了在每个回答时刻，每个记忆对回答模型所产生的成本，且所有分支均使用相同的提问进行测试。 Token 是指回答模型自身的消耗量，按每问平均计算；调用则指每问触发的语言模型调用次数。 记忆构建过程未被计入：所有方法均在本地构建其记忆，不涉及任何 API 调用，因此其成本为计算时间而非 Token。 已发布的视频模型以及我们未在这些问题上运行的视频检索方法均未包含在内。

paragraphs.en: On HD-EPIC (Table 40 ), the stored record is read in one call of about 1.8k input tokens, and the two memories that cost less are the two that keep less: AMEGO’s interaction log at 0.8k admits only handled objects, and the blind control at 0.4k stores nothing. The memories that cost more do not answer better here. ReMEmbR reads about 14 times as many input tokens over roughly four calls and scores at the blind level, because its captions carry no object positions.
paragraphs.zh: 在 HD-EPIC（表 40）中，存储的记录通过一次调用读取，消耗约 1.8k 输入标记；而成本较低的两种记忆是存储内容较少的两种：AMEGO 的交互日志以 0.8k 仅记录已处理的对象，而盲控则以 0.4k 不存储任何内容。 成本较高的记忆在此处并未表现出更好的效果。 ReMEmbR 在大约四次调用中读取了约 14 倍的输入标记，且得分处于盲控水平，因为其描述信息不包含对象位置。

paragraphs.en: The UCS-Bench arms (Table 41 ) separate the two costs. Reading 48 frames costs about 9.6k input tokens per question, nearly five times the 2.0k that reading our record costs, and it buys 5.9 points over the record alone. Adding the record to the frames costs a further 0.9k, about a tenth of the frame budget, and recovers 1.9 points on top of frames. A memory therefore substitutes for frames at roughly a fifth of the answer-time cost, and complements them at a small fraction of it.
paragraphs.zh: UCS-Bench 的臂（表 41）将两种成本分开计算。 读取 48 帧每道题大约需要 9.6k 输入标记，几乎是读取我们记录所需的 2.0k 的五倍，但仅凭记录本身只能获得 5.9 分的提升。 将记录添加到帧中会额外消耗 0.9k，约占帧预算的十分之一，并能在帧的基础上再提升 1.9 分。 因此，内存能以大约五分之一的答案时间成本替代帧，并以极小的一部分成本对其起到补充作用。

paragraphs.en: ReMEmbR returns an answer for 2,183 of the 2,772 questions. Restricted to those, it scores 41.3% against 38.5% for our memory, so it is ahead on these single recordings, and it reads 18,917 input tokens over 3.7 calls per question against 2,041 in one call, about nine times the input for one call in place of four. The blind control scores 33.3% on the same subset. Whether that accuracy is worth the cost depends on the budget; the comparison of what each record preserves, independent of how it is read, is in Appendix E.7 .
paragraphs.zh: ReMEmbR 在 2,772 个问题中回答了其中的 2,183 个。 仅在这些问题上，其得分为 41.3%，而我们的记忆模型为 38.5%；因此，在这些单次记录中，ReMEmbR 表现更优：每问题平均每次调用读取 18,917 个输入标记（共 3.7 次调用），而我们的模型每次调用仅读取 2,041 个标记，即单次调用输入的约九倍，而非四倍。 在相同子集上，盲控模型的得分为 33.3%。 这种准确性是否值得付出相应成本取决于预算；关于各记录所保留内容的比较（不考虑其读取方式）见附录 E.7。
